altar-of-fangs.name: Altar of Fangs
altar-of-fangs.description: Upon the Altar of Fangs, the ancient Amani sealed the vaults of Atal'Utek with the Fang of Ula'tek. Only that cursed dagger has the power to unseal the prison of the great weapon of the Amani. Aid Orweyna and Liadrin in their pursuit of Zul'jan, who has entered this accursed place in a misbegotten attempt to bring lost glory back to the Amani.

bosses.name: Rav'i
bosses.description: This ravenous hydra has survived this cursed place through scavenging the meat of the fallen. That doesn't mean it is not a fearsome combatant, eager to add some fresh temple explorers to its otherwise rotting diet.

tips.text:
• Ravenous Stomp drops Fresh Meat on some Carrion Piles.
• Carrion Piles with Fresh Meat cause Rav'i to go into a Feeding Frenzy.
• Rav'i inflicts melee damage with Hydrastrike.

• Rav'i stops Ssscavenging or her Feeding Frenzy when her absorb shield is removed.
• Ssscavenging and Feeding Frenzy both continuously apply Carrion Burst to all players until stopped.
• Regurgitate hurls waves of acid in a player's direction.

• Triple Shot inflicts damage around 3 players over time.
• While Rav'i is eating, she afflicts all players with increasing applications of Carrion Burst and is a Messy Eater.
• Regurgitate hurls waves of acid in a player's direction.

bosses.overview:
Rav'i's domain is littered with Carrion Piles from the many sacrificed creatures thrown into the pit. Occasionally, Rav'i makes a Ravenous Stomp, dropping Fresh Meat.

Upon running out of energy, Rav'i begins Ssscavenging from the nearest Carrion Pile. If the Carrion Pile contains Fresh Meat, Rav'i goes into a Feeding Frenzy.

abilities.name: Ssscavenging
abilities.text:
Rav'i runs to feast on the nearest Carrion Pile, gaining a shield that absorbs all damage. Until her shield is removed, Rav'i applies Carrion Burst to all enemies every 3 sec.
$? DIFF23 | DIFF8 [
Rav'i is a Messy Eater, and throws chunks of rotting meat across the pit while Ssscavenging.
][]
If the Carrion Pile contains Fresh Meat, Rav'i goes into a Feeding Frenzy instead.

children.name: Feeding Frenzy
children.text:
Rav'i runs to feast on the nearest Carrion Pile, gaining a shield that absorbs all damage. Until her shield is removed, Rav'i applies Carrion Burst to all enemies every 3 sec.
$? DIFF23 | DIFF8 [
Rav'i is a Messy Eater, and throws chunks of rotting meat across the pit while in a Feeding Frenzy.
][]

children.name: Carrion Burst
children.text: The stench of rotting meat and viscera clings to all enemies, inflicting Nature damage every 3 sec for 9 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Messy Eater
children.text:
Rav'i's chomping throws chunks of rotting meat across the pit. Each chunk inflicts Nature damage to enemies near its impact location.

Each chunk that isn't caught by an enemy explodes in a Carrion Burst.

children.name: Carrion Burst
children.text: The stench of rotting meat and viscera clings to all enemies, inflicting Nature damage every 3 sec for 9 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fresh Meat
children.text: The taste of Fresh Meat throws Rav'i into a Feeding Frenzy, causing her to eat twice as fast.

children.name: Scent of Blood
children.text: If the nearest Carrion Pile contains Fresh Meat, Rav'i gains Scent of Blood, increasing attack speed by 30%.

abilities.name: Fetid Roar
abilities.text:
Rav'i stomps impatiently, sending a quake through the temple that inflicts Nature damage to all enemies and breaks several stalactites from the ceiling. Each stalactite inflicts Nature damage to enemies near the impact and stuns players caught in the impact for 2 sec.

Flying Twinfangs are skewered by the falling rocks, dropping Fresh Meat into Rav'i's pit.

children.name: Fresh Meat
children.text: The taste of Fresh Meat throws Rav'i into a Feeding Frenzy, causing her to eat twice as fast.

children.name: Scent of Blood
children.text: If the nearest Carrion Pile contains Fresh Meat, Rav'i gains Scent of Blood, increasing attack speed by 30%.

abilities.name: Triple Shot
abilities.text: Rav'i shoots globs of venom at 3 enemies that each inflict Nature damage and an additional Nature damage to enemies within yd every 1 sec for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Regurgitate
abilities.text: Rav'i hurls 3 waves of stomach acid in lines toward an enemy, inflicting Nature damage to enemies within yards and enemies caught in the waves, and decreasing their movement speed by 50% and their damage done by 50%.

abilities.name: Hydrastrike
abilities.text: Each of Rav'i's three heads strike her current target, inflicting Physical damage.

bosses.name: The Writhing Coil
bosses.description: In the feeding frenzy upon each other, there has been one Child of Ula'tek that has proved victorious over the rest of the brood. With every battle won, the twisting monstrosity known as the Writhing Coil only grows stronger.

tips.text:
• Tail Scythe inflicts heavy Physical damage.
• Interrupting Death Rattle with Vine Grip causes the creature to Uncoil.

• Interrupting Death Rattle with Vine Grip causes the creature to Uncoil.
• Damage inflicted while the Writhing Coil is Uncoiled persists after Assimilation.
• Toxic Atrophy reduces all players' speed and damage done.

• Death Rattle inflicts increasing damage to all players.
• Interrupting Death Rattle with Vine Grip causes the creature to Uncoil.

bosses.overview:
The Writhing Coil assaults its enemies relentlessly with Vindictive Onslaught and its razor sharp Tail Scythe.

When the beast prepares to unleash Death Rattle, Orweyna empowers players with Vine Grip to Uncoil the creature and clash with the serpents one by one.

children.name: [PH] Ability #1
children.text: The Writhing Coil unleashes a relentless rattle, inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks, and increases its applications every 1 sec until the Writhing Coil is pulled apart.

children.name: Vine Grip
children.text: Orweyna attaches players to the Writhing Coil with powerful vines. All attached players moving 10yd farther from the Writhing Coil causes it to Uncoil.

children.name: Uncoil
children.text: The Writhing Coil is ripped apart into its constituent snakes, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Toxic Barrage
children.text: The Writhing Coil prepares to afflict its enemies with Toxic Atrophy 3 times in succession.

children.name: Toxic Atrophy
children.text: Releases a toxin that causes all enemies' muscles to wither away, reducing their damage done by 20% and their movement speed by 20%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Vindictive Onslaught
children.text: The Writhing Coil directs a sequence of vicious attacks at an enemy.

children.name: Burrowing Charge
children.text: The Writhing Coil burrows across the ground, inflicting Nature damage to enemies in its path.

children.name: Venom Jet
children.text: The Writhing Coil unleashes a spray of venom at an enemy, inflicting Nature damage to enemies in a cone in front of it.

children.name: Tail Scythe
children.text: The Writhing Coil slices its current target with a bladed tail, inflicting Physical damage.

children.name: Synchronized Venom
children.text: The Writhing Coil shoots venom at all enemies, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 35 sec.

children.name: Uncoiled
children.text:
The Writhing Coil splits into Uncoiled Writhes, each with a portion of the Writhing Coil's health. After 20 sec, the Uncoiled Writhes cast, and the Writhing Coil reforms with the combined health of the Uncoiled Writhes.

Uncoiled Writhes are susceptible to crowd control effects.

children.name: Spiteful Hunt
children.text: Each Uncoiled Writhe fixates on an enemy.

children.name: Toxic Atrophy
children.text: Releases a toxin that causes all enemies' muscles to wither away, reducing their damage done by 20% and their movement speed by 20%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Undermining
children.text: Upon defeat, an Uncoiled Writhe begins destabilizing the earth, inflicting Nature damage and knocking back enemies above them.

bosses.name: Zul'jan
bosses.description: With the Fang of Ula'tek, Zul'jan performs the final ritual to gain the power to release the monstrous weapon his ancestors sealed away thousands of years ago. Still held in the sway of the spirit of Malacrass, Zul'jan is unaware that the Fang is also the only hope for his sister Zul'jarra's survival.

tips.text:
•Chop Down inflicts heavy Physical damage.
•Ritual of the Fang inflicts damage to all players unless intercepted.
•Bloodletting removes Ritual Venom.

•Ritual of the Fang inflicts damage to all players unless intercepted.
•Bloodletting removes Ritual Venom.
•Axegrinder and Boneslicer inflict Physical damage to players struck.

•Axegrinder and Boneslicer inflict Physical damage to players struck.
•Ritual of the Fang inflicts damage to all players unless intercepted.
•Bloodletting removes Ritual Venom.

bosses.overview:
During Ritual of the Fang, Zul'jan invokes the altar's ancient venoms to empower the dagger.

Zul'jan then hacks, slashes, and chops down his enemies as the sacred grounds stain crimson with Bloodletting.

abilities.name: [PH] Ability #1
abilities.text:
Zul'jan wields the Fang of Ula'tek as snake heads focus ancient beams into him for 8 sec, granting Fang Empowered.

Upon interception by players, the beams instead inflict Nature damage every 1 sec and apply Ritual Venom.

children.name: Fang Empowered
children.text: The Fang of Ula'tek pulses with strength, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Ritual Venom
children.text: Dormant toxins fill the player for 50 sec. Upon expiration, the venom bursts inflicting Nature damage.

abilities.name: Bloodletting
abilities.text: Zul'jan's Physical abilities cause players to hemorrhage, removing applications of Ritual Venom and creating pools of blood inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players within them.

abilities.name: Boneslicer
abilities.text: Zul'jan hurls an axe at a player, inflicting Physical damage to all players caught in its path and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 7 sec. This effect ignores armor.

abilities.name: Axegrinder
abilities.text:
Zul'jan unleashes spinning axes that eviscerate players on contact, inflicting up to ${*} Physical damage. This effect ignores armor.

The axes ricochet through the arena, inflicting reduced damage as they lose speed.

abilities.name: Chop Down
abilities.text: Zul'jan hacks twice at his current target, inflicting Physical damage with each strike.

den-of-nalorakk.name: Den of Nalorakk
den-of-nalorakk.description: Wounded by Zul'jin and Malacrass, Nalorakk turned his back on the Amani, slumbering in his den to ease his pain. Now, the Amani seek to heal the rift between their tribe and the loa. But, to gain Nalorakk's favor, those who come before him must complete his trials. Assist Zul'jarra as she journeys into the mind of the Loa of War to defeat him and gain his blessing.

bosses.name: The Hoardmonger
bosses.description: Driven by voracious greed, the gluttonous Hoardmonger fiercely defends the stashes of food and supplies he has stolen from nearby troll tribes. Nalorakk's first trial is to eliminate him before the tribes go hungry.

tips.text:
• Rotten Mushrooms apply Toxic Spores upon contact, preventing them from detonating in a Putrid Burst.
• Earthshatter Slam and Bonespike Slam inflict massive damage in a frontal cone.
• Ravenous Bellow and Hearty Bellow inflicts high damage to all players.

• Ravenous Bellow and Hearty Bellow inflict high damage to all players.
• Rotten Mushrooms' Toxic Spores can be removed by Poison-cleansing effects.
• Earthshatter Slam and Bonespike Slam inflict massive damage in a frontal cone.

• The Hoardmonger gathers from the nearest resource pile during Resourceful Measures.
• Rotten Mushrooms apply Toxic Spores upon contact, preventing them from detonating in a Putrid Burst.
• Ravenous Bellow and Hearty Bellow inflict high damage to all players.

bosses.overview:
The Hoardmonger prevents his reserves from being pilfered at all costs, casting Resourceful Measures upon reaching 90%, 70%, and 40% health, empowering one of his abilities.

Upon reaching 100 energy, he tosses Spoiled Supplies throughout the arena, growing Rotten Mushrooms for 12 seconds. Upon contact, these apply Toxic Spores destroying the fungi, preventing Putrid Burst.

abilities.name: Resourceful Measures
abilities.text: The Hoardmonger gathers from the nearest pile of resources, replacing one of his abilities with a new one.

children.name: Overflowing Supplies
children.text:
Gathering from his pile of mushrooms, the Hoardmonger gains Overflowing Supplies.

This effect increases the amount of s thrown during Spoiled Supplies.

children.name: Bonespike Slam
children.text:
Gathering from his pile of bones, the Hoardmonger unlocks Bonespike Slam.

The Hoardmonger slams the ground, inflicting Nature damage to players in a frontal cone. This additionally creates bone spikes for 45 sec which apply Bonespiked upon contact.

children.name: Bonespiked
children.text: Broken bones litter the ground, inflicting Physical damage every 0.5 sec and reducing movement speed by 50%.

children.name: Hearty Bellow
children.text:
Gathering from his pile of meat, the Hoardmonger unlocks Hearty Bellow.

The Hoardmonger lets out a mighty roar, inflicting Physical damage to all players and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 10 sec and knocking them back. Ignores armor.

abilities.name: Spoiled Supplies
abilities.text: The Hoardmonger reaches into his sack and tosses rotten food over 7 sec, impacting targeted players for Nature damage or littering s around the arena.

children.name: Rotten Mushroom
children.text:
This fungi grows for 12 seconds then detonates in a Putrid Burst, covering all players in Toxic Spores.

Upon contact, the spores transfer, applying Toxic Spores and destroying the fungi.

children.name: Toxic Spores
children.text: Rotten Mushrooms apply a noxious cloud, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 12 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Putrid Burst
children.text: After sec the mushroom bursts, inflicting Nature damage, applying Toxic Spores to all players.

abilities.name: Earthshatter Slam
abilities.text: The Hoardmonger slams the ground, inflicting Nature damage to players in a frontal cone.

abilities.name: Ravenous Bellow
abilities.text: The Hoardmonger lets out a mighty roar, inflicting Physical damage to all players and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 10 sec. Ignores armor.

bosses.name: Sentinel of Winter
bosses.description: The seasons can be kind or cruel. Sentinel of Winter unleashes the harshest of winter storms to test all who face him. To surpass Nalorakk's second trial, endure the biting cold and defeat the embodiment of a winter storm.

tips.text:
• Fractured Shivercores create Snowdrifts and trigger Rimeshatter when defeated.

•Frozen Tempest inflicts heavy damage and pushes players back.
•Raging Squalls wander the landscape and inflict moderate damage.

•Frozen Tempest inflicts heavy damage and pushes players back.
•Glacial Torment inflicts a large amount of damage, but can be removed by Magic-cleansing effects.
• Fractured Shivercores create Snowdrifts and trigger Rimeshatter when defeated.

• Fractured Shivercores create Snowdrifts and trigger Rimeshatter when defeated.

•Frozen Tempest inflicts heavy damage and pushes players back.
•Raging Squalls wander the landscape and inflict moderate damage.

bosses.overview:
The Sentinel of Winter harnesses the power of the surrounding blizzard. This forms Raging Squalls which wander the landscape, and Fractured Shivercores which cast Winter's Shroud until defeated.

Frozen Tempest creates a massive storm that pulses Frost damage to all players and continously pushes them back.

abilities.name: Frozen Tempest
abilities.text:
The Sentinel of Winter manifests a massive storm, inflicting Frost damage to all players every 1 sec, pushing them away.

Players outside of the eye of the storm suffer an additional Frost damage every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Shattering Frostspike
abilities.text: The Sentinel of Winter slams the ice, forming 2 icicles which splinter, inflicting Frost damage to players near targeted locations, revealing a Fractured Shivercore.

children.name: Rimeshatter
children.text:
The Fractured Shivercore bursts releasing ice shards that impact 6 sec later inflicting Frost damage to players nearby.

If no players are struck the shard fragments cause a Rime Detonation.

children.name: Rime Detonation
children.text: Inflicts Frost damage to all players and roots them in place for 4 sec.

children.name: Winter's Shroud
children.text: The Fractured Shivercore blankets players with the chill of Winter, inflicting Frost damage to all players, increasing their Frost damage taken by 10% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Snowdrift
children.text: Upon defeat, the Fractured Shivercore forms a pile of deep snow at its location. Players standing within have their movement speed reduced by 40% and are immune to forced movement effects.

abilities.name: Raging Squall
abilities.text: The Sentinel of Winter creates Raging Squalls, inflicting Frost damage to players near the impact location. These squalls wander the arena for 90 sec, inflicting Frost damage to players it hits and knocking them back.

abilities.name: Glacial Torment
abilities.text: The Sentinel of Winter assaults players with freezing temperatures, inflicting Frost damage every 2 sec for 16 sec.

bosses.name: Nalorakk
bosses.description: Slumbering in his fitful and battle-filled dream, Nalorakk, the Loa of War, will only test the mettle of the worthy. Survive his trial and receive his blessing or die trying.

tips.text:
• Fury of the War God sends Echoes of Nalorakk to attack Zul'jarra, stopping only to cast Echoing Fury on the first target they encounter.
• Each Echo of Nalorakk casts Echoing Maul when Nalorakk casts Echoing Maul.
• Nalorakk's Forceful Roar pushes all players away.

• Overwhelming Onslaught inflicts significant damage even while protected from Zul'jarra's Defensive Stance.
• Each Echo of Nalorakk casts Echoing Maul when Nalorakk casts Echoing Maul.
• Nalorakk's Forceful Roar pushes all players away.

• Zul'jarra's Defensive Stance greatly reduces Nalorakk's Overwhelming Onslaught.
• Fury of the War God sends Echoes of Nalorakk to attack Zul'jarra, stopping only to cast Echoing Fury on the first target they encounter.
• Each Echo of Nalorakk casts Echoing Maul when Nalorakk casts Echoing Maul.

bosses.overview:
The Loa of War spares no mortal as the final trial, assailing players with Echoing Maul and pushing them with Forceful Roar.

At 100 energy, Nalorakk casts Fury of the War God, slamming Zul'jarra across the arena and incapacitating her with Concussive Shock. Nalorakk commands Echoes of Nalorakk to charge the defenseless Zul'jarra, casting Echoing Fury when colliding with the first target they encounter.

abilities.name: Fury of the War God
abilities.text:
Nalorakk headbutts Zul'jarra into a Concussive Shock, then commands the Echoes of Nalorakk to charge her position. These collide with the first target encountered casting Echoing Fury.

Any Echo of Nalorakk that reaches Zul'jarra triggers Demoralizing Scream. Each Echo remains for one additional Fury of the War God, then vanishes.

children.name: Concussive Shock
children.text: Nalorakk disables Zul'jarra with a hefty blow. Unable to defend herself, she stands vulnerable to Nalorakk's echoes.

children.name: Demoralizing Scream
children.text:
Zul'jarra cries out in pain from the undefended attack, inflicting Physical damage to all players. Ignores armor.

Players feel the weight of her burden, increasing damage taken by 10% for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Echoing Fury
children.text: The charging Echo of Nalorakk ravages the first target in their path, inflicting Nature damage.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Onslaught
abilities.text:
Nalorakk unleashes a devastating set of attacks on all players, inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec for 3 sec. These attacks ignore armor. 

The final hit stuns Zul'Jarra and knocks all players back. Nalorakk then targets Zul'Jarra with Forceful Slam.

children.name: Defensive Stance
children.text: When Nalorakk casts, Zul'jarra creates a protective barrier reducing damage taken from by 80% to players behind her.

children.name: Forceful Slam
children.text: Nalorakk unleashes a power slam on Zul'jarra. Inflicting Physical damage to all players near impact. If there is no player hit, Zul'jarra bears the full force of the slam, causing her to let out a Demoralizing Scream.

children.name: Demoralizing Scream
children.text:
Zul'jarra cries out in pain from the undefended attack, inflicting Physical damage to all players. Ignores armor.

Players feel the weight of her burden, increasing damage taken by 10% for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Echoing Maul
abilities.text: Nalorakk marks players for 4 sec, then sends an Echo of Nalorakk to their position. All Echoes of Nalorakk immediately inflict Nature damage to players nearby.

children.name: Spectral Slash
children.text: The echo slashes at nearby players, knocking them back. The slash lingers on player, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 12 sec. This effect stacks.

loot.name: Formula: Enchant Chest - Mark of Nalorakk

kings-rest.name: Kings' Rest
kings-rest.description:
Few places in Zandalar are more sacred than Kings' Rest. Every king, conqueror, or tyrant who has held control of the Zandalari empire is housed within this great city of the dead to protect and honor not only their bodies, but also their spirits.

Entry has historically been restricted solely to the Zandalari priesthood and royalty, but as Zul's dark magic winds its way through the tomb you must venture inside and put an end to the darkness that has found purchase there.

bosses.name: The Golden Serpent
bosses.description: Kings' Rest has come under attack before. After a foolish troll tried to summon Hakkar the Soulflayer to this island many millennia ago, the priests of Zandalar created a mighty construct to defend this tomb. The Golden Serpent has stood against intruders ever since, judging who is worthy to enter these sacred halls.

tips.text:
•Tail Thrash inflicts Physical damage to the current target player.
•Each stack of Luster shields The Golden Serpent and increases its damage.

•Spit Gold inflicts Fire damage over time to the afflicted player and leaves a pool of Molten Gold at their location.
•Serpentine Gust inflicts damage to all players.

•Lucre's Call turns all pools of Molten Gold into Animated Gold, which move toward The Golden Serpent.
•Spit Gold inflicts Fire damage over time to the afflicted player and leaves a pool of Molten Gold at their location.

bosses.overview: The Golden Serpent spits gold at party members, who then leave it behind in the form of Molten Gold. The Golden Serpent later animates these pools with Lucre's Call. Any Animated Gold that reaches The Golden Serpent is absorbed, granting a stack of Luster that shields the Serpent and increases its damage.

abilities.name: Spit Gold
abilities.text: Spits molten gold at random players, inflicting Fire damage to players near impact and additional Fire damage every 2 sec for 6 sec, and creating a pool of Molten Gold at the player's location afterwards.

children.name: Molten Gold
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players who touch the molten gold.

abilities.name: Lucre's Call
abilities.text: Turns all pools of Molten Gold in the area into Animated Gold.

children.name: Animated Gold
children.text: Attempts to move towards The Golden Serpent. If any reach it, The Golden Serpent absorbs them and gains a stack of Luster. When any Animated Gold are killed, they return to pools of Molten Gold.

children.name: Luster
children.text: Shields the Golden Serpent for 10% of its health in damage, and increases its damage done by 25% until removed. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Serpentine Gust
abilities.text: The Golden Serpent creates a powerful gust of wind for 5 sec, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 1 sec and pushing them back.

abilities.name: Tail Thrash
abilities.text: A heavy hitting melee strike that inflicts Physical damage.

bosses.name: Mchimba the Embalmer
bosses.description: There was once a caste of Zandalari whose purpose was to preserve and defend the remains of past rulers. But when a terrible plague of corrupted blood tore through the empire, it was too risky for mortals to handle the dead. Golems were summoned for the grim work of preservation and burial; they have been used ever since.

tips.text:
•Entomb seals the afflicted player inside one of the crypts.
•Open Coffin opens one of the crypts and summons a Finished Mummy.

•Drain Fluids inflicts Nature damage over time to the afflicted player. When the effect completes, it applies Desiccation, reducing the afflicted player's damage done and movement speed until they are healed above 90% health.
•Burn Corruption inflicts Fire damage to target player and creates a patch of Burning Ground.
•Entomb seals the afflicted player inside one of the crypts.

•Entomb seals the afflicted player inside one of the crypts.
•Drain Fluids inflicts Nature damage over time to the afflicted player. When the effect completes, it applies Desiccation, reducing the afflicted player's damage done and movement speed until they are healed above 90% health.
•Burn Corruption inflicts Fire damage to target player and creates a patch of Burning Ground.

bosses.overview: Mchimba the Embalmer prepares his victims for mummification. Drain Fluids inflicts Nature damage over time on target player that ends in Desiccation. Entomb seals a player inside one of the chamber's crypts, after which Mchimba begins to Open Coffin on the remaining crypts one at a time, releasing a Finished Mummy from every unoccupied crypt.

abilities.name: Command Constructs
abilities.text: Mchimba lets out a powerful roar, inflicting Physical damage tol players and commands nearby Interment Constructs to embalm players.

abilities.name: Awakening Slam
abilities.text: Mchimba slams the ground with necrotic energy, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. The slam causes random crypts to open, summoning Half-Finished Mummy.

children.name: Wretched Discharge
children.text: Afflicts all players with a disease, causing Nature damage every 2 sec for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Burn Corruption
abilities.text: Mchimba targets a random player with purifying flames, inflicting Fire damage to players near impact and creates a patch of Burning Ground.

children.name: Burning Ground
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to any players inside a patch of Burning Ground.

abilities.name: Drain Fluids
abilities.text: Prepares the targets for mummification by draining their fluids, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec and triggers Explosive Acids for 6 sec. Applies Desiccation to the target when finished.

children.name: Explosive Acids
children.text: Gastric acid that inflicts Nature damage to players near impact.

children.name: Desiccation
children.text: Reduces damage done by 50% and movement speed by 50%. Lasts until the target is healed above 90% health.

abilities.name: Entomb
abilities.text:
Entombs the target within one of the crypts inside the chamber. After casting Entomb, Mchimba will move between the crypts, opening them one at a time, beginning with the crypts that do not contain the entombed player.

Releasing the Entombed player will interrupt the ritual, preventing Mchimba from releasing additional Finished Mummies.

children.name: Open Coffin
children.text: Opens one of the crypts, releasing the occupant. Each open coffin reduces the time required to open subsequent coffins.

children.name: Struggle
children.text: While trapped, players can struggle against the doors of the crypt, alerting other players to their presence.

children.name: Finished Mummy
children.text: When a coffin that does not contain a player is opened, a Finished Mummy will emerge and attack the party.

children.name: Wretched Discharge
children.text: Afflicts all players with a disease, causing Nature damage every 2 sec for 12 sec.

bosses.name: The Council of Tribes
bosses.description: There was once a time when no single emperor could rule Zandalar. After a period of civil war, the heads of three families formed an uneasy coalition and tried to rule the empire together. Though they did not often agree, there was peace in Zandalar. Briefly.

tips.text:
•Debilitating Backhand inflicts Physical damage to Aka'ali the Conqueror's current target player, knocks them back, and applies Shattered Defenses, increasing the target's Physical damage taken.
•Barrel Through causes Aka'ali the Conqueror to charge a targeted player, inflicting heavy Physical damage that splits among all players hit.

•Barrel Through causes Aka'ali the Conqueror to charge a targeted player, inflicting heavy Physical damage that splits among all players hit.
•Severing Axe inflicts Physical damage over time to random players.

•Barrel Through causes Aka'ali the Conqueror to charge a targeted player, inflicting heavy Physical damage that splits among all players hit.
•Poison Nova inflicts Nature damage over time to all players.
•Call of the Elements summons three elemental totems with powerful effects.

bosses.overview:
The battle will begin with Kula the Butcher.

When a councilor is defeated, they will return to their urn and the next will join the encounter. However, the defeated councilor will periodically rejoin the battle to use a single ability, and then return to their urn.

When all three councilors are defeated, the encounter ends.

children.name: Whirling Axes
children.text: Kula unleashes a whirling attack that inflicts Physical damage to players nearby, knocking them back. She then throws two whirling axes which inflict Physical damage every 2 sec for 6 sec to players who come into contact with them, and knock the player back.

children.name: Severing Axe
children.text: Kula throws an axe at a random player, inflicting Physical damage and additional Physical damage every 2 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Barrel Through
children.text: Aka'ali charges a targeted player, inflicting Physical damage, split among players near impact. This attack ignores armor.

children.name: Debilitating Backhand
children.text: Wallops her current target with a Debilitating Backhand, inflicting Physical damage, knocking them back, and applying Shattered Defenses to them.

children.name: Shattered Defenses
children.text: Increases physical damage taken.

children.name: Arc Lightning
children.text: Zanazal strikes target player with a lightning bolt that arcs to other players, inflicting Nature damage to each player struck.

children.name: Poison Nova
children.text: Creates a burst of poisonous gas, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec for 12 sec.

children.name: Call of the Elements
children.text: Zanazal the Wise calls forth his reinforced elemental totems.

children.name: Explode
children.text: Explodes, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Torrent
children.text: Gouts of water spew forth from the totem, inflicting Frost damage to players nearby and knocking them back.

children.name: Disruption
children.text: A burst of thunder interrupts all players for 4 sec.

bosses.name: Dazar, The First King
bosses.description:
Dazar. The founder and first King of Zandalar, who led an exodus of his people out of the muck and mire and built a city of gold. The first tamer of raptors. The warrior undefeated. The father of a kingdom.

His eternal repose cut short by Zul's dark magic, it lies to you to once again put him to rest.

tips.text:
•Blade Combo inflicts heavy damage to its target.
•T'zala's Savage Maul increases its target's Phyiscal damage taken.

•Gilded Destruction inflicts Fire damage on all players.
•Impaling Spear periodically springs from the ceiling, inflicting heavy Phyical damage to players hit and causing them to bleed.
•T'zala's Savage Maul increases its target's Phyiscal damage taken.

•Impaling Spear periodically springs from the ceiling, inflicting heavy Phyical damage to players hit and causing them to bleed.
•King Dazar's Aerial Smash and T'zala's Quaking Leap inflict Physical damage to all players at their destinations.

bosses.overview:
Dominated by Zul's dark magic, Dazar returns from the dead with his overwhelming martial prowess intact.

At 80% health, he mounts T'zala, his loyal steed.

children.name: Eternal Bond
children.text: The eternal bond between King Dazar and T'zala causes them to share 100% of all damage taken.

children.name: Gilded Destruction
children.text: King Dazar empowers himself with molten gold around his eternal throne, then unleashes a gilded smash that inflicts Fire damage to all players and additional Fire damage for 15 sec$?|diff2[.]$?diff8[. Dazar becomes enveloped in Searing Gold.]

children.name: Searing Gold
children.text: Empowered by the molten gold, King Dazar's melee attacks creates a wave of searing gold in front of him, inflicting Fire damage to players hit.

children.name: Blade Combo
children.text: A series of deadly melee strikes that deal increasing damage to their target.

children.name: Aerial Smash
children.text: King Dazar leaps at target players, unleashing a powerful smash that inflicts Physical damage to players near impact.

children.name: Impaling Spear
children.text: Spears periodically launches from the ceiling, inflicting Physical damage to all players near impact and causes them to bleed for Physical damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

children.name: Hunting Leap
children.text: Reban jumps towards a targeted player, inflicting Physical damage and additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. Reban then follows up with a series of gutripping attacks, inflicting Physical to players in a cone with each attack.

children.name: Deathly Roar
children.text: Rezan lets out a terrifying roar, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and makes them run in fear for 4 sec.

abilities.name: T'zala
abilities.text: When Dazar reaches 80% health, he will mount T'zala.

children.name: Eternal Bond
children.text: The eternal bond between King Dazar and T'zala causes them to share 100% of all damage taken.

children.name: Savage Maul
children.text: T'zala charges towards the target player and mauls them, inflicting Physical damage. The attack leaves behind a bleeding wound on the target, causing them to bleed for Physical damage every 1 sec and increasing their Physical damage taken by 10% for 10 sec.

children.name: Quaking Leap
children.text: T'zala leaps at target players, inflicting Physical damage to players near impact.

abilities.name: Heroic and Mythic Difficulty Only
abilities.text: Kings' Rest is not available in Normal Difficulty.

murder-row.name: Murder Row
murder-row.description: The darkened streets of Murder Row hide a secret fel-smuggling operation that has been preying on the fears of Silvermoon's citizens ever since the Voidstorm appeared.

bosses.name: Kystia Manaheart
bosses.description: Although an accomplished Magister, Kystia Manaheart was far too devoted to fel magic to give it up entirely. Little wonder she's become a staunch supporter and ally to underground fel smuggling operations in the Row.

tips.text:
• Kystia turns Nibbles hostile to players with Illicit Infusion.
• Avoid Nibbles' Fel Spray.
• Interrupt Kystia's Mirror Images.

• Kystia turns Nibbles hostile to players with Illicit Infusion.
• Avoid Nibbles' Fel Spray.
• Kystia inflicts heavy damage to all players while Destabilized.

• Kystia turns Nibbles hostile to players with Illicit Infusion.
• Avoid Nibbles' Fel Spray.
• Interrupt Kystia's Mirror Images.

bosses.overview: Kystia Manaheart is accompanied by her pet mana wyrm Nibbles, who is controlled by Illicit Infusion. When this infusion is removed, Nibbles breaks free of Kystia's control and reverts back to her light form to assist players in battle with Light Infusion.

children.name: Illicit Infusion
children.text: Kystia infuses Nibbles with fel magic, turning her hostile to players while she is above 20% health.

children.name: Felshield
children.text: Kystia enshrouds herself in a fel barrier, reducing the damage she takes by ${(*)}%.

children.name: Chaos Barrage
children.text: Kystia unleashes a devastating blast of chaos at her current target, dealing Chaos damage and then jumping to nearby players at reduced effectiveness.

children.name: Fel Nova
children.text: Kystia teleports to a random player's location and sends out an explosive wave of destructive energy, inflicting Fire damage to nearby players and knocking them back.

children.name: Mirror Images
children.text: Kystia creates copies of herself nearby, each of which cast Felstorm.

children.name: Felstorm
children.text: Kystia's mirror image engulfs the arena in fel fire, inflicting Fire damage to all nearby players every 1 sec.

children.name: Fel Spray
children.text: Nibbles unleashes a spray of fel magic in a cone in front of her, dealing Fire damage to players caught in the spray every 1 sec for 5 sec.

children.name: Corroding Spittle
children.text: Nibbles spits at players, inflicting Fire damage immediately and Fire damage every 3 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Light Infusion
children.text: When Nibbles is drained of fel magic she reverts to her light form. While in her light form, Nibbles attempts to purge the fel from Kystia with an infusion of light.

children.name: Destabilized
children.text:
The light infusion stuns Kystia for 20 sec, bringing her attacks to a halt, increasing all damage she takes by 115%, and expelling bursts of fel magic that inflict Chaos damage to all players every 1 sec.

Additionally, this reduces the effectiveness of Kystia's Felshield.

bosses.name: Zaen Bladesorrow
bosses.description: Clever, quick-witted and commanding, Zaen Bladesorrow oversees the shipments of illegal fel artifacts. Those under his command follow his orders to the letter... or pay the price.

tips.text:
• At 100 energy, Zaen casts Murder in a Row. Get to cover!
• Avoid damage from Same-Day Delivery and Fire Bomb.

• At 100 energy, Zaen casts Murder in a Row. Get to cover!
• Avoid damage from Same-Day Delivery and Fire Bomb.

• At 100 energy, Zaen casts Murder in a Row. Get to cover!
• Avoid damage from Same-Day Delivery and Fire Bomb.
• Zaen inflicts heavy damage to his current target with Envenom.

bosses.overview: Zaen Bladesorrow demonstrates how this town got its name by occassionally casting Murder in a Row at all players. Dodge his deadly aim by taking cover to avoid heavy damage.

abilities.name: Murder in a Row
abilities.text: Zaen takes a few precious moments to take aim at all players. When he is ready to fire, he shoots all players in his line of sight, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Bleed damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Same-Day Delivery
abilities.text: Zaen calls upon the warehouse workers above to throw Forbidden Freight at players, causing Fire damage on impact and knocking them away.

children.name: Forbidden Freight
children.text: A shipment meant to be kept hidden from prying eyes. Provides an excellent source of cover.

children.name: Freight Explosion
children.text: Upon being hit by a Fire Bomb or Murder in a Row, Forbidden Freight explode after 5 sec, inflicting Fire damage to nearby players, knocking them away.

children.name: Fel-Infused Freight
children.text: A shipment that is barely containing the volatile magic within, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 3 sec.

abilities.name: Killing Spree
abilities.text: Zaen unleashes a rapid barrage of gunfire, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 0.5 sec over 3 sec. This attack ignores armor.

abilities.name: Fire Bomb
abilities.text: Zaen hurls a ticking bomb at a player. After 6 sec the bomb explodes, dealing Fire damage to players nearby and destroying any Forbidden Freight caught in the blast.

abilities.name: Envenom
abilities.text: Zaen drives a poisoned blade in deep at his current target, inflicting Physical damage and applying Heartstop Poison.

children.name: Heartstop Poison
children.text: A lethal poison that reduces the target's maximum health by 30% and inflicts Nature damage over 15 sec.

bosses.name: Xathuux the Annihilator
bosses.description: Xathuux the Annihilator is one of Lithiel Cinderfury's most powerful summons. Although he loathes serving the warlock, he follows her commands for the sheer visceral joy of destruction.

tips.text:
•Burning Steps leaves damaging pools of fel magic on the ground for a long duration.

•Axe Toss targets a random player and applies Fel Lightning to all players until the axe is destroyed.

•Legion Strike inflicts heavy Physical damage and reduces incoming healing.

•Axe Toss targets a random player and applies Fel Lightning to all players until the axe is destroyed.

•Legion Strike inflicts heavy Physical damage and reduces incoming healing.

•Burning Steps creates damaging pools of fel magic that expand from Xathuux the Annihilator's location and remain on the ground for a long duration.

bosses.overview: Xathuux the Annihilator's rage increases until he erupts with Demonic Rage and gains Burning Steps.

abilities.name: Demonic Rage
abilities.text: Xathuux the Annihilator flies into a Demonic Rage, inflicting Chaos damage to all players. While this effect is active, Xathuux gains 75% attack speed, suffers 30% increased incoming damage, and gains Burning Steps for 15 sec.

children.name: Burning Steps
children.text: Xathuux the Annihilator spreads fel magic across the ground from his feet inflicting Fire damage every sec to any players standing in it.

abilities.name: Axe Toss
abilities.text: Xathuux the Annihilator throws his massive axe at the location of a random player inflicting Chaos damage to players within yds of the impact. The axe remains on the ground emitting Fel Lightning until it is destroyed.

children.name: Fel Lightning
children.text: Xathuux the Annihilator's axe channels beams of fel lightning at all players inflicting Chaos damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Infernal Crush
abilities.text: Xathuux the Annihilator slams the ground with his fel-infused axe, causing energy to erupt under target players, inflicting Fire damage and additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Legion Strike
abilities.text: Xathuux the Annihilator performs a powerful swing with his axe that inflicts Physical damage and reduces healing received by 80% for 8 sec.

bosses.name: Lithiel Cinderfury
bosses.description: Lithiel Cinderfury sees the Voidstorm above Silvermoon as both threat and opportunity. Her people are afraid, and she has a perfect solution... the power of fel. She claims her smuggling operation protects her people from the dangers above, but the profits she receives are a pleasing bonus.

tips.text:
• Malefic Wave grants Malefic Empowerment to any summoned demons still alive when it passes over them.

• Chaos Bolt inflicts high damage to a random target if not interrupted.

• Chaos Bolt inflicts high damage to a random target if not interrupted.

•Furious Vilefiend inflicts heavy damage.

• Malefic Wave applies lingering damage over time when players using Lithiel's Demonic Gateway pass through Malefic Wave.

•Furious Vilefiend inflicts heavy damage.

bosses.overview:
Fingers of Gul'dan will summon Wild Imps near every target.

After casting Fingers of Gul'dan Lithiel Cinderfury casts Demonic Gateway to escape and then begins casting Malefic Wave.

Malefic Wave slowly expands over a large area inflicting heavy damage along with lingering damage over time.

Players traveling through Lithiel's Demonic Gateway are immune to the initial impact and lingering Fire vulnerability from passing through Malefic Wave.

abilities.name: Malefic Wave
abilities.text:
Lithiel Cinderfury conjures a Felshield and then projects a wave of fel fire. Impacted players suffer Fire damage every 1 sec and take 50% additional fire damage for 1 min. This effect stacks.

Demons struck by Malefic Wave are granted Malefic Empowerment.

children.name: Malefic Empowerment
children.text: Empowered by Malefic Wave, increasing haste by 100%.

children.name: Felshield
children.text: Lithiel enshrouds herself in a fel barrier, reducing the damage she takes by 50% for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Demonic Gateway
abilities.text: Lithiel Cinderfury creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway and prevents initial damage and Fire vulnerability from Malefic Wave.

abilities.name: Chaos Bolt
abilities.text: Lithiel Cinderfury unleashes a devastating blast inflicting Chaos damage.

abilities.name: Fingers of Gul'dan
abilities.text: Lithiel Cinderfury calls down demonic magic to each nearby enemy inflicting Shadowflame damage to all enemies within yds of each target. Wild Imps to burst from the impact sites and attack nearby targets.

children.name: Felfire Burst
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Summon Vilefiend
abilities.text: Lithiel summons a vilefiend that attacks players.

children.name: Shadow Bite
children.text: Melee attacks inflict additional Shadow damage to target enemy.

abilities.name: Summon Infernal
abilities.text: Summons a slow but powerful Infernal that fixates onto players.

children.name: Felfire Core
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage to nearby enemies every sec.

abilities.name: Searing Fel Flame
abilities.text: Lithiel Cinderfury engulfs herself in fel fire, radiating Fire damage to enemies every 1 sec.

ruby-life-pools.name: Ruby Life Pools
ruby-life-pools.description:
As the ancestral nesting grounds for the five flights, the Ruby Life Pools is a sacred place. The Red Dragonflight, whose charge it is to nuture all life, protect these pools and the the future of all dragonkind held within them.

However, Raszageth and her Primalists have come to steal that future away and infuse their own powers into the sacred pools. They must be stopped for dragonkind to thrive.

bosses.name: Melidrussa Chillworn
bosses.description: Melidrussa Chillworn leads the Primalist infusion efforts in the Ruby Life Pools. Her fervent belief is that she is protecting young dragon eggs from the influence of the titans and cleansing them from the stain of Order magic. She will stop at nothing to fulfill her calling and return the eggs to what she believes is their natural state.

tips.text:
•Awaken Whelps causes many Infused Whelps to swarm the party.
•Melidrussa's Infused Whelps apply Cold Claws to their current target until defeated.
•Frost Overload becomes deadly quickly unless stopped.

•Frost Overload becomes deadly quickly unless stopped.
•Awaken Whelps causes many Infused Whelps to swarm the party.
•Chillstorm and Hailburst cause significant damage.

•Chillstorm and Hailburst cause significant damage.
•Frost Overload becomes deadly quickly unless stopped.
•Melidrussa's Infused Whelps apply Cold Claws to their current target until defeated.

bosses.overview: Melidrussa assaults players with Hailburst and Chillstorm. After reaching 66% health and 33% health, Melidrussa begins a Frost Overload and calls forth Infused Whelps to assist her. These whelps apply Cold Claws to their current target with each attack.

abilities.name: Awaken Whelps
abilities.text: Melidrussa calls upon her Infused Whelps to join the fight.

children.name: Cold Claws
children.text: Infused Whelps attack with frost-infused claws, applying an affliction that causes Frozen Solid at applications.

children.name: Frozen Solid
children.text: Chilling magic freezes the player, stunning them for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Frost Overload
abilities.text:
Melidrussa pulses frost energy, encasing herself in an Ice Bulwark.

While Ice Bulwark holds, she inflicts Frost damage every 1.5 sec to all players and increases damage taken from this ability by 5% for 3 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Ice Bulwark
children.text: Ice Bulwark absorbs 10% of Melidrussa's maximum health.

abilities.name: Chillstorm
abilities.text:
Melidrussa summons a storm of frost at a player's location that pulls players towards the Storm's Eye.

Every 1.5 sec, the storm inflicts Frost damage to all players.

After 7 sec the storm explodes, inflicting Frost damage to all players and pushing them away.

children.name: Storm's Eye
children.text: Players within the eye of Melidrussa's Chillstorm take 100% increased Frost damage.

abilities.name: Hailburst
abilities.text: Melidrussa unleashes a frost wave that inflicts Frost damage to all players and launches Hailbombs at them.

children.name: Hailbombs
children.text:
The frosty mine explodes upon contact with a player, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and knocking them upward.

Additionally, these mines reduce the haste of victims by 50% for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Frigid Shard
abilities.text: Melidrussa launches a shard of ice that inflicts Physical damage to her current target.

bosses.name: Kokia Blazehoof
bosses.description: As Primalist forces assault the Ruby Life Pools from all sides, it falls to Kokia and her Blazebound lieutenants to capture precious eggs from overwhelmed defenders, all while spreading flame and havoc as they go.

tips.text:
•Searing Blows applies additional Searing Wounds with each hit.
•Blaze Volley inflicts significant damage to all players unless interrupted.
•Blazebound Firestorms from Ritual of Blazebinding cast damaging abilities until defeated.

•Blazebound Firestorms from Ritual of Blazebinding cast damaging abilities until defeated.
•Blaze Volley inflicts significant damage to all players unless interrupted.
•Molten Boulder inflicts heavy Fire damage and knocks away any player it hits.

•Inferno inflicts significant damage to all players.
•Ritual of Blazebinding inflicts significant damage to the targeted player.
•Molten Boulder inflicts heavy Fire damage and knocks away any player it hits.

bosses.overview:
Throughout the fight, Kokia alternates between hurling Molten Boulders at players and pummeling her target with Searing Blows.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Kokia performs a Ritual of Blazebinding.

abilities.name: Ritual of Blazebinding
abilities.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Kokia summons a Blazebound Firestorm at a player's location, searing players nearby for Fire damage.

children.name: Burnout
children.text: When its health is depleted, the Blazebound Firestorm goes out with a bang, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby and leaving behind Scorched Earth.

children.name: Scorched Earth
children.text: The scorched ground inflicts Fire damage to players within the flames every 1 sec.

children.name: Blaze Volley
children.text: The Blazebound Firestorm blasts all players with flames, inflicting Fire damage.

children.name: Inferno
children.text: The Blazebound Firestorm inflicts Fire damage to all players and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Molten Boulder
abilities.text:
Kokia slams a molten boulder into the ground in front of her, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby. Any player it touches takes Fire damage and gets knocked back.

The boulder rolls forward up to yards and then explodes, inflicting damage to players nearby and leaving behind Scorched Earth.

children.name: Scorched Earth
children.text: The scorched ground inflicts Fire damage to players within the flames every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Searing Blows
abilities.text: Kokia strikes her target times over 3 sec, inflicting 150% weapon damage and applying Searing Wounds with each strike.

children.name: Searing Wounds
children.text: Each strike from Searing Blows causes the victim's skin to blister and melt, inflicting Fire damage every 0.5 sec for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Kyrakka and Erkhart Stormvein
bosses.description: Kyrakka and Erkhart roam the skies above the Ruby Life Pools coordinating attacks on the shrine below, while also taking out any interfering dragons. If left unchecked, they will burn the Life Pools to the ground and blow the remaining ash away in a cleansing elemental storm.

tips.text:
• Erkhart's Stormslam inflicts high damage.
• Kyrakka's Inferno Spit denies space with resultant Flaming Embers.
• Erkhart's Winds of Change push players and Kyrakka's Flaming Embers.

• Kyrakka's Inferno Spit denies space with resultant Flaming Embers.
• Erkhart's Winds of Change push players and Kyrakka's Flaming Embers.
• Erkhart's Interrupting Cloudburst interrupts casts.

• Kyrakka's Inferno Spit inflicts significant damage to players.
• Erkhart's Interrupting Cloudburst interrupts casts.
• Erkhart's Winds of Change push players and Kyrakka's Flaming Embers.

bosses.overview:
Kyrakka begins the battle airborne, breathing flames and spitting fire from around the Ruby Overlook, whilst Erkhart intercepts players directly.

Upon either of them reaching 40% health, Kyrakka lands so Erkhart can remount, battling players atop Kyrakka.

children.name: Inferno Spit
children.text:
Kyrakka spits a gout of fire, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for.

Upon removal, these flames explode, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby, creating Flaming Embers.

children.name: Flaming Embers
children.text: Burning embers char the ground, inflicting Fire damage every sec to players within them.

children.name: Roaring Firebreath
children.text: Kyrakka forges flames in a frontal direction, tempering targets for Fire damage every 1 sec for.

children.name: Winds of Change
children.text: Erkhart conjures a localized hurricane, inflicting Nature damage every sec for, pushing players and Kyrakka's Flaming Embers.

children.name: Interrupting Cloudburst
children.text: Erkhart conjures a massive torrent, inflicting Nature damage to all players and interrupting casts for.

children.name: Stormslam
children.text: Erkhart delivers a massive blow to a player, inflicting Physical damage and Nature damage, and additionally increasing Nature damage taken by 100% for. This effect stacks.

temple-of-sethraliss.name: Temple of Sethraliss
temple-of-sethraliss.description: Centuries ago, Sethraliss, a powerful snake loa, sacrificed herself to stop Mythrax from unleashing his master upon Azeroth. After the battle, her devoted followers transported her remains and built a temple around them while they awaited her rebirth. Now, a dark force stirs within this sacred temple that seeks to twist her power towards nefarious ends.

bosses.name: Adderis and Aspix
bosses.description: A pair of powerful sethrak that are blessed by the storm and charged with guarding the temple's entrance.

tips.text:
•Storm Blessed alternates between the sethrak duo which grants damage immunity.
•Thunder and Lightning is a two part attack, the first of which inflicts damage divided evenly between players hit.
•Gale Force violently pushes players backwards.

•Tempest Winds inflict damage to players upon creation.
•Thunder and Lightning is a two part attack, the first of which inflicts damage divided evenly between players hit.
•Gale Force violently pushes players backwards.

•Overload causes Adderis to rapidly inflict additional Nature damage with each attack.
•Thunder and Lightning is a two part attack, the first of which inflicts damage divided evenly between players hit.
•Gale Force violently pushes players backwards.

bosses.overview:
Adderis is a fearsome warrior, unleashing deadly electric attacks like his twofold strike Thunder and Lightning.

Aspix is a relentless caster, creating powerful winds that damage and disrupt.

Adderis and Aspix alternate being Storm Blessed, which grants them immunity to damage.

abilities.name: Storm Blessed
abilities.text:
Adderis and Aspix call upon the power of the storm, granting them immunity to damage.

The duo will transfer this blessing between themselves as they get injured.

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.text: The loss of one partner sends the other into a wild frenzy, casting abilities with reckless abandon.

children.name: Thunder and Lightning
children.text:
Adderis dashes forward with his arcing blade, inflicting Nature damage divided evenly between all players nearby.

He then winds up a massive peal of thunder, inflicting Nature damage to all enemies nearby.

children.name: Overload
children.text: Adderis overloads with power for 8 sec, increasing his attack speed by 100% and causing each of his melee strikes to inflict 25% of their damage as additional Nature damage.

children.name: Tempest Winds
children.text:
Aspix targets players with furious winds, inflicting Nature damage to players within yards of the impacts.

These winds build over time, coalescing into tempest zones for 1 min that silence and pacify any players who contact them for 4 sec.

children.name: Gale Force
children.text: Aspix launches gale force winds at players, inflicting Nature damage and pushing them away.

children.name: Gust
children.text: Aspix blasts a player for Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

bosses.name: Merektha
bosses.description: Merektha is the product of foul experiments to produce an army of unstoppable beasts. With her clutch of eggs beginning to hatch, this mother is on the hunt for victims to serve as food for her ravenous children.

tips.text:
•Hatch releases snakes that join the fight.
•Toxic Viper's Poison Spit can be interrupted.
•A Knot of Snakes stuns allies until destroyed or incapacitated.

•Serpentstorm inflicts significant damage to all players.
•A Knot of Snakes damages allies while active.
•Burrowquake damages the party while Merektha Burrows.

•Lightning Bite inflicts significant damage to Merektha's current target.
•Storm Serpent's Storm Catalyst leaves Lingering Storm underneath the creature.
•Hatch releases snakes that join the fight.

bosses.overview: Merektha emerges and attacks players with Thunder Spit and Serpentstorm. Occasionally, she sends out Knots of Snakes to constrict players. Merektha eventually Hatches snakes that attack players while she Burrows across the playspace.

abilities.name: Hatch
abilities.text: Snakes emerge from eggs within Merektha's chamber that attack players.

children.name: Poison Spit
children.text: The Toxic Viper spits poison at a player, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Storm Catalyst
children.text: The Storm Serpent calls down a lightning strike at its location, inflicting Nature damage to all players near the impact zone and leaving behind Lingering Storm.

children.name: Lingering Storm
children.text: The pool of electricity inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Burrow
abilities.text:
Merektha burrows through the ground, inflicting Nature damage to any players caught in her path. Victims are knocked up and stunned for 4 sec.

A Burrowquake occurs while Merektha burrows.

children.name: Burrowquake
children.text: While burrowing, Merektha causes the ground to violently tremble, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 1 sec.

abilities.name: A Knot of Snakes
abilities.text:
Many small snakes wrap around the target, preventing any action and slowly suffocating the victim for Physical damage every 1 sec.

Destroying or incapacitating the knot of snakes frees the victim, causing the clump to unravel and attack players.

abilities.name: Ability
abilities.text: Merektha sinks her crackling fangs into her current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 7 sec.

abilities.name: Noxious Breath
abilities.text:
Merektha spits volatile energy at players, inflicting Nature damage and causing lightning to strike their location every 1 sec for 4 sec.

Each strike inflicts Nature damage to all players within the impact zone and leaves behind Lingering Storm.

children.name: Lingering Storm
children.text: The pool of electricity inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Serpentstorm
abilities.text:
Merektha exhales, knocking back all players and inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Storm Strikes occur across the chamber.

children.name: Storm Strikes
children.text: Lightning strikes across the chamber, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impacts.

bosses.name: Galvazzt
bosses.description: With the corruption of her temple, Sethraliss' command of lightning has created twisted elementals that roam the sunken chambers. Formed by this aberrant energy, Galvazzt seeks to grow in power by any means.

tips.text:
• Lightning Spires form at targeted locations, inflicting damage and knocking away any players struck.
•Standing between Galvazzt and his Lightning Spires prevents Galvazzt from unleashing Consume Charge.

•Standing between Galvazzt and his Lightning Spires prevents Galvazzt from unleashing Consume Charge.
•Galvanized inflicts significant damage to players.

• Lightning Spires form at targeted locations, inflicting damage and knocking away any players struck.
•Galvanized significantly increases Physical damage taken.

bosses.overview: Galvazzt attempts to accumulate energy with Lightning Spires. Players standing between Galvazzt and these spires become Galvanized, preventing energy from flowing to Galvazzt.

abilities.name: Lightning Spire
abilities.text:
Galvazzt coalesces electric energy at locations within his chamber, causing lightning strikes that inflict Nature damage to players nearby and knock them back.

A Lightning Spire forms from each strike that attempts to Energize Galvazzt. Players standing between the spire and Galvazzt become Galvanized.

children.name: Energize
children.text:
Each Lightning Spire increases the energy level of Galvazzt unless its connection with him becomes blocked.

If Galvazzt reaches 100 energy, he unleashes Consume Charge. He passively loses energy over time.

children.name: Consume Charge
children.text:
Galvazzt consumes his energy to shock all players, inflicting Nature damage and reducing their damage done by 50% for 20 sec.

Consuming the energy also grants Galvazzt a stack of Capacitance.

children.name: Capacitance
children.text: With each release of energy, Galvazzt's damage done increases by 25%.

Galvazzt's spire inflicts Nature damage every 0.5 sec but cannot Energize Galvazzt.

While afflicted, the victim takes 250% increased Physical damage.

abilities.name: Induction
abilities.text: Galvazzt releases a pulse of electric energy, inflicting Nature damage to all enemies and creating an Induction Field.

children.name: Induction Field
children.text: A static field inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec to players standing within it.

bosses.name: Avatar of Sethraliss
bosses.description: The Heart of Sethraliss is in the grips of a terrible power that seeks to corrupt her. Her avatar must be restored before this evil takes root and she is reborn as a dark loa capable of destroying the whole of Vol'dun.

tips.text:
•Defeating all Essence Defilers cleanses the Avatar of Defiling Taint.
•The Avatar consumes Corrupted Lifeforce from Corrupted Guardians once purified.
•After damaging Faithless Tormentors, the Avatar Siphons the Weak.

•The battle ends in victory once the Avatar reaches full health.
•Essence Defilers' Defiling Taint and Faithless Tormentors' Shadowlash thwart healing.
•The Avatar consumes Corrupted Lifeforce from Corrupted Guardians once purified.

•Corrupted Guardians inflict significant Physical and Shadow damage with Tainted Strike.
•The Avatar consumes Corrupted Lifeforce from Corrupted Guardians once purified.
•Essence Defilers' Defiling Taint and Faithless Tormentors' Shadowlash thwart healing.

bosses.overview: Essence Defilers arrive to channel Defiling Taint upon the Avatar of Sethraliss until their defeat. As part of their assault, Corrupted Guardians appear whose Corrupted Lifeforce can be cleansed to heal the Avatar. Upon removal of Defiling Taint, Faithless Tormentors fixate on the party's healer and attempt to strike them with Shadowlash. The battle ends once players fully restore the Avatar.

abilities.name: Stage One: Defiler's Corruption
abilities.text: Jakra'zet's allies arrive to prevent healing energy from reaching the Avatar.

children.name: Unstable Corruption
children.text: Polluted energy erupts from the Corrupted Guardian, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and forming Corrupted Lifeforce.

children.name: Corrupted Lifeforce
children.text:
Touching cleanses it, transferring Corruption to the player.

The Avatar can Consume Lifeforce once cleansed. Otherwise, a Corruption Burst occurs upon expiration of.

children.name: Corruption
children.text: The dark energy inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec, reduces healing done by 33%, and increases Physical damage taken by 250% for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Consume Lifeforce
children.text: The Avatar of Sethraliss consumes, healing herself for 2% of her maximum health and regenerating $<healAmount>% of her maximum health every 3 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Corruption Burst
children.text: Dark energy explodes from the, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and increasing damage taken from this ability by 100% for 3 sec.

children.name: Tainted Strike
children.text: The Corrupted Guardian attacks their current target with a brutal slash, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Vile Charge
children.text: The Corrupted Guardian charges to a player and strikes them, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Flame Shock
children.text: The creature sears a player with fire, inflicting Fire damage and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Latent Hex
children.text:
The creature afflicts a player for 4 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec.

Upon removal, shadowy energy inflicts Shadow damage to players within yards of the victim and releases Hex Muck.

children.name: Hex Muck
children.text: A mire of hex magic transforms players within it into a frog, rendering them unable to attack or cast spells and inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Defiling Taint
children.text: The Essence Defiler channels dark energy into the Avatar of Sethraliss, preventing all external healing.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Tormentor's Fixation
abilities.text: Faithless Tormentors attempt to disrupt the Avatar's restoration.

children.name: Shadowlash
children.text: The creature attempts to fixate upon the closest enemy healer and reduces their healing done upon striking by 5%. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Avatar of Sethraliss
abilities.text: The battle concludes upon full restoration of the Avatar of Sethraliss.

children.name: Siphon the Weak
children.text: The Avatar of Sethraliss siphons essence from Faithless Tormentors below 25% health, killing them instantly and healing for $<healAmount>% of her maximum health.

children.name: Agony of Sethraliss
children.text: The chamber of Sethraliss lashes out with an electric jolt, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact.

the-blinding-vale.name: The Blinding Vale
the-blinding-vale.description:
The Blinding Vale sprouted instantly. From within the Lightbloom, rutaani emerged and spread the Lightbloom in their wake.
After the Lightbloom's defeat in Eversong, Orweyna began surgical strikes to keep the Lightbloom in check. But the hideous glare of the Blinding Vale hides a garden where the Lightbloom cultivates new creatures and magic to drive forward their one fanatical imperative. Growth unstoppable.

bosses.name: Lightblossom Trinity
bosses.description: The Lightbloom has suffered a terrible defeat, but like the rutaani it imbues, it changes. These Lightblossomed rutaani fanatically propagate their vicious and invasive garden.

tips.text:
• Lightblossoms gain an increasing amount of Light-Gorged unless the rays of Lightblossom Beam are blocked.
• Damage taken is shared between the trio with Thicket's Trinity.

• Lightbloom Overgrowth inflicts higher damage based on applications of Light-Gorged.
• Thornblade causes random players to bleed for high damage.
• Bedrock Surge inflicts periodic damage to all players.

• Bedrock Slam creates patches of Fertile Loam near the location of the target.
• Lightblossoms gain an increasing amount of Light-Gorged unless the rays of Lightblossom Beam are blocked.

bosses.overview: The trio of Lightbloom rutaani work in tandem to sow and nurture a Lightblossom garden. Meittik creates Fertile Loam that is then planted by Lekshi's Lightsower Dash. Kezkitt rapidly germinates the flora with Lightblossom Beam until they burst in a Lightbloom Overgrowth.

abilities.name: Thicket's Trinity
abilities.text: Meittik, Lekshi, and Kezkitt are bonded, causing them to share all damage taken.

children.name: Bedrock Slam
children.text: Meittik strikes their primary target with immense force, inflicting Nature damage and Physical damage. The force of the impact ruptures nearby topsoil, creating patches of Fertile Loam.

children.name: Fertile Loam
children.text: Unearthed subsoil slows players standing within the effect by 50% and inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Bedrock Surge
children.text: The impact of Bedrock Slam causes an aftershock that inflicts Nature damage to all players every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Lightsower Dash
children.text: Lekshi dashes between patches of Fertile Loam, inflicting Holy damage to players in their path and sowing a Lightblossom at each destination.

children.name: Light-Gorged
children.text: The concentrated energy empowers the Lightblossom, increasing its damage inflicted by 50% with each application.

children.name: Lightbloom Overgrowth
children.text: The fully cultivated Lightblossom surges with energy, inflicting Holy damage to all players every 1 sec for 8 sec. Devoid of nutrients, patches of Fertile Loam wither into Light-Scorched Earth.

children.name: Light-Scorched Earth
children.text: The charred earth inflicts Holyfire damage every 1 sec to players standing within the effect.

children.name: Thornblade
children.text: Lekshi ambushes a player and backstabs them, inflicting Nature damage and causing them to bleed for Physical damage every 2 sec for 12 sec.

children.name: Fan Of Thorns
children.text: Lekshi unleashes a flurry of thorns, inflicting Nature damage to players near their location every 1 sec for 3 sec.

children.name: Lightblossom Beam
children.text:
Kezkitt channels a beam of light on each Lightblossom Seed, inflicting Holy damage every 2 sec to players standing in the effect. The powerful beam rapidly germinates the seed, applying stacks of Light-Gorged. After 8 sec, the blossom casts Lightbloom Overgrowth.

Standing within the beam stifles the seed's growth and prevents applications of Light-Gorged.

children.name: Light-Gorged
children.text: The concentrated energy empowers the Lightblossom, increasing its damage inflicted by 50% with each application.

children.name: Lightblossom Overgrowth
children.text: The fully cultivated Lightblossom surges with energy, inflicting Holy damage to all players every 1 sec for 8 sec. Devoid of nutrients, patches of Fertile Loam wither into Light-Scorched Earth.

children.name: Light-Charred Earth
children.text: The charred earth inflicts Holyfire damage every 1 sec to players standing within the effect.

children.name: Light Bolt
children.text: Kezkitt inflicts Holy damage to a player.

bosses.name: Ikuzz the Light Hunter
bosses.description: Ikuzz is a fearsome carnivore who once stalked prey throughout Harandar. Now the Light Hunter has succumbed to the overwhelming power of the Lightbloom, and his insatiable hunger serves its growth.

tips.text:
• Bloodthorn Roots immobilize players until the roots are destroyed.
• Players targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze will be Incised if Ikuzz reaches their location.

• Bloodthorn Roots immobilize players until the roots are destroyed.
• Thorncaller Roar channels Nature damage on all players.
• Players take a high amount of damage when Incised.

• Bloodthorn Roots immobilize players until the roots are destroyed.
• Players targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze will be Incised if Ikuzz reaches their location.

bosses.overview: Ikuzz entangles players in Bloodthorn Roots to immobilize his prey. At 100 energy, he fixates on a player with a Bloodthirsty Gaze and attempts to Incise them.

abilities.name: Bloodthorn Roots
abilities.text: Roots entangle players, inflicting Nature damage and rooting them in place until destroyed.

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Gaze
abilities.text: Ikuzz fixates on a player, pursuing them for 10 sec. Upon reaching their target, Ikuzz will Incise them.

children.name: Crushing Footfalls
children.text: While fixating on a target, Ikuzz's massive footfalls inflict Nature damage to players and crush any Bloodthorn Roots nearby every 1 sec.

children.name: Incise
children.text: Upon reaching its prey, Ikuzz chomps down on the player, causing them to bleed Physical damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

children.name: Crunched
children.text: The player is stunned for 5 sec after being chewed up and spit out.

abilities.name: Verdant Stomp
abilities.text: Ikuzz stomps, inflicting Physical damage to all players and knocking them back. After 4 sec, Bloodthorn Roots emerge at players' locations.

abilities.name: Thorncaller Roar
abilities.text: Ikuzz roars, inflicting Nature damage to all players while Bloodthorn Roots erupt around it every 2 sec for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Lightcrazed Frenzy
abilities.text: Ikuzz fully absorbs the power of the Lightbloom, increasing its movement speed by 20% and causing it to pulse Holy damage every 2 sec.

bosses.name: Lightwarden Ruia
bosses.description: The once-respected Rootwarden Ruia could not defeat the Lightbloom on his own. His wounded pride led him to drawing power from the Lightbloom and using it to punish all others instead of aiding his allies.

tips.text:
• Pulverizing Strikes launches a cone of Physical damage at each target.
• Lightfall inflicts high damage to players within each impact.

• Grievous Thrash is only removed when the afflicted target reaches full health.
• Pulverizing Strikes launches a cone of Physical damage at each target.

• In Moonkin form, Ruia's melee attacks are replaced with Warden's Wrath.
• Pulverizing Strikes launches a cone of Physical damage at each target.
• Lightfall inflicts high damage to players within each impact.

bosses.overview: Lightwaden Ruia unleashes his druidic power, shapeshifting between Moonkin and Bear forms. At 40% remaining health, he returns to Haranir form and channels Spirits of the Vale, casting all his abilities in a rapid flurry.

children.name: Lightfire
children.text:
Ruia shoots a beam of energy at a player, burning them for Radiant damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

Upon expiration, Lightfire Beams emerge at the afflicted player's location.

children.name: Lightfire Beams
children.text: Standing within the beams inflicts Radiant damage every 1 sec and silences players for 6 sec.

children.name: Lightfall
children.text: Ruia calls down waves of falling Light energy, inflicting Holy damage to players near the impact.

children.name: Warden's Wrath
children.text: Ruia blasts his current target with a bolt of energy, inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Pulverizing Strikes
children.text: Ruia marks several targets and launches a wave of force toward each of them in a frontal cone every 2 sec for 6 sec. Each impact inflicts Physical damage to players within the effect and applies Pulverized.

children.name: Pulverized
children.text: Upon being struck by Pulverizing Strikes, players take 100% increased damage from Pulverizing Strikes for 6 sec.

children.name: Grievous Thrash
children.text: Ruia thrashes about, inflicting Physical damage to players and causing them to bleed an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 40 sec or until fully healed. This effect stacks.

children.name: Mangling Claws
children.text: While in Bear form, Lightwarden Ruia's melee attacks inflict %1 increased damage.

children.name: Spirits of the Vale
children.text: Ruia calls upon the spirits, casting Lightfire, Lightfall, Pulverizing Strikes, and Grievous Thrash every 8 sec until he is defeated.

bosses.name: Ziekket
bosses.description: Born from the Lightbloom's epicenter, Ziekket was spawned and incubated by Light-infested rutaani to create an unstoppable engine of the Lightbloom's expansion.

tips.text:
• Concentrated Lightbeam vaporizes Dormant Lightspawn Lashers into Lightsap.
• Touching globules of Lightbloom's Essence inflicts Holy damage while increasing damage and healing done.

• Lightbloom's Essence inflicts Holy damage to players, but increases damage and healing done.
• Oozing Xylem continually inflicts Holy damage to all players.

• Thornspike impales Ziekket's current target.
• Awaken the Lightbloom summons a thicket of vicious Lightspawn Lashers.

bosses.overview:
Ziekket will periodically Awaken the Lightbloom, sprouting Lightspawn Lashers from the earth and awakening any Dormant ones.

Surging with the Light's power, Ziekket projects a Concentrated Lightbeam at players that annihilates flora and fauna alike.

abilities.name: Awaken the Lightbloom
abilities.text:
Ziekket sows Light energy into the soil, sprouting Lightspawn Lashers and reawakening any that are Dormant.

Lashers reawaken with Vicious Regrowth.

children.name: Light Shot
children.text: The lasher spews at a player, inflicting Holy damage.

children.name: Dormant
children.text: Upon reaching 1% remaining health, Lightspawn Lashers submerge themselves back into the ground, becoming unable to move and immune to player effects.

children.name: Vicious Regrowth
children.text: Lightspawn Lashers reawaken with renewed power, increasing their haste and damage done by 20%. This effect also makes them immune to interrupts and crowd controlling effects.

abilities.name: Concentrated Lightbeam
abilities.text:
Ziekket releases a powerful beam of Light energy, inflicting Holy damage every 0.5 sec to players within the effect.

Any Dormant Lightspawn Lashers hit by the beam are instantly liquified into puddles of Lightsap.

children.name: Lightsap
children.text: Viscous resin covers the ground, inflicting Holy damage every 2 sec to players standing within the effect and reducing their movement speed by 40%.

abilities.name: Lighbloom's Essence
abilities.text:
Ziekket draws out globules of Lightbloom energy from the earth that move toward him, triggering a Fluorescent Outburst upon reaching him.

The orbs instead burst when touched by players, granting that player Lightbloom's Might.

children.name: Florescent Outburst
children.text: Ziekket absorbs the Lightbloom's Essence, triggering a powerful reaction that inflicts Holy damage to all players. This effect grants Ziekket a Fluorescent Shield.

children.name: Fluorescent Shield
children.text: Ziekket becomes enveloped in Light energy, absorbing the next damage taken and increasing his damage done by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Lightbloom's Might
children.text: Players briefly borrow the power of the Lightbloom, increasing damage and healing done by 10% while suffering Holy damage every 1 sec for 12 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Thornspike
