bosses.name: Entombed Sentinels
bosses.description: The Blood and Breath of Ula'tek bar the way to Vashnik's inner sanctum. Ancient golems that long stood guard within the vaults, now corrupted by the venom of the nightmarish monster they imprisoned.

tips.text:
•Toxic Droplets sprays droplets of venom in front of the Breath of Ula'tek.
•Empowering Slam and Bloodvenom Injection increase in intensity each time they strike the same target.
•Helical Toxins is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly applications.

•Venom Coagulation creates a massive slime that uses Contaminate until it is destroyed.
•Vitriolic Stasis restores health to the weaker Sentinel until it matches the healthier Sentinel.
•Helical Toxins is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly applications.

•Blighted Blood infects players and can be dispelled.
•Helical Toxins is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly applications.
•Contaminate inflicts a high amount of damage to all players.

bosses.overview:
The Sentinel Golems of Ula'tek are filled with the caustic venoms flowing throughout the temple. The Breath of Ula'tek animates venom to destroy invaders while the Blood of Ula'tek infects players with deadly toxins.

At 100 energy the Sentinels come together to fill their venom levels with Vitriolic Stasis, restoring health to the weaker Sentinel and infecting all players with Helical Toxins.

children.name: Ula'tek's Dominance
children.text: While the Entombed Sentinels are within yards of each other, they empower each other with Ula'tek's Dominance, reducing their damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Mark of the Aolem
children.text: The Breath of Ula'tek applies its mark to players nearby every 5 sec, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Mark of the Bolem
children.text: The Blood of Ula'tek applies its mark to players nearby every 5 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Blightburn
children.text: Venom slime ejected by the Breath of Ula'tek returns to the golem after 4 sec, inflicting Nature damage to players struck.

children.name: Venom Coagulation
children.text: The Breath of Ula'tek vomits up a sticky mass of venom that animates itself into a living slime.

children.name: Contaminate
children.text: The Venom Coagulation continually radiates a contaminating essence, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 3 sec.

children.name: Toxic Droplets
children.text: The Breath of Ula'tek sprays forth many toxic droplets, which each erupt into Noxious Blast after 16 sec. Players can destroy the droplets by stepping on top of them, suffering Nature damage.

children.name: Noxious Blast
children.text: The Toxic Droplet violently explodes, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Empowering Slam
children.text: The Breath of Ula'tek slams its current target, inflicting Physical damage. Each time the golem slams the same target, it empowers itself and gains 10% additional Physical damage dealt until it slams a different target.

children.name: Vile Toxicant
children.text: Blood venom from the Blood of Ula'tek creates a toxic pool upon expiration, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within. Greater applications of blood venom create larger toxic pools.

children.name: Blighted Blood
children.text: The Blood of Ula'tek infects players with blood venom, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec for 18 sec.

children.name: Debilitating Miasma
children.text: The Blood of Ula'tek marks a player with unstable miasma. After 8 sec, the miasma erupts, inflicting Shadow damage split evenly among players nearby. This impact spreads applications of Clinging Murk among the targets struck.

children.name: Clinging Murk
children.text: Clinging blood venom inflicts Shadow damage every 2 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Injecting Strike
children.text: The Blood of Ula'tek injects its current target with a blood venom, inflicting Physical damage immediately with an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Vitriolic Homeostasis
abilities.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, both Sentinels rush together and begin to balance their fluid levels over 30 sec. This process reduces their damage taken by 99% and restores health to the weaker Sentinel until it matches the other.

children.name: Helical Toxins
children.text:
The Sentinels combine fluids to infect all players with an entangled blood venom, inflicting Plague damage every 2 sec for 28 sec.

A victim colliding with another player combines the strength of the venom. Reaching exactly applications of Helical Toxins neutralizes the venom, removing it harmlessly.

children.name: Cultivated Burst
children.text: Upon expiration, Helical Toxins erupts in a violent explosion, inflicting Plague damage to its host and an additional Plague damage every 1 sec for 1 min.

bosses.name: The Lost Explorers
bosses.description: A band of tortollans, possessed by spirits, have come to their senses near the sarcophagus of an ancient Soulcoiler. Trapped in the vault, they seek ancient artifacts to protect themselves from further possession by vengeful spirits.

tips.text:
• Frost and Fire patches left behind by Frostfire Volley can be removed by the opposing elemental effects of Burning Flames and Piercing Frost.
• Mighty Thud inflicts very high damage to all players. Each impact inflicts damage split evenly between players directly hit.
• Trader Gebbo's Explosive Surprise triggers Blast Wave, which can be avoided using the mushrooms from Mushroom Toss.

• Blink Nova inflicts high damage to all players. Players farther from Scrollsage Epu's target receive less damage.
• Icebound Flames inflicts high damage to a player if Scrollsage Epu is not interrupted, but the lingering effects can be dispelled.
• Splinters inflicts damage over time to any players who stomp on crates thrown by Trader Gebbo.

• Shredding Shards from Scrollsage Epu inflicts high magic damage and vulnerability to this effect to the current target.
• First Mate Nema's attacks against his current target gain increasing Physical damage from Steady Strikes.
• First Mate Nema grants United Defense to the tortollan explorers when Scrollsage Epu and Trader Gebbo are both near him.

bosses.overview:
Mor'zahi uses Dark Whispers to gain control over a group of tortollan explorers he has lured into the temple. If his control over them is broken, Mor'zahi casts Mor'zahi's Command, expending all of his energy to reassert control and grant the target additional abilities.

Mor'zahi inflicts deadly damage if he is allowed to finish casting Final Ascension.

Mor'zahi's concentration can be broken if a tortollan he is controlling consumes a Disgusting Fish.

children.name: Dark Whispers
children.text: Mor'zahi's dark whispers compel the target to follow his commands.

children.name: Mor'zahi's Command
children.text: Mor'zahi violently retakes control of his target, granting them additional abilities.

children.name: Evil Eyes
children.text: The statues within the chamber project spirit flames at players, inflicting Shadow damage to players within yds of the impact locations.

children.name: Malevolent Presence
children.text: Mor'zahi glows with ancient power, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec to all players.

children.name: Fishy Feedback
children.text: Mor'zahi Inflicts Shadow damage and Shadow damage every 2 sec for 12 sec to all players as his concentration is broken.

children.name: Final Ascension
children.text: Mor'zahi gathers power slowly for his final ascension. Upon channeling, he inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to all players.

children.name: Throw Junk
children.text: While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, Trader Gebbo throws crates from his inventory which inflict Physical damage to players within yds of their impact locations. Stepping on a crate breaks it, inflicting Splinters.

children.name: Disgusting Fish
children.text: A fish found within one of Trader Gebbo's boxes. Tossing it to a possessed tortollan interrupts Mor'zahi and causes him to repossess them with Mor'zahi's Command.

children.name: Splinters
children.text: Stomping on crates of junk causes the player to bleed for Physical damage every 1 sec for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Relic Rupture
children.text: The relic within the crate ruptures with necrotic energy if left untouched after 25 sec, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Mushroom Toss
children.text: Trader Gebbo tosses Bouncy Mushrooms at players' locations. Bouncy Mushrooms bounce players high into the air when touched.

children.name: Bouncy Mushroom
children.text: Jumping on a Bouncy Mushroom will bounce a player high into the air but will perturb the mushroom, triggering Fungal Burst soon after.

children.name: Bounce
children.text: A Bouncy Mushroom bounces a player high into the air.

children.name: Fungal Burst
children.text: A perturbed mushroom bursts after a short delay, inflicting Nature damage to players within yds.

children.name: Explosive Surprise
children.text: Trader Gebbo tosses a bomb to the location of a player which inflicts Physical damage to players within yds on impact.

children.name: Concussive Blast
children.text: The Concussion Bomb explodes, inflicting Fire damage and knocking back players within yds. Players affected suffer Fire damage every 1 sec for 12 sec.

children.name: Blast Wave
children.text: A shockwave from an Explosive Bomb inflicts Fire damage and Fire damage every 1 sec for 10 sec to players it contacts.

children.name: Spreading Flames
children.text: Fire spreads across a large area and inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Smashing Shovel
children.text: When one of his allies is defeated, Trader Gebbo wields a shovel which inflicts an additional Physical damage and knocks players back with each strike.

children.name: Frostfire Volley
children.text:
While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, Scrollsage Epu unleashes a volley of elemental missiles at several targets, inflicting Fire or Frost damage to players within yds of the targets and afflicting them with Burning Flames or Piercing Frost.

Each missile leaves behind a patch of elemental ground at its impact location.

These impacts trigger Elemental Explosion if they strike any player afflicted by Burning Flames or Piercing Frost.

children.name: Elemental Explosion
children.text: The volatile elemental interaction inflicts Frostfire damage to all players.

children.name: Burning Flames
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage every sec for 1 min or until cancelled by a Frost effect.

children.name: Fire Patch
children.text:
Inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within 5 yds.

Frost effects will dissipate this patch.

children.name: Piercing Frost
children.text: Inflicts Frost damage every 1 sec and reduces the target's movement speed by 10% for 1 min or until cancelled by a Fire effect.

children.name: Frost Patch
children.text:
Inflicts Frost damage every 1 sec to players within 5 yds.

Fire effects will dissipate this effect.

children.name: Blink Nova
children.text: Scrollsage Epu gathers arcane power and teleports to the location of a player, inflicting Arcane damage to all players. Players farther from Scrollsage Epu's target receive less damage.

children.name: Icebound Flames
children.text: Scrollsage Epu blasts a player with elemental magic, inflicting Frostfire damage along with Frostfire damage every 1 sec while reducing their movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

children.name: Shredding Shards
children.text:
Scrollsage Epu projects a series of ice shards at her current target, inflicting Frost damage every sec for 3.5 sec.

Each shard increases the target's damage taken from Shredding Shards for 80 sec.

children.name: Cataclysmic Invocation
children.text: When one of her allies is defeated, Scrollsage Epu unleashes a massive explosion, inflicting Fire damage to all players. This damage increases with each cast.

children.name: United Defense
children.text: First Mate Nema, Scrollsage Epu, and Trader Gebbo reduce the incoming damage they take by 99% while they are within 30 yds of each other.

children.name: Mighty Thud
children.text:
While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, First Mate Nema marks three players then leaps to each of their locations.

Each impact inflicts Physical damage split evenly among players within yds and knocks them back.

If Mighty Thud fails to hit a player, it inflicts Physical damage to all players.

children.name: Aftershock
children.text: Mighty Thud leaves behind quaking ground that inflicts Physical damage to players within yds every 1 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Shell Spin
children.text: First Mate Nema hurls three spinning shells in a cone in front of him. The shells will stun players they come into contact with for 4 sec.

children.name: Steady Strikes
children.text: First Mate Nema gains 4% Physical damage to his current target with each attack, lasting 30 sec.

children.name: Relentless Escalation
children.text: When one of his allies is defeated, First Mate Nema gains 100% increased damage every 1 sec for sec.

bosses.name: Vashnik the Malignant
bosses.description: Within The Chamber of Virulence, Vashnik the Malignant distills Ula'tek's venoms into ever more lethal forms. The creature lurks in its noxious chamber, brewing foul toxins to empower its brood.

tips.text:
• Imbibe creates living venom from two nearby fountains.

• Living venoms explode in Malignant Bursts unless destroyed.

• The initial Clotting Venom is protected by Sanguineous Fortitude.

• Imbibe inflicts heavy damage to all players.

• Vashnik's chamber fills with increasing Toxic Vapor each time he Imbibes.

• Siphoning Infection absorbs a large amount of incoming healing.

• Dripping Fangs inflicts increasing damage over time.

• Imbibe infuses Vashnik with the power of two nearby fountains.

bosses.overview:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Vashnik Imbibes from the nearest two fountains, increasing his affinity to them. These fountains erupt with vapor, bringing forth living venoms that crawl toward the Malignant Cavity in the center of the chamber.

Should a living venom reach its destination, a Malignant Burst occurs.

abilities.name: Imbibe
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, Imbibe conjures Malignant Totem's from the venomous fountains.

children.name: Blood Infusion
children.text:
Vashnik empowers himself with blood venom, bolstering his next cast of Imbibe.

Increases the damage of Hemo Expulsion by 100% and the maximum health of Clotting Venoms by 50% for 90 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Hemo Expulsion
children.text: Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Blood, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Sanguineous Fortitude
children.text: Clotting Venom is fortified as it emerges, protecting it from crowd control effects until destroyed.

children.name: Splitting Clot
children.text: Clotting Venom splits upon dying, creating smaller Clotting Venom.

children.name: Shadow Infusion
children.text:
Vashnik empowers himself with shadow venom, bolstering his next cast of Imbibe.

Increases the damage of Gloom Expulsion by 100% and the maximum health of Shrouded Venoms by 50% for 90 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Gloom Expulsion
children.text: Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Shadow, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Miasmic Coating
children.text: Shrouded Venom is protected by a Miasmic Coating that absorbs 100% of its max health in damage.

children.name: Umbral Ejection
children.text: Shrouded Venoms burst when destroyed, spraying shadow venom that inflicts Shadow damage to players near its impact locations.

children.name: Flame Infusion
children.text:
Vashnik empowers himself with flame venom, bolstering his next cast of Imbibe.

Increases the damage of Conflagrating Expulsion by 100% and the maximum health of Burning Venoms by 50% for 90 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Conflagrating Expulsion
children.text: Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Flame, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Burning Presence
children.text: Burning Venom pulses with flame, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 3 sec.

children.name: Caustic Surge
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Caustic Surge inflicts damage over time, and multiple applications stack.

children.name: Hardened Venom
children.text: The venom hardens after sixty seconds, and becomes immune to crowd control effects, and gains 50% increased movement speed.

children.name: Toxic Vapor
children.text: Toxic vapor fills the dank air of the chamber, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Malignant Burst
children.text: Living venoms burst upon reaching the Malignant Cavity, inflicting Nature damage to all players and an additional Nature damage every 3 sec for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Malignant Catalyst
abilities.text: Vashnik congeals an orb of venom above the Malignant Cavity and then explodes it, inflicting Nature damage to all players and launching Catalytic Bile.

children.name: Catalytic Bile
children.text:
A toxic spray that inflicts Nature damage to players near the impact locations. 

If Catalytic Bile fails to hit at least one player, Nature damage is inflicted to all players instead.

abilities.name: Plague Froth
abilities.text: Vashnik coats his victims in a corrosive venom that inflicts Plague damage to players nearby every 1 sec for 6 sec. When the aura expires, Plague Waves erupt from the target in cardinal directions.

children.name: Plague Wave
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Plague Waves destroy Malignant Tumors.

abilities.name: Dripping Fangs
abilities.text: Vashnik bites into his current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Nature damage every 2 sec for 32 sec. Increases Physical damage taken by 100%. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Adaptive Infection
abilities.text: Vashnik infects several players with toxins, according to his current infusions.

children.name: Siphoning Infection
children.text:
Vashnik infects several players with a blood venom that inflicts Shadow damage every 1.5 sec and absorbs the next healing.

While the infection lasts, healing received is reduced by 100%, and the target periodically casts Siphon Blood to nearby players.

children.name: Siphon Blood
children.text: Inflicting Shadow damage to nearby allies, and healing for each ally hit every 1.5 sec.

children.name: Exploding Infection
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, this gains a stack every 1.5 sec until dispelled.

children.name: Caustic Explosion
children.text: The infected player explodes, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Stygian Infection
children.text: Vashnik infects several players with a shadow venom that inflicts Shadow damage every 1.5 sec and absorbs the next healing. While the infection lasts, the infected player periodically casts Stygian Burst.

children.name: Stygian Burst
children.text: An eruption of dark venom that inflicts Shadow damage to players near the impact location.

bosses.name: Sszorak
bosses.description: A horrifying creature, warped by Ula'tek's toxic venom, Sszorak is a brutal instrument of vengeance. Calling upon the winds that howl deep within Atal'Utek, it tears apart any living creature it encounters.

tips.text:
•Venomous Surge inflicts raid-wide damage. Players farther from the affected player receive less damage.
•Raging Crosswinds inflicts damage over time before knocking affected players in the indicated direction.
•Dig In increases Sszorak's damage taken during Howling Maelstrom.

•Venomous Surge inflicts raid-wide damage. Players farther from the affected player receive less damage.
•Raging Crosswinds inflicts damage over time before knocking affected players in the indicated direction.
•When the winds in the Altar of Six Winds build to a Howling Maelstrom, players are pushed in the wind's direction.

•During Apex Predator, Sszorak casts a combination of Ravage and Mutilate.
•Corroding Venom increases Physical damage taken. This effect stacks.
•When the winds in the Altar of Six Winds build to a Howling Maelstrom, players are pushed in the wind's direction.

bosses.overview: Sszorak relentlessly assaults players with Apex Predator combination attacks and noxious Venomous Surge globs. The Altar of the Six Winds unleashes Raging Crosswinds and eventually builds to a massive Howling Maelstrom that pushes players around the arena.

abilities.name: Howling Maelstrom
abilities.text: The Altar of the Six Winds unleashes a succession of gales across the arena. Each gale pushes players in its indicated direction.

children.name: Dig In
children.text: Sszorak hunkers down during Howling Maelstrom, increasing his damage taken by 30% for 25 sec.

abilities.name: Apex Predator
abilities.text: Sszorak executes multiple attacks in rapid succession. Taunt effects can change his current target while casting.

children.name: Ravage
children.text: Sszorak slashes repeatedly, inflicting Physical damage to all players in a frontal cone and increasing their damage taken from Ravage by 300% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Mutilate
children.text:
Sszorak rakes his venom-coated claws in a frontal cone, inflicting Nature damage split evenly among players struck and afflicting them with Mutilated Gash.

If Mutilate strikes or fewer players, it inflicts deadly damage.

children.name: Mutilated Gash
children.text: Players struck by Mutilate are lacerated with toxic wounds, suffering Nature damage every 1 sec for 22 sec. This effect is split evenly among players struck.

children.name: Tempest
children.text: Sszorak forms vortices of poisonous wind which spiral around the arena. These inflict Nature damage plus an additional Nature damage every 1 sec and reduce movement speed by 30% for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Venomous Surge
abilities.text:
Sszorak heaves fresh venom onto several players, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

Upon expiration, the venom detonates forming a Viscous Cyst and inflicting Nature damage to all players, decreasing in damage as distance increases.

children.name: Viscous Cyst
children.text:
A glob of unstable toxin forms for 2 min. Upon contact or expiration, the glob bursts, knocking all players away and inflicting Nature damage. The toxin then inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec and reduces movement speed by 30% for 5 sec. This effect stacks.

The toxins cling to players, allowing them to better adhere to the ground while it persists.

children.name: Caustic Claws
children.text: Sszorak flings toxin from his claws, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact.

abilities.name: Raging Crosswinds
abilities.text:
The Altar of the Six Winds imbues several players with roiling winds, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Upon expiration, the winds inflict Nature damage to players nearby. The winds then knock each affected player in the indicated direction and apply Turbulent Gusts.

children.name: Turbulent Gusts
children.text: Turbulent winds hold the target aloft, reducing their falling speed for 10 sec. Contacting another player affected by Turbulent Gusts causes the winds to dissipate.

abilities.name: Corroding Venom
abilities.text: Sszorak's venom-laced claws corrode his target's armor, causing melee attacks to increase Physical damage taken by the target by 3% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Ula'tek's Presence
abilities.text: The Altar of the Six Winds emits a caustic mist, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec.

bosses.name: The Twin Fangs
bosses.description: The first of Ula'tek's blood, Vexhul and Ithraz brood beneath a roiling sea of venom deep within the vault of Atal'Utek. Any foolish enough to enter the prison's inner chamber risk their monstrous jaws and toxic strikes.

tips.text:
•Caustic Deluge ejects a salvo of globules which afflict players with Eternal Venom when touched.

•Venomous Emergence summons Spawns of Vexhul which will continuously target players with Corrosive Spit.

•Caustic Deluge ejects a salvo of globules which afflict players with Eternal Venom when touched.

•Venomous Emergence summons Spawns of Vexhul which will continuously target players with Corrosive Spit.

•Caustic Globules form near the Caustic Deluge target.

•If Stone Breaker strikes no players, it instead strikes all players.

bosses.overview:
The Twin Fangs' Eternal Venom accumulates throughout the battle. Vexhul funnels toxin into her target with Caustic Deluge forming Caustic Globules and calls her progeny with Venomous Emergence. Ithraz consumes players with Ravenous Feast and strikes repeatedly with Stone Breaker.

At 100 energy, both serpents submerge and reposition before attacking together. Vexhul releases a Vile Flood while Ithraz spews globs of gore during Sanguine Storm.

abilities.name: Eternal Venom
abilities.text:
Being struck by some abilities causes an everlasting venom to course through the target's veins, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon reaching applications, the target suffers 85% of their maximum health as Nature damage and is stunned for 8 sec.

children.name: Caustic Deluge
children.text:
Vexhul funnels toxin into her current target for 5 sec, inflicting Nature damage every 0.5 sec and ejecting acid nearby.

Each acid splash inflicts Nature damage and applies Eternal Venom to players nearby, forming a Caustic Globule at the impact location.

children.name: Caustic Globule
children.text:
An acidic globule forms and ruptures after 10 sec, inflicting Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to all players.

Upon contact, the globule instead only affects that player.

children.name: Envenomed
children.text: Caustic Deluge damage increases damage taken from Caustic Deluge by 10% for 90 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Venomous Emergence
children.text: Vexhul calls her progeny from the churning sea, inflicting Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to all players.

children.name: Corrosive Spit
children.text: The spawn focuses on a player and spews toxin in a frontal line, inflicting Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to players struck.

children.name: Stir the Depths
children.text:
Vexhul thrashes and churns the surrounding sea of venom for 6 sec, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec and forming waves.

The waves travel across the platform, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec and applying Eternal Venom to players struck.

children.name: Vile Flood
children.text: Vexhul channels a continuous torrent of toxin in a frontal direction for 14 sec, inflicting Nature damage every 0.5 sec and applying Eternal Venom to players struck.

children.name: Concentrated Spittle
children.text: Vexhul pelts her current target with spittle if they are out of range, inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Ravenous Feast
children.text:
Ithraz attempts to consume players times in quick succession. Each strike inflicts Physical damage split evenly among players nearby.

Ithraz consumes:applications; of Eternal Venom from players struck, applying Feasted to them.

If Ravenous Feast fails to hit at least:targets; all players suffer the full effect.

children.name: Feasted
children.text: Prevents Ithraz from consuming further applications of Eternal Venom from this player.

children.name: Coiling Ichor
children.text:
Ithraz infuses several players with vile ichor, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby every 1 sec for 12 sec. Over time, the ichor inflicts increasing damage as it shrinks in area.

Upon expiration, the ichor forms a pool of Congealed Gore.

children.name: Congealed Gore
children.text: A pool of thick gore persists for 2 min, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing the movement speed of players within by 50%.

children.name: Stone Breaker
children.text:
Ithraz roars, pushing players away. He then slams the platform repeatedly. Each impact inflicts Physical damage to players nearby and increases their damage taken from Stone Breaker by 33% for 90 sec. This effect stacks.

If no players are struck, Ithraz instead inflicts Physical damage to all players and knocks them away. This effect ignores armor.

children.name: Sanguine Storm
children.text: Ithraz showers the platform with globs of gore for 18 sec. Each impact inflicts Shadow damage to players nearby.

children.name: Congealed Gore
children.text: A pool of thick gore persists for 6 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing the movement speed of players within by 50%.

children.name: Clotted Bolt
children.text: Ithraz lances his current target with gore if they are out of range, inflicting Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: The Twin Fangs submerge, showering the nearby area with venom that inflicts Nature damage to players near each impact and forming a Noxious Slick.

children.name: Noxious Slick
children.text: A slick of noxious fluid coats the platform, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage taken of players within by 30%.

abilities.name: Toxic Fumes
abilities.text: The Twin Fangs suffuse the air with toxic fumes, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec.

abilities.name: Uncoiled Wrath
abilities.text: When Vexhul or Ithraz dies, the surviving serpent enters a vengeful rage and gains 10% increased damage every 3 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: The Coiled Altar
bosses.description: The spirit of Malacrass will not release his grip on Zul'jan so easily. At the Coiled Altar, the shaman commands the warrior to enact the final ritual to unleash Ula'tek on the Amani--for revenge, and to gain their promised reward.

tips.text:
• Toxic Deluge creates Coalesced Venom around the arena.
• Freeing players possessed by Dreadmarch creates Manifestations of Dread that fixate on a random player.
• Eternal Nightfall inflicts deadly damage unless Veil of Twilight is broken.

• Fangs of the Coiled Altar and Defilement of the Coiled Altar inflict massive damage and healing absorbs to all players.
• Coalesced Venom explode into a Venom Rupture when destroyed.
• Venomfang and Gloombomb inflict heavy damage.

• Sever inflicts a massive amount of damage, destroying Coalesced Venom.
• Soul Sever afflicts players hit with Gravebound and destroys Manifestations of Dread.
• Corrupted Toxin inflicts stacking moderate damage.

bosses.overview:
A mutated Zul'jan unleashes his new power by Coalescing Venom within The Coiled Altar. He wields twin axes that Sever players and destroy Coalesced Venom.

Upon Zul'jan's defeat, Malacrass joins the fray. Malacrass haunts players with Dreadmarch, creating Manifestations of Dread as it resolves. His casts of Soul Sever hurt players and destroy any Manifestations of Dread in its blast.

Upon defeat, Malacrass begins a ritual of Soulbinding to revive Zul'jan as his puppet, and claim what is rightfully his.

children.name: Fangs of the Coiled Altar
children.text:
Zul'jan channels the power of The Coiled Altar, inflicting Nature damage to all players and gaining applications of Twinfang Toxin every 1 sec for 8 sec.

The mouths of The Coiled Altar overflow, spewing Noxious Ground beneath them that quickly swell and slowly subside over time.

children.name: Twinfang Toxin
children.text: Zul'jan's melee attacks consume applications of Twinfang Toxin, inflicting an additional Nature damage to his current target.

children.name: Noxious Ground
children.text: The poisonous ground inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec to players standing within.

children.name: Toxic Deluge
children.text: The crucible spews venom into the chamber, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact locations, and creating Coalesced Venom.

children.name: Coalesced Venom
children.text:
A toxic globule that pulses with venom, inflicting Nature damage to all players every sec. Triggers a Venom Rupture when destroyed.

Stepping on the globule attaches itself to the player, applying Volatile Venom.

children.name: Venom Rupture
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Venom Rupture inflicts damage over time and now stacks.

children.name: Volatile Venom
children.text:
Ula'tek's venom reacts violently to the player, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players nearby for 5 sec.

Upon expiring, creates a Coalesced Venom.

children.name: Toxic Deluge
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, one Coalesced Venom mutates into a Virulent Cyst.

children.name: Coalesced Venom
children.text:
A toxic globule that pulses with venom, inflicting Nature damage to all players every sec. Triggers a Venom Rupture when destroyed.

Stepping on the globule attaches itself to the player, applying Volatile Venom.

children.name: Venom Rupture
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Venom Rupture inflicts damage over time and now stacks.

children.name: Volatile Venom
children.text:
Ula'tek's venom reacts violently to the player, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players nearby for 5 sec.

Upon expiring, creates a Coalesced Venom.

children.name: Virulent Cyst
children.text: Ulatek's venom mutates into a physical form.

children.name: Caustic Secretion
children.text: The cyst expels Coalesced Venoms every 6 sec, inflicting Nature damage to players near each impact point.

children.name: Toxic Deluge
children.text: The crucible spews venom into the chamber, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact locations, and creating Coalesced Venom.

children.name: Coalesced Venom
children.text:
A toxic globule that pulses with venom, inflicting Nature damage to all players every sec. Triggers a Venom Rupture when destroyed.

Stepping on the globule attaches itself to the player, applying Volatile Venom.

children.name: Venom Rupture
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Venom Rupture inflicts damage over time and now stacks.

children.name: Volatile Venom
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Volatile Venom applies Tainted Blood on expiration.

children.name: Tainted Blood
children.text: The venom enters your bloodstream, increasing damage taken from Volatile Venom by 200% for 10 sec.

children.name: Guillotine
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Guillotine increases damage taken by Guillotine by 500%.

children.name: Execution
children.text: Inflicts Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Widow's Kiss
children.text: The axe erupts in a violent plume that scatters a deadly toxin, inflicting Nature to damage to players nearby.

children.name: Widow's Touch
children.text: The nearby explosion inflicts Nature damage to players at least yards away from the epicenter.

children.name: Guillotine
children.text:
Zul'jan throws his axe at a player, inflicting Physical damage split evenly among players near the target. This effect ignores armor. The axe then swells with poison before erupting with a Widow's Kiss.

If Guillotine fails to hit at least players, the axe instead inflicts an Execution.

children.name: Guillotined
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Guillotined is permanent.

children.name: Execution
children.text: Inflicts Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Widow's Kiss
children.text: The axe erupts in a violent plume that scatters a deadly toxin, inflicting Nature to damage to players nearby.

children.name: Widow's Touch
children.text: The nearby explosion inflicts Nature damage to players at least yards away from the epicenter.

children.name: Sever
children.text:
Zul'jan unleashes a mighty cleave at his current target, inflicting Physical damage to players in a frontal cone and increasing their damage taken from Sever by 200% for 33 sec.

Destroys Coalesced Venoms.

children.name: Venomfang
children.text: Zul'jan hurls a poison-coated axe between multiple players, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 14 sec.

children.name: Axegrinder
children.text: Zul'jan hurls out axes that inflict Physical damage to players near each impact point, knocking them away. The axes wander the arena for 1 min, inflicting Physical damage every 0.sec to players nearby. This effect ignores armor.

children.name: Axegrinder
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Axegrinders no longer despawn.

children.name: Dreadmarch
children.text:
Malacrass possesses multiple players, causing them to absorb damage as they march towards the edge of the platform and jump to their death.

Upon removal, Manifestations of Dread emerge from the possessed player.

children.name: Manifestation of Dread
children.text: A terrifying manifestation that fixates on a single player.

children.name: Unnerving Fixation
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Manifestations of Dread apply Dreadmarch upon reaching their target.

children.name: Soul Sever
children.text:
Malacrass unleashes a blast of shadow energy at his current target, inflicting Shadow damage to players in a frontal cone. Increases their damage taken from Soul Sever by 200% and inflicts Shadow damage every 2 sec for 45 sec. Players hit are afflicted with Gravebound.

bosses.name: Ula'tek
bosses.description: The great shame of the Amani empire. The vast complex of Atal'Utek was created to imprison the weapon that proved to be as much of a threat as the enemy she was intended to destroy. Ula'tek has risen from her ancient slumber and threatens all of Azeroth if she should escape.

tips.text:
• Blightscale Spawn hatch a Blightscale Viper when they connect with venom.
• A Blightscale Clutch grows in power unless destroyed.
• Doomscale Wardens use Writhing Gestation on nearby Blightscale Spawn.

• Every Blightscale Viper hatched inflicts Putrid Membrane to all players.
• Spectral Coils inflicts damage to everyone that is reduced by the number of players at the impact location.

• Ula'tek uses Unchecked Rage while not engaged in melee combat.
• Ula'tek's Gore Rattle uses Rattler Slam while not engaged in melee combat.
•Mother's Wrath inflicts damage to everyone while no one is in its area of effect.

bosses.overview:
Ula'tek splashes venom across her platform with Caustic Waves. Any Blightscale Spawn that touch her venom hatches and covers players in a Putrid Membrane. While her slithering children continue to spawn, Ula'tek uses her Spectral Coils to shatter the space.

After Ula'tek rails against her prison with Rage of the Shackled she summons her faithful then dives beneath the venom to gather her strength. Ula'tek's Doomscale Wardens move between the Blightscale Spawn imbuing them with Writhing Gestation as the Doomscale Eggs begin to hatch.

With her progeny broken, Ula'tek shatters the arena. She continues to use Call of the Serpent to gather her forces while destroying the only safe spaces remaining with Circling Prey.

abilities.name: Blightscale Spawn
abilities.text: The endless spawn of Ula'tek. These eggs go through rapid gestation and hatch whenever they come into contact with the venom that fills Ula'tek's prison.

children.name: Malignant Shell
children.text: Ula'tek's eggs are covered in a viscous shell that sticks to players who touch them, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec while attached.

children.name: Putrid Membrane
children.text: When Ula'tek's eggs hatch a, they spray a membrane over all players that inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Blightscale Rawling

Broken from their shells early, the Blightscale Rawling struggles to survive.

children.name: Poisonous Bite

children.name: Blightscale Viper

children.name: Petrifying Sting

Waves that connect with Ula'tek's eggs cause them to instantly hatch.

If her current target is outside her reach, Ula'tek inflicts these effects on all players.

On Heroic difficulty, Ula'tek casts Soul Constrictor on players that mitigate Spectral Coil's damage.

children.name: Necrotic Vapors

children.text: All aspects of Ula'tek's form share damage taken.

Flying into this rage exposes Ula'tek's Venomous Heart.

children.name: Venomous Heart

children.name: Unchecked Rage
children.text: If Ula'tek is unable to melee a nearby player when she is not casting or channeling, she inflicts Physical damage to all players.

mythic.name: The Venomous Abyss
mythic.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. As the monster's power grows, Zul'jarra calls upon the Champions of Azeroth to descend into the Vaults of Atal'Utek to stop her brother before the weapon is unleashed upon Azeroth.

bosses.name: Nek'zali the Soulcoiler
bosses.description: Long ago, the shadow hunter Nek'zali and her followers were entombed for the blasphemous act of summoning Ula'tek. Restored by the very power she unleashed, she calls the other Soulcoilers from their tombs to serve her once more.

tips.text:
• Essence Rend lingers and leaves behind a Latent Cultist upon expiration.
• Restless Amani awaken from the sarcophagi on the outer edges of the room, empowered with Gravebound Advance until they are destroyed.
• Echoes of Jawae awaken during Soul Transfer and provide Nek'zali with Tether of Awakening.

• Essence Rend lingers and leaves behind a Latent Cultist upon expiration.
• Soulcoil Ignition inflicts significant damage to all players.
• Soulcoil Rite inflicts deadly damage if too many souls enter the|Hspell:1284032|h [Soulcoil Well]|h.

• Possession Barrage inflicts damage based on the distance each barrage travels.
• Echoes of Jawae awaken during Soul Transfer and provide Nek'zali with Tether of Awakening.
• Nek'zali attacks her target with Hollowing Strikes.

bosses.overview:
As Nek'zali energizes the Soulcoil Well by invoking the Soulcoil Rite, she provokes the Restless Amani to the well.

Upon reaching 50% health, Nek'zali retreats to begin the Ritual of Awakening. Destroying Echoes of Jawae removes their Tethers of Awakening and draws her back.

Upon reaching full energy, she unwinds the Soulcoil and begins Uncoiling, empowering her with new abilities until her defeat.

children.name: Soulcoil Well
children.text:
A well of necrotic energy used to raise the cult of the Soulcoilers. Any that reach the well trigger a Soulcoil Rite.

Standing in the well inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec. Players who die within the well are Soulcoiled.

children.name: Soulcoil Rite
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, the rite's power afflicts players with |Hspell:1297624|h[Ritual Burn]

children.name: Ritual Burn
children.text: Increases damage taken from Soulcoil Rite by 15% for 1 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Uncoiled Rage
children.text: Upon reaching full energy, Nek'zali gains her full potential, increasing her attack and movement speeds by 150% and all damage by 500%. Additionally, grants immunity to Taunt effects.

children.name: Soulcoiled
children.text: Nek'zali claims a player's soul, compelling them towards the Soulcoil Well. The target is sacrificed upon reaching its waters, triggering Soulcoil Rite.

children.name: Soulcoil Ignition
children.text: Nek'zali stirs the Soulcoil Well, invoking the Soulcoil Rite every 1 sec for 4 sec. During the channel, Anguished Echoes emerge from the well.

children.name: Anguished Echoes
children.text: An anguished spirit emerges, inflicting Shadow damage to players near its impact location and knocking them away.

children.name: Essence Rend
children.text:
Nek'zali entraps several players, pulling them in for 5 sec before knocking them away and inflicting Shadow damage.

A ghostly essence remains, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. Upon removal, a Latent Cultist emerges at the player's location.

children.name: Latent Cultist
children.text: A cultist's spirit materializes, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby. Necrotic energy clings to the spirit, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing movement speed of players standing within it by 40%.

children.name: Restless Amani
children.text:
Ancient spirits return to their corpses, and make their way towards the Soulcoil Well.

 On Heroic difficulty, Raised Amani corpses remain on the ground upon defeat as Vessels of Awakening.

children.name: Vessel of Awakening
children.text: A corpse lingers on the ground to be repossessed by while the Ritual of Awakening is active. Reawakened Amani become empowered, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

children.name: Gravebound Advance
children.text: Restless Amani are protected by a necrotic barrier, absorbing magic damage equal to 25% of their maximum health. While the barrier holds, the Restless Amani cannot be destroyed and fixate on the Soulcoil Well.

children.name: Corpse Blight
children.text: Restless Amani erupt in necrosis, inflicting Plague damage to all players and an additional Plague damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Possession Barrage
children.text: Nek'zali launches spectral echoes in the direction of her primary target that burst on impact, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. This damage is reduced the farther each echo travels.

children.name: Hollowing Strikes
children.text: Nek'zali's melee attacks tear away a part of the target's soul, inflicting Shadow damage every 3 sec and reducing healing and absorption effects received by 5% for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Intermission: Ritual of Awakening
abilities.text: Upon reaching 50% health, Nek'zali retreats to the Soulcoil Well and summons an Echo of Jawae that protects her from harm.

children.name: Echo of Jawae
children.text: A spectral echo that protects Nek'zali from harm. Defeating an Echo of Jawae severs their Tether of Awakening.

children.name: Soul Transfer
children.text: Jawae transfers her essence to an Echo of Jawae over sec. A surge of soul energy then inflicts Shadow damage to players caught in the blast.

children.name: Tether of Awakening
children.text: Tethered to the Soulcoil Well, gaining immunity to all damage.

children.name: Hungering Pyre
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Slithering Flame combusts into Cremation upon expiration.

children.name: Slithering Flame
children.text: A serpentine flame slithers to a player and ignites, inflicting Fire damage and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

children.name: Cremation
children.text: The flames explode, incinerating corpses and Restless Amani nearby. Inflicts Fire damage to players and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

children.name: Grasping Depths
children.text: A Drowned Echo awakens within the well, periodically pulling players towards the well and inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to all players until it is defeated. Players may enter the well while the echo lives, and are marked with Soul Exhaustion upon leaving.

children.name: Immortal Coil
children.text: Necrotic energy within the well inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Soulcoiler's Curse
children.text: The Drowned Echo coils around all players within the well, ejecting them and leaving them Soulcoiled.

children.name: Soulcoiled
children.text: Nek'zali claims a player's soul, compelling them towards the Soulcoil Well. The target is sacrificed upon reaching its waters, triggering Soulcoil Rite.

children.name: Swirling Spirit
children.text: Spirits swirl within the Soulcoil Well, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec on contact. This effect stacks.

children.name: Soul Exhaustion
children.text: The Soulcoil Well marks those who leave it, increasing damage taken from Soulcoil Well and Immortal Coil by 300%.

children.name: Restless Amani
children.text:
Ancient spirits return to their corpses, and make their way towards the Soulcoil Well.

 On Heroic difficulty, Raised Amani corpses remain on the ground upon defeat as Vessels of Awakening.

children.name: Vessel of Awakening
children.text: A corpse lingers on the ground to be repossessed by while the Ritual of Awakening is active. Reawakened Amani become empowered, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

children.name: Gravebound Advance
children.text: Restless Amani are protected by a necrotic barrier, absorbing magic damage equal to 25% of their maximum health. While the barrier holds, the Restless Amani cannot be destroyed and fixate on the Soulcoil Well.

children.name: Corpse Blight
children.text: Restless Amani erupt in necrosis, inflicting Plague damage to all players and an additional Plague damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Uncoiling
abilities.text: Nek'zali uncoils the Soulcoil Well, gaining new abilities until defeated.

children.name: Uncoiling
children.text: Nek'zali pours all her power into the Soulcoil Well, causing it to overflow, energizing her and inflicting Shadow damage every 0.8 sec until she is defeated.

children.name: Uncoiled Rage
children.text: Upon reaching full energy, Nek'zali gains her full potential, increasing her attack and movement speeds by 150% and all damage by 500%. Additionally, grants immunity to Taunt effects.

children.name: Invoke
children.text: On Mythic Difficulty, interrupts all spell casts and silences interrupting players for 3 sec.

children.name: Latent Cultist
children.text: A cultist's spirit materializes, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby. Necrotic energy clings to the spirit, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing movement speed of players standing within it by 40%.

children.name: Entwined Step
children.text: Latent Cultists reenact an ancient ritual, repositioning around the Soulcoil Well.

children.name: Soulcoil Rite
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, the rite's power afflicts players with |Hspell:1297624|h[Ritual Burn]

children.name: Ritual Burn
children.text: Increases damage taken from Soulcoil Rite by 15% for 1 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Soulcoil Well
children.text:
A well of necrotic energy used to raise the cult of the Soulcoilers. Any that reach the well trigger a Soulcoil Rite.

Standing in the well inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec. Players who die within the well are Soulcoiled.

children.name: Soulcoiled
children.text: Nek'zali claims a player's soul, compelling them towards the Soulcoil Well. The target is sacrificed upon reaching its waters, triggering Soulcoil Rite.

children.name: Essence Rend
children.text:
Nek'zali entraps several players, pulling them in for 5 sec before knocking them away and inflicting Shadow damage.

A ghostly essence remains, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. Upon removal, a Latent Cultist emerges at the player's location.

children.name: Latent Cultist
children.text: A cultist's spirit materializes, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby. Necrotic energy clings to the spirit, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing movement speed of players standing within it by 40%.

children.name: Hollowing Strikes
children.text: Nek'zali's melee attacks tear away a part of the target's soul, inflicting Shadow damage every 3 sec and reducing healing and absorption effects received by 5% for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Possession Barrage
children.text: Nek'zali launches spectral echoes in the direction of her primary target that burst on impact, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. This damage is reduced the farther each echo travels.

bosses.name: Entombed Sentinels
bosses.description: The Blood and Breath of Ula'tek bar the way to Vashnik's inner sanctum. Ancient golems that long stood guard within the vaults, now corrupted by the venom of the nightmarish monster they imprisoned.

tips.text:
•Toxic Droplets sprays droplets of venom in front of the Breath of Ula'tek.
•Empowering Slam and Bloodvenom Injection increase in intensity each time they strike the same target.
•Helical Toxins is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly applications.

•Venom Coagulation creates a massive slime that uses Contaminate until it is destroyed.
•Vitriolic Stasis restores health to the weaker Sentinel until it matches the healthier Sentinel.
•Helical Toxins is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly applications.

•Blighted Blood infects players and can be dispelled.
•Helical Toxins is neutralized harmlessly upon reaching exactly applications.
•Contaminate inflicts a high amount of damage to all players.

bosses.overview:
The Sentinel Golems of Ula'tek are filled with the caustic venoms flowing throughout the temple. The Breath of Ula'tek animates venom to destroy invaders while the Blood of Ula'tek infects players with deadly toxins.

At 100 energy the Sentinels come together to fill their venom levels with Vitriolic Stasis, restoring health to the weaker Sentinel and infecting all players with Helical Toxins.

abilities.name: Vashnik the Malignant
abilities.text: Constantly seeking to improve his toxins, Vashnik infects players and obfuscates their attempts to save themselves.

children.name: Shifting Protovenom
children.text:
Vashnik contaminates random players with a prototype venom, inflicting Plague damage every 2 sec.

Coming into contact with another Protovenom neutralizes them harmlessly, while colliding with an uncontaminated player causes a Protovenom Eruption.

children.name: Protovenom Eruption
children.text: A burst of non-compatible toxins erupts, inflicting Plague damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

children.name: Ula'tek's Dominance
children.text: While the Entombed Sentinels are within yards of each other, they empower each other with Ula'tek's Dominance, reducing their damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Mark of the Aolem
children.text: The Breath of Ula'tek applies its mark to players nearby every 5 sec, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Mark of the Bolem
children.text: The Blood of Ula'tek applies its mark to players nearby every 5 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Blightburn
children.text: Venom slime ejected by the Breath of Ula'tek returns to the golem after 4 sec, inflicting Nature damage to players struck.

children.name: Venom Coagulation
children.text: The Breath of Ula'tek vomits up a sticky mass of venom that animates itself into a living slime.

children.name: Contaminate
children.text: The Venom Coagulation continually radiates a contaminating essence, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 3 sec.

children.name: Toxic Droplets
children.text: The Breath of Ula'tek sprays forth many toxic droplets, which each erupt into Noxious Blast after 16 sec. Players can destroy the droplets by stepping on top of them, suffering Nature damage.

children.name: Noxious Blast
children.text: The Toxic Droplet violently explodes, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Empowering Slam
children.text: The Breath of Ula'tek slams its current target, inflicting Physical damage. Each time the golem slams the same target, it empowers itself and gains 10% additional Physical damage dealt until it slams a different target.

children.name: Vile Toxicant
children.text: Blood venom from the Blood of Ula'tek creates a toxic pool upon expiration, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within. Greater applications of blood venom create larger toxic pools.

children.name: Blighted Blood
children.text: The Blood of Ula'tek infects players with blood venom, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec for 18 sec.

children.name: Debilitating Miasma
children.text: The Blood of Ula'tek marks a player with unstable miasma. After 8 sec, the miasma erupts, inflicting Shadow damage split evenly among players nearby. This impact spreads applications of Clinging Murk among the targets struck.

children.name: Clinging Murk
children.text: Clinging blood venom inflicts Shadow damage every 2 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Injecting Strike
children.text: The Blood of Ula'tek injects its current target with a blood venom, inflicting Physical damage immediately with an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 40 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Vitriolic Homeostasis
abilities.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, both Sentinels rush together and begin to balance their fluid levels over 30 sec. This process reduces their damage taken by 99% and restores health to the weaker Sentinel until it matches the other.

children.name: Helical Toxins
children.text:
The Sentinels combine fluids to infect all players with an entangled blood venom, inflicting Plague damage every 2 sec for 28 sec.

A victim colliding with another player combines the strength of the venom. Reaching exactly applications of Helical Toxins neutralizes the venom, removing it harmlessly.

children.name: Cultivated Burst
children.text: Upon expiration, Helical Toxins erupts in a violent explosion, inflicting Plague damage to its host and an additional Plague damage every 1 sec for 1 min.

bosses.name: The Lost Explorers
bosses.description: A band of tortollans, possessed by spirits, have come to their senses near the sarcophagus of an ancient Soulcoiler. Trapped in the vault, they seek ancient artifacts to protect themselves from further possession by vengeful spirits.

tips.text:
• Frost and Fire patches left behind by Frostfire Volley can be removed by the opposing elemental effects of Burning Flames and Piercing Frost.
• Mighty Thud inflicts very high damage to all players. Each impact inflicts damage split evenly between players directly hit.
• Trader Gebbo's Explosive Surprise triggers Blast Wave, which can be avoided using the mushrooms from Mushroom Toss.

• Blink Nova inflicts high damage to all players. Players farther from Scrollsage Epu's target receive less damage.
• Icebound Flames inflicts high damage to a player if Scrollsage Epu is not interrupted, but the lingering effects can be dispelled.
• Splinters inflicts damage over time to any players who stomp on crates thrown by Trader Gebbo.

• Shredding Shards from Scrollsage Epu inflicts high magic damage and vulnerability to this effect to the current target.
• First Mate Nema's attacks against his current target gain increasing Physical damage from Steady Strikes.
• First Mate Nema grants United Defense to the tortollan explorers when Scrollsage Epu and Trader Gebbo are both near him.

bosses.overview:
Mor'zahi uses Dark Whispers to gain control over a group of tortollan explorers he has lured into the temple. If his control over them is broken, Mor'zahi casts Mor'zahi's Command, expending all of his energy to reassert control and grant the target additional abilities.

Mor'zahi inflicts deadly damage if he is allowed to finish casting Final Ascension.

Mor'zahi's concentration can be broken if a tortollan he is controlling consumes a Disgusting Fish.

children.name: Dark Whispers
children.text: Mor'zahi's dark whispers compel the target to follow his commands.

children.name: Mor'zahi's Command
children.text: Mor'zahi violently retakes control of his target, granting them additional abilities.

children.name: Evil Eyes
children.text: The statues within the chamber project spirit flames at players, inflicting Shadow damage to players within yds of the impact locations.

children.name: Malevolent Presence
children.text: Mor'zahi glows with ancient power, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec to all players.

children.name: Fishy Feedback
children.text: Mor'zahi Inflicts Shadow damage and Shadow damage every 2 sec for 12 sec to all players as his concentration is broken.

children.name: Final Ascension
children.text: Mor'zahi gathers power slowly for his final ascension. Upon channeling, he inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to all players.

children.name: Throw Junk
children.text: While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, Trader Gebbo throws crates from his inventory which inflict Physical damage to players within yds of their impact locations. Stepping on a crate breaks it, inflicting Splinters.

children.name: Disgusting Fish
children.text: A fish found within one of Trader Gebbo's boxes. Tossing it to a possessed tortollan interrupts Mor'zahi and causes him to repossess them with Mor'zahi's Command.

children.name: Splinters
children.text: Stomping on crates of junk inflicts Physical bleeding damage to all players and causes them to bleed for damage every 1 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Relic Rupture
children.text: The relic within the crate ruptures with necrotic energy if left untouched after 25 sec, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Mushroom Toss
children.text: Trader Gebbo tosses Bouncy Mushrooms at players' locations. Bouncy Mushrooms bounce players high into the air when touched.

children.name: Bouncy Mushroom
children.text: Jumping on a Bouncy Mushroom will bounce a player high into the air but will perturb the mushroom, triggering Fungal Burst soon after.

children.name: Bounce
children.text: A Bouncy Mushroom bounces a player high into the air.

children.name: Fungal Burst
children.text: A perturbed mushroom bursts after a short delay, inflicting Nature damage to players within yds.

children.name: Explosive Surprise
children.text: Trader Gebbo tosses a bomb to the location of a player which inflicts Physical damage to players within yds on impact.

children.name: Concussive Blast
children.text: The Concussion Bomb explodes, inflicting Fire damage and knocking back players within yds. Players affected suffer Fire damage every 1 sec for 12 sec.

children.name: Blast Wave
children.text: A shockwave from an Explosive Bomb inflicts Fire damage and Fire damage every 1 sec for 10 sec to players it contacts.

children.name: Spreading Flames
children.text: Fire spreads across a large area and inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Smashing Shovel
children.text: When one of his allies is defeated, Trader Gebbo wields a shovel which inflicts an additional Physical damage and knocks players back with each strike.

children.name: Frostfire Volley
children.text:
While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, Scrollsage Epu unleashes a volley of elemental missiles at several targets, inflicting Fire or Frost damage to players within yds of the targets and afflicting them with Burning Flames or Piercing Frost.

Each missile leaves behind a patch of elemental ground at its impact location.

These impacts trigger Elemental Explosion if they strike any player afflicted by Burning Flames or Piercing Frost.

children.name: Elemental Explosion
children.text: The volatile elemental interaction inflicts Frostfire damage to all players.

children.name: Burning Flames
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage every sec for 1 min or until cancelled by a Frost effect.

children.name: Fire Patch
children.text:
Inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within 5 yds.

Frost effects will dissipate this patch.

children.name: Piercing Frost
children.text: Inflicts Frost damage every 1 sec and reduces the target's movement speed by 10% for 1 min or until cancelled by a Fire effect.

children.name: Frost Patch
children.text:
Inflicts Frost damage every 1 sec to players within 5 yds.

Fire effects will dissipate this effect.

children.name: Blink Nova
children.text: Scrollsage Epu gathers arcane power and teleports to the location of a player, inflicting Arcane damage to all players. Players farther from Scrollsage Epu's target receive less damage.

children.name: Icebound Flames
children.text: Scrollsage Epu blasts a player with elemental magic, inflicting Frostfire damage along with Frostfire damage every 1 sec while reducing their movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

children.name: Shredding Shards
children.text:
Scrollsage Epu projects a series of ice shards at her current target, inflicting Frost damage every sec for 3.5 sec.

Each shard increases the target's damage taken from Shredding Shards for 80 sec.

children.name: Cataclysmic Invocation
children.text: When one of her allies is defeated, Scrollsage Epu unleashes a massive explosion, inflicting Fire damage to all players. This damage increases with each cast.

children.name: United Defense
children.text: First Mate Nema, Scrollsage Epu, and Trader Gebbo reduce the incoming damage they take by 99% while they are within 30 yds of each other.

children.name: Mighty Thud
children.text:
While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, First Mate Nema marks three players then leaps to each of their locations.

Each impact inflicts Physical damage split evenly among players within yds and knocks them back.

If Mighty Thud fails to hit a player, it inflicts Physical damage to all players.

children.name: Aftershock
children.text: Mighty Thud leaves behind quaking ground that inflicts Physical damage to players within yds every 1 sec.

children.name: Shell Spin
children.text: First Mate Nema hurls three spinning shells in a cone in front of him. The shells will stun players they come into contact with for 4 sec.

children.name: Steady Strikes
children.text: First Mate Nema gains 4% Physical damage to his current target with each attack, lasting 30 sec.

children.name: Relentless Escalation
children.text: When one of his allies is defeated, First Mate Nema gains 100% increased damage every 1 sec for sec.

bosses.name: Vashnik the Malignant
bosses.description: Within The Chamber of Virulence, Vashnik the Malignant distills Ula'tek's venoms into ever more lethal forms. The creature lurks in its noxious chamber, brewing foul toxins to empower its brood.

tips.text:
• Imbibe creates living venom from two nearby fountains.

• Living venoms explode in Malignant Bursts unless destroyed.

• The initial Clotting Venom is protected by Sanguineous Fortitude.

• Imbibe inflicts heavy damage to all players.

• Vashnik's chamber fills with increasing Toxic Vapor each time he Imbibes.

• Siphoning Infection absorbs a large amount of incoming healing.

• Dripping Fangs inflicts increasing damage over time.

• Imbibe infuses Vashnik with the power of two nearby fountains.

bosses.overview:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Vashnik Imbibes from the nearest two fountains, increasing his affinity to them. These fountains erupt with vapor, bringing forth living venoms that crawl toward the Malignant Cavity in the center of the chamber.

Should a living venom reach its destination, a Malignant Burst occurs.

abilities.name: Imbibe
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, Imbibe conjures Malignant Totem's from the venomous fountains.

children.name: Malignance
children.text: The totem sends a wave of poison, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 2 sec for 16 sec to all players. This effect stacks.

children.name: Blood Infusion
children.text:
Vashnik empowers himself with blood venom, bolstering his next cast of Imbibe.

Increases the damage of Hemo Expulsion by 100% and the maximum health of Clotting Venoms by 50% for 90 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Hemo Expulsion
children.text: Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Blood, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Sanguineous Fortitude
children.text: Clotting Venom is fortified as it emerges, protecting it from crowd control effects until destroyed.

children.name: Splitting Clot
children.text: Clotting Venom splits upon dying, creating smaller Clotting Venom.

children.name: Shadow Infusion
children.text:
Vashnik empowers himself with shadow venom, bolstering his next cast of Imbibe.

Increases the damage of Gloom Expulsion by 100% and the maximum health of Shrouded Venoms by 50% for 90 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Gloom Expulsion
children.text: Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Shadow, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Miasmic Coating
children.text: Shrouded Venom is protected by a Miasmic Coating that absorbs 100% of its max health in damage.

children.name: Umbral Ejection
children.text: Shrouded Venoms burst when destroyed, spraying shadow venom that inflicts Shadow damage to players near its impact locations.

children.name: Flame Infusion
children.text:
Vashnik empowers himself with flame venom, bolstering his next cast of Imbibe.

Increases the damage of Conflagrating Expulsion by 100% and the maximum health of Burning Venoms by 50% for 90 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Conflagrating Expulsion
children.text: Vashnik draws venom from the Fountain of Flame, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Burning Presence
children.text: Burning Venom pulses with flame, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 3 sec.

children.name: Caustic Surge
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Caustic Surge inflicts damage over time, and multiple applications stack.

children.name: Hardened Venom
children.text: The venom hardens after sixty seconds, and becomes immune to crowd control effects, and gains 50% increased movement speed.

children.name: Toxic Vapor
children.text: Toxic vapor fills the dank air of the chamber, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Malignant Burst
children.text: Living venoms burst upon reaching the Malignant Cavity, inflicting Nature damage to all players and an additional Nature damage every 3 sec for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Malignant Catalyst
abilities.text: Vashnik congeals an orb of venom above the Malignant Cavity and then explodes it, inflicting Nature damage to all players and launching Catalytic Bile.

children.name: Catalytic Bile
children.text:
A toxic spray that inflicts Nature damage to players near the impact locations. 

If Catalytic Bile fails to hit at least one player, Nature damage is inflicted to all players instead.

abilities.name: Plague Froth
abilities.text: Vashnik coats his victims in a corrosive venom that inflicts Plague damage to players nearby every 1 sec for 6 sec. When the aura expires, Plague Waves erupt from the target in cardinal directions.

children.name: Plague Wave
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Plague Waves destroy Malignant Tumors.

abilities.name: Dripping Fangs
abilities.text: Vashnik bites into his current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Nature damage every 2 sec for 32 sec. Increases Physical damage taken by 100%. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Adaptive Infection
abilities.text: Vashnik infects several players with toxins, according to his current infusions.

children.name: Siphoning Infection
children.text:
Vashnik infects several players with a blood venom that inflicts Shadow damage every 1.5 sec and absorbs the next healing.

While the infection lasts, healing received is reduced by 100%, and the target periodically casts Siphon Blood to nearby players.

children.name: Siphon Blood
children.text: Inflicting Shadow damage to nearby allies, and healing for each ally hit every 1.5 sec.

children.name: Thinned Blood
children.text: Your blood is being drained faster than expected, increasing damage taken from Siphon Blood by 500%.

children.name: Exploding Infection
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, this gains a stack every 1.5 sec until dispelled.

children.name: Caustic Explosion
children.text: The infected player explodes, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Stygian Infection
children.text: Vashnik infects several players with a shadow venom that inflicts Shadow damage every 1.5 sec and absorbs the next healing. While the infection lasts, the infected player periodically casts Stygian Burst.

children.name: Stygian Burst
children.text: An eruption of dark venom that inflicts Shadow damage to players near the impact location.

bosses.name: Sszorak
bosses.description: A horrifying creature, warped by Ula'tek's toxic venom, Sszorak is a brutal instrument of vengeance. Calling upon the winds that howl deep within Atal'Utek, it tears apart any living creature it encounters.

tips.text:
•Venomous Surge inflicts raid-wide damage. Players farther from the affected player receive less damage.
•Raging Crosswinds inflicts damage over time before knocking affected players in the indicated direction.

bosses.overview: Sszorak relentlessly assaults players with Apex Predator combination attacks and noxious Venomous Surge globs. The Altar of the Six Winds unleashes Raging Crosswinds and eventually builds to a massive Howling Maelstrom that pushes players around the arena.

abilities.name: Howling Maelstrom
abilities.text: The Altar of the Six Winds unleashes a succession of gales across the arena. Each gale pushes players in its indicated direction.

children.name: Dig In
children.text: Sszorak hunkers down during Howling Maelstrom, increasing his damage taken by 30% for 25 sec.

abilities.name: Serpent's Fury
abilities.text:
Sszorak marks a player and gains rage over time. When at least players are within yards of the marked player, Sszorak casts To the Slaughter and consumes his rage.

Upon reaching rage, Sszorak gains Unbound Ferocity and begins slaughtering players.

children.name: Unbound Ferocity
children.text: Sszorak flies into a killing frenzy, increasing his damage done by 500% and attack speed by 50% until all his foes are left dead or dying.

children.name: To the Slaughter
children.text: Sszorak consumes his rage and charges toward the player marked by Serpent's Fury, inflicting Physical damage to players struck and applying Virulence.

children.name: Virulence
children.text:
Toxifies a target for 5 sec, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec.

Upon removal the toxin bursts, inflicting Nature damage to players struck and afflicting them with Virulence.

abilities.name: Apex Predator
abilities.text: Sszorak executes multiple attacks in rapid succession. Taunt effects can change his current target while casting.

children.name: Ravage
children.text: Sszorak slashes repeatedly, inflicting Physical damage to all players in a frontal cone and increasing their damage taken from Ravage by 300% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Mutilate

If Mutilate strikes or fewer players, it inflicts deadly damage.

children.name: Mutilated Gash

children.name: Tempest

abilities.name: Venomous Surge
abilities.text:
Sszorak heaves fresh venom onto several players, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

Upon expiration, the venom detonates forming a Viscous Cyst and inflicting Nature damage to all players, decreasing in damage as distance increases.

children.name: Viscous Cyst
children.text:
A glob of unstable toxin forms for 2 min. Upon contact or expiration, the glob bursts, knocking all players away and inflicting Nature damage. The toxin then inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec and reduces movement speed by 30% for 5 sec. This effect stacks.

The toxins cling to players, allowing them to better adhere to the ground while it persists.

children.name: Caustic Claws
children.text: Sszorak flings toxin from his claws, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact.

children.name: Caustic Residue

abilities.name: Raging Crosswinds
abilities.text:

Upon expiration, the winds inflict Nature damage to players nearby. The winds then knock each affected player in the indicated direction and apply Turbulent Gusts.

children.name: Turbulent Gusts
children.text: Turbulent winds hold the target aloft, reducing their falling speed for 10 sec. Contacting another player affected by Turbulent Gusts causes the winds to dissipate.

abilities.name: Corroding Venom
abilities.text: Sszorak's venom-laced claws corrode his target's armor, causing melee attacks to increase Physical damage taken by the target by 3% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Ula'tek's Presence
abilities.text: The Altar of the Six Winds emits a caustic mist, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec.

bosses.name: The Twin Fangs
bosses.description: The first of Ula'tek's blood, Vexhul and Ithraz brood beneath a roiling sea of venom deep within the vault of Atal'Utek. Any foolish enough to enter the prison's inner chamber risk their monstrous jaws and toxic strikes.

bosses.overview:
The Twin Fangs' Eternal Venom accumulates throughout the battle. Vexhul funnels toxin into her target with Caustic Deluge forming Caustic Globules and calls her progeny with Venomous Emergence. Ithraz consumes players with Ravenous Feast and strikes repeatedly with Stone Breaker.

At 100 energy, both serpents submerge and reposition before attacking together. Vexhul releases a Vile Flood while Ithraz spews globs of gore during Sanguine Storm.
