bosses.name: Ula'tek
bosses.description: The great shame of the Amani empire. The vast complex of Atal'Utek was created to imprison the weapon that proved to be as much of a threat as the enemy she was intended to destroy. Ula'tek has risen from her ancient slumber and threatens all of Azeroth if she should escape.

tips.text:
• Blightscale Spawn hatch a Blightscale Viper when they connect with venom.
• A Blightscale Clutch grows in power unless destroyed.
• Doomscale Wardens use Writhing Gestation on nearby Blightscale Spawn.

• Every Blightscale Viper hatched inflicts Putrid Membrane to all players.
• Spectral Coils inflicts damage to everyone that is reduced by the number of players at the impact location.

• Ula'tek uses Unchecked Rage while not engaged in melee combat.
• Ula'tek's Gore Rattle uses Rattler Slam while not engaged in melee combat.
•Mother's Wrath inflicts damage to everyone while no one is in its area of effect.

bosses.overview:
Ula'tek splashes venom across her platform with Caustic Waves. Any Blightscale Spawn that touch her venom hatches and covers players in a Putrid Membrane. While her slithering children continue to spawn, Ula'tek uses her Spectral Coils to shatter the space.

After Ula'tek rails against her prison with Rage of the Shackled she summons her faithful then dives beneath the venom to gather her strength. Ula'tek's Doomscale Wardens move between the Blightscale Spawn imbuing them with Writhing Gestation as the Doomscale Eggs begin to hatch.

With her progeny broken, Ula'tek shatters the arena. She continues to use Call of the Serpent to gather her forces while destroying the only safe spaces remaining with Circling Prey.

abilities.name: Blightscale Spawn
abilities.text:
The endless spawn of Ula'tek. These eggs go through rapid gestation and hatch whenever they come into contact with the venom that fills Ula'tek's prison.

$[!16 On Mythic difficulty, Blightscale Spawn are Hardened and cast Noxious Shell on players that pick them up.

children.name: Hardened
children.text:
The shell of the Blightscale Spawn absorbs the next damage.

While the spawn's shell is hardened, it cannot be moved.

children.name: Noxious Shell
children.text:
Ula'tek's noxious eggs inflict Nature damage every 1 sec while attached to a player.

Moving within 3 yards of another player carrying a Noxious Shell causes a Noxious Splash.

When the aura is removed, the egg inflicts Rancid Yolk on the player.

children.name: Noxious Splash
children.text: Moving within 3 yards of another player carrying a Noxious Shell causes it to instantly hatch and inflicts Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec to the carrier for 10 sec.

children.name: Rancid Yolk
children.text: The egg breaks, spilling Rancid Yolk over the player and increasing the damage inflicted from Noxious Shell by 200% for 20 sec.

children.name: Putrid Membrane
children.text: When Ula'tek's eggs hatch a, they spray a membrane over all players that inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Blightscale Rawling
children.text:
Broken from their shells early, the Blightscale Rawling struggles to survive.

$[!16 On Mythic difficulty, Blightscale Rawlings cast Boiling Venom which grants them the ability to use Acidic Expulsion.

children.name: Boiling Venom
children.text: After 25 sec the Blightscale's venom boils, increasing its haste by 100% and all damage done by 100%.

children.name: Acidic Expulsion
children.text: The Blightscale expulses venom, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec to all players for 35 sec.

children.name: Poisonous Bite
children.text: The Blightscale Rawling's bite inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec to their current target for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Blightscale Viper
children.text: Fully gestated, the Blightscale Viper is a lethal predator.

children.name: Acidic Burst
children.text: The viper spits at a random player, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 18 sec.

children.name: Petrifying Sting
children.text: The Viper dives at a random player, turning players near the location to stone, absorbing the next healing and inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec.

abilities.name: Stage One: Fury of the Serpent Mother

children.name: Toxic Womb
children.text:
Ula'tek rips a gestating Blightscale Wretch from the ceiling that inflicts Nature damage to players near the impact location.

Torn from its incubation, the Blightscale Wretch will awaken after 20 sec.

children.name: Boiling Venom
children.text: After 30 sec the Blightscale's venom boils, increasing its haste by 100% and all damage done by 100%.

children.name: Fester Burst
children.text: The Blightscale Wretch forms a festering membrane around itself which bursts, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec to players farther than 10 yards away for 12 sec.

children.name: Toxic Incubation
children.text:
A spectral Ula'tek unleashes a cascade of venom towards the Blightscale Wretch, applying Mother's Boon every 1 sec for 4 sec. If a player intercepts the venom, it inflicts Nature damage and applies Toxic Burn to them instead.

Each impact causes to erupt from the target's location.

children.name: Mother's Boon
children.text: Each application of Mother's Boon the Blightscale Wretch receives reduces their damage taken by 10% and increases their damage done by 15%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Toxic Burn
children.text: The player's skin sizzles, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for12 sec. This effect stacks.

Waves that connect with Ula'tek's eggs cause them to instantly hatch.

children.name: Call of the Serpent

children.name: Mother's Wrath

Ula'tek knocks back her current target, marking them for wrath, inflicting Nature damage every 0.3 sec for 3 sec while within reach of her attack. Each bite injects Ula'tek's target with Stone Venom and leaves them Hobbled.

If her current target is outside her reach, Ula'tek inflicts these effects on all players.

children.name: Stone Venom

children.name: Hobbled

children.name: Rattler Slam

children.name: Mephitic Thrash

children.name: Spectral Coils
children.text: Ula'tek's Spectral Coils rise above the platform and crush anything beneath them, inflicting Nature damage to all players. This damage is reduced by the number of players near the impact location.

children.name: Soul Constrictor
children.text: Ula'tek constricts your soul, preventing you from mitigating damage from Spectral Coils for 6 sec.

children.name: Necrotic Vapors
children.text: As Ula'tek disturbs the pool, Necrotic Vapors fill the room, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to all players. This effect stacks.

children.name: Ula'tek's Bond
children.text: All aspects of Ula'tek's form share damage taken.

children.name: Rage of the Shackled
children.text:
Ula'tek rages, inflicting Nature damage every 4 sec to all players for 20 sec and causing Falling Debris to impact several random destinations.

Flying into this rage exposes Ula'tek's Venomous Heart.

children.name: Falling Debris
children.text: Falling debris drops onto several random destinations, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Venomous Heart
children.text: The beating core of Ula'tek. All damage taken by the Venomous Heart is increased by 100% for 20 sec.

children.name: Unchecked Rage
children.text: If Ula'tek is unable to melee a nearby player when she is not casting or channeling, she inflicts Physical damage to all players.

children.name: Hatching Doom

normal.name: The Tidebound Grotto
normal.description: Hidden beneath the waves of Atal'Utek lies the Tidebound Grotto, a submerged cave veiled by shifting tides. Within, the naga sorceress Nymrissa Wavecaller bends the tides to conceal her domain--and to drown any who dare uncover it.

bosses.name: Nymrissa Wavecaller
bosses.description: Nymrissa Wavecaller commands the restless sea itself, concealing her lair beneath shifting tides. Those who dare uncover her sanctuary find her murloc minions eager to answer their mistress' call.

tips.text:
•Iceblade Flurry inflicts sustained damage to Nymrissa Wavecaller's current target.
•Alluring Bubble attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.

•Abyssal Rain inflicts significant damage to all players.
•Alluring Bubble inflicts a large burst of damage to all players when it Pops!

•Alluring Bubble attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.
•Murlocs that enter a Alluring Bubble become empowered.

bosses.overview: Nymrissa Wavecaller creates an Alluring Bubble within the grotto that lures nearby murlocs into her grasp. She then summons Swirling Whirlpools to break the bubble, empowering murlocs within.

abilities.name: Alluring Bubble
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, Bubblefin Frostscales emerge from the grotto's depths.

children.name: Bubblefin Shorerunner
children.text: Murlocs heed the call of the bubble and swarm toward it.

children.name: Bubblefin Berserker
children.text: Murlocs that enter the bubble transform into Bubblefin Berserkers.

children.name: Pulsing Tides
children.text: Bubblefin Berserkers pulse with the power of the deeps, inflicting Frost damage to all players every 3 sec.

children.name: Pop!
children.text: The bubble pops, unleashes a surge of pressurized water that inflicts Frost damage to all players and knocks them away.

abilities.name: Swirling Whirlpools
abilities.text:
Nymrissa awakens whirlpools within the grotto that surge toward the Alluring Bubble.

The whirlpools inflict Frost damage to players in their path.

abilities.name: Chilling Frost
abilities.text:
Nymrissa chills players to the bone, inflicting Frost damage every 1.5 sec and decreasing their movement speed by 15% for 6 sec.

Each impact leaves behind a Frost Orb at the player's location.

children.name: Frost Orb
children.text:
A frozen orb that clings to the player when touched, inflicting Frost damage and an additional Frost damage every 2 sec for 12 sec.

Leaves behind Lingering Frost.

children.name: Lingering Frost
children.text: Inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec and causes players to slide.

abilities.name: Iceblade Flurry
abilities.text: Nymrissa empowers her weapon with ice, slashing her current target for Frost damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Abyssal Rain
abilities.text:
Nymrissa channels a torrent of water from the crevices above, inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

This rain drenches its victims, inflicting Frost damage every 2 sec for 24 sec.

abilities.name: Unending Tides
abilities.text: Nymrissa unleashes a catastrophic surge of water, repeatedly crashing into all players, inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec.

heroic.name: The Tidebound Grotto
heroic.description: Hidden beneath the waves of Atal'Utek lies the Tidebound Grotto, a submerged cave veiled by shifting tides. Within, the naga sorceress Nymrissa Wavecaller bends the tides to conceal her domain--and to drown any who dare uncover it.

bosses.name: Nymrissa Wavecaller
bosses.description: Nymrissa Wavecaller commands the restless sea itself, concealing her lair beneath shifting tides. Those who dare uncover her sanctuary find her murloc minions eager to answer their mistress' call.

tips.text:
•Iceblade Flurry inflicts sustained damage to Nymrissa Wavecaller's current target.
•Alluring Bubble attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.

•Abyssal Rain inflicts significant damage to all players.
•Alluring Bubble inflicts a large burst of damage to all players when it Pops!

•Alluring Bubble attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.
•Murlocs that enter a Alluring Bubble become empowered.

bosses.overview: Nymrissa Wavecaller creates an Alluring Bubble within the grotto that lures nearby murlocs into her grasp. She then summons Swirling Whirlpools to break the bubble, empowering murlocs within.

abilities.name: Alluring Bubble
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, Bubblefin Frostscales emerge from the grotto's depths.

children.name: Bubblefin Shorerunner
children.text: Murlocs heed the call of the bubble and swarm toward it.

children.name: Bubblefin Berserker
children.text: Murlocs that enter the bubble transform into Bubblefin Berserkers.

children.name: Pulsing Tides
children.text: Bubblefin Berserkers pulse with the power of the deeps, inflicting Frost damage to all players every 3 sec.

children.name: Pop!
children.text: The bubble pops, unleashes a surge of pressurized water that inflicts Frost damage to all players and knocks them away.

abilities.name: Swirling Whirlpools
abilities.text:
Nymrissa awakens whirlpools within the grotto that surge toward the Alluring Bubble.

The whirlpools inflict Frost damage to players in their path.

abilities.name: Chilling Frost
abilities.text: On Heroic difficulty, Frost Orb effects stack and orbs Shatter if left untouched.

children.name: Frost Orb
children.text:
A frozen orb that clings to the player when touched, inflicting Frost damage and an additional Frost damage every 2 sec for 12 sec.

Leaves behind Lingering Frost.

children.name: Lingering Frost
children.text: Inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec and causes players to slide.

children.name: Shatter
children.text: The Frost Orb explodes violently if left untouched, inflicting Frost damage to all players and an additional Frost damage every 2 sec for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Iceblade Flurry
abilities.text: Nymrissa empowers her weapon with ice, slashing her current target for Frost damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Abyssal Rain
abilities.text: On Heroic difficulty, Abyssal Rain grants the caster Wavecaller's Might.

children.name: Wavecaller's Might
children.text: Nymrissa's power swells, increasing her Frost damage by 3%. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Unending Tides
abilities.text: Nymrissa unleashes a catastrophic surge of water, repeatedly crashing into all players, inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec.

lfr.name: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
lfr.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.

bosses.name: Kith'ix
bosses.description: Defeated long ago, Kith'ix was restrained deep in the Vaults of Ula'tek by Ula'tek herself. With her defeat, the C'Thraxxi has returned, intent on wiping out not just the Amani, but any who would oppose him.

tips.text:
• Aqir that are not slain before Kith'ix casts Suffocating Darkness become greatly empowered.
• Light's Embrace greatly reduces the damage of Extinguish.

• Abyssal Grasp drags players into the darkness if its heal absorb effect is not removed quickly enough.
• Light's Embrace greatly reduces the damage of Extinguish.

• Kith'ix's Commanding Presence greatly reduces damage taken by nearby aqir.
• Dark Devastation leaves Kith'ix's target Devastated, greatly increasing damage they take.
• Light's Embrace greatly reduces the damage of Extinguish.

bosses.overview:
Kith'ix calls upon his Voidswarm to fight alongside him as he assaults players with an array of powerful dark magic.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Kith'ix attempts to smother his enemies with Suffocating Darkness. Lady Liadrin holds the darkness at bay while gathering power to banish it with Divine Radiance.

At 25% health, Kith'ix stuns players with Stygian Howl and Liadrin rescues them with Last Light, beginning a race to slay Kith'ix before his Eightfold Eclipse snuffs out Liadrin's light.

children.name: Voidswarm
children.text: Kith'ix tears open void portals over 6 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec and summoning aqir servants.

children.name: Venom Roar
children.text: The Venomous Hulk roars with toxic fury, inflicting Nature and Physical damage to players in a cone in front of it and knocking them back.

children.name: Voidweave
children.text: The Voidweaver conjures a sphere of turbulent void and focuses its energies on random players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Nightfall
children.text:
The Voidweaver lashes out at all players with piercing darkness, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec and increasing damage taken from Nightfall by 10%.

This effect stacks.

children.name: Suffocating Darkness
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Kith'ix creates a swirling storm of darkness that inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec as it closes in around them, and applies Dark Frenzy to any surviving aqir.

children.name: Abyssal Grasp
children.text:
Void tendrils emerge from the darkness and grab random players, gradually pulling them in and absorbing the next incoming healing.

After 9 sec, any players this effect is not removed from are immediately dragged into the darkness.

children.name: Suffocation
children.text: Kith'ix's storm of darkness pacifies players caught within, reduces their movement speed by 30%, and inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Dark Frenzy
children.text: Suffocating Darkness infuses aqir with raw void energy that increases their attack and movement speed by 100%, grants immunity to crowd control effects, and inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Refulgent Bulwark
children.text: Liadrin forms a protective barrier of Light in the area around her, greatly slowing the approach of Suffocating Darkness.

children.name: Divine Radiance
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Liadrin unleashes radiant Light that burns away all traces of Suffocating Darkness and stuns Kith'ix for 8 sec.

children.name: Exhausted
children.text: Unleashing Divine Radiance places immense strain on Liadrin, reducing the effectiveness of Light's Embrace and Refulgent Bulwark, and increasing the damage of Suffocating Darkness by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Extinguish
children.text: Kith'ix charges up and releases a devastating shockwave that inflicts Shadow damage to all players and removes Light's Embrace.

children.name: Light's Embrace
children.text: Liadrin scatters motes of soothing Light that envelop players on contact, reducing all Shadow damage they take by 90% for up to 8 sec.

children.name: Unspeakable Horrors
children.text: Kith'ix floods the minds of random players with unspeakable horrors for 6 sec, after which they succumb to Overwhelming Fear.

children.name: Overwhelming Fear
children.text:
Forced to cower in fear by Kith'ix's Unspeakable Horrors for up to 6 sec.

Upon expiration or removal, release a piercing scream that inflicts Shadow damage to all players, reduced based on distance.

children.name: Twisted Appendage
children.text: Kith'ix manifests shadowy tentacles that lash out at nearby players, inflicting Shadow damage to any players hit.

children.name: Dark Devastation
children.text: Kith'ix hurls an immense mass of darkness at his current target, inflicting Shadow and Physical damage to players within yds on impact and leaving them Devastated.

children.name: Devastated
children.text: Increases Physical damage taken by 100% and Shadow damage taken by 100% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Commanding Presence
children.text: Kith'ix's commanding presence protects aqir within yds, reducing all damage they take by 75%. This does not affect Eggs.

children.name: Stygian Howl
children.text:
Upon reaching 25% health, Kith'ix howls with otherworldly fury, stunning all players.

He then absorbs all of his own minions and abilities and begins casting Eightfold Eclipse.

children.name: Eightfold Eclipse
children.text:
Kith'ix begins a ritual to plunge his enemies into endless darkness, manifesting eclipses that inflict Shadow damage to all players.

Once the final eclipse is manifest, they converge upon Lady Liadrin, snuffing out her Light and killing all players instantly.

children.name: Null Gate
children.text: Kith'ix focuses void energy on random players for 5 sec, then tears open a Null Gate at their location, inflicting Shadow damage and applying Nullify to other players within yds.

children.name: Nullshards
children.text: Shards of pure void energy scatter from Null Gates, inflicting Shadow damage and applying Nullify to players on contact.

children.name: Nullify
children.text:
Inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon reaching applications, affected players are instantly killed.

children.name: Last Light
children.text: Liadrin's unbreakable resolve shines through as she becomes a conduit of pure Light, fully healing all players and granting them Luminous Grace.

children.name: Luminous Grace
children.text: Increases all damage done by 50% and all healing done by 100%.

Bomber Beetles violently explode after 30 sec or upon contact with any player, coating all players in Digestive Juices.

This effect kills the Beetle.

children.name: Digestive Juices
children.text: The Bomber Beetle's acidic viscera inflict Nature damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Incubation
children.text: The aqir is filled with Mindstinger Eggs that burst from its body on death.

children.name: Mindsting
children.text: The Mindstinger flies to a player and injects them with a mind toxin, stunning them and inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

children.name: Suffocating Darkness
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Kith'ix creates a swirling storm of darkness that inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec as it closes in around them, and applies Dark Frenzy to any surviving aqir.

children.name: Abyssal Grasp
children.text:
Void tendrils emerge from the darkness and grab random players, gradually pulling them in and absorbing the next incoming healing.

After 9 sec, any players this effect is not removed from are immediately dragged into the darkness.

children.name: Suffocation
children.text: Kith'ix's storm of darkness pacifies players caught within, reduces their movement speed by 30%, and inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Dark Frenzy
children.text: Suffocating Darkness infuses aqir with raw void energy that increases their attack and movement speed by 100%, grants immunity to crowd control effects, and inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Refulgent Bulwark
children.text: Liadrin forms a protective barrier of Light in the area around her, greatly slowing the approach of Suffocating Darkness.

children.name: Divine Radiance
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Liadrin unleashes radiant Light that burns away all traces of Suffocating Darkness and stuns Kith'ix for 8 sec.

children.name: Exhausted
children.text: Unleashing Divine Radiance places immense strain on Liadrin, reducing the effectiveness of Light's Embrace and Refulgent Bulwark, and increasing the damage of Suffocating Darkness by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Extinguish
children.text: Kith'ix charges up and releases a devastating shockwave that inflicts Shadow damage to all players and removes Light's Embrace.

children.name: Light's Embrace
children.text: Liadrin scatters motes of soothing Light that envelop players on contact, reducing all Shadow damage they take by 90% for up to 8 sec.

children.name: Unspeakable Horrors
children.text: Kith'ix floods the minds of random players with unspeakable horrors for 6 sec, after which they succumb to Overwhelming Fear.

children.name: Overwhelming Fear
children.text:
Forced to cower in fear by Kith'ix's Unspeakable Horrors for up to 6 sec.

Upon expiration or removal, release a piercing scream that inflicts Shadow damage to all players, reduced based on distance.

children.name: Twisted Appendage
children.text: Kith'ix manifests shadowy tentacles that lash out at nearby players, inflicting Shadow damage to any players hit.

children.name: Dark Devastation
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, Dark Devastation leaves behind a Voidscar.

children.name: Devastated
children.text: Increases Physical damage taken by 100% and Shadow damage taken by 100% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Voidscar
children.text: A churning mass of void energy that inflicts Shadow damage to players on contact and knocks them back.

children.name: Eclipse Fragment
children.text:
Suffocating Darkness energizes Voidscars, causing them to release powerful fragments of void energy that are slowly drawn toward Liadrin.

Contact with a player destroys the fragment and inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec for 6 sec to players within yds. This effect stacks.

Contact with Liadrin triggers Lost Refulgence.

children.name: Lost Refulgence
children.text: Eclipse Fragments that reach Liadrin inflict Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 2 sec and reduce the size of Refulgent Bulwark. This effect stacks.

children.name: Commanding Presence
children.text: Kith'ix's commanding presence protects aqir within yds, reducing all damage they take by 75%. This does not affect Eggs.

children.name: Stygian Howl
children.text:
Upon reaching 25% health, Kith'ix howls with otherworldly fury, stunning all players.

He then absorbs all of his own minions and abilities and begins casting Eightfold Eclipse.

children.name: Eightfold Eclipse
children.text:
Kith'ix begins a ritual to plunge his enemies into endless darkness, manifesting eclipses that inflict Shadow damage to all players.

Once the final eclipse is manifest, they converge upon Lady Liadrin, snuffing out her Light and killing all players instantly.

children.name: Null Gate
children.text: Kith'ix focuses void energy on random players for 5 sec, then tears open a Null Gate at their location, inflicting Shadow damage and applying Nullify to other players within yds.

children.name: Nullshards
children.text: Shards of pure void energy scatter from Null Gates, inflicting Shadow damage and applying Nullify to players on contact.

children.name: Nullify
children.text:
Inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon reaching applications, affected players are instantly killed.

children.name: Negation
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, this effect applies multiple stacks.

children.name: Explosive Restabilization
children.text: Negation's immense void energy reacts on contact with a Null Gate, triggering a violent explosion that inflicts Shadow and Physical damage to players and destroys Null Gates and Nullshards nearby.

children.name: Last Light
children.text: Liadrin's unbreakable resolve shines through as she becomes a conduit of pure Light, fully healing all players and granting them Luminous Grace.

children.name: Luminous Grace
children.text: Increases all damage done by 50% and all healing done by 100%.

5543.name: Fade Out
5543.text: Turns the caster invisible for 2 sec.

110960.name: Greater Invisibility
110960.text: Makes you invisible and untargetable for 20 sec, removing all threat. Any action taken cancels this effect.

263425.name: Arc Dash
263425.text: Adderis rapidly charges at all enemies, inflicting Physical damage to all players in their path.

263958.name: A Knot of Snakes
263958.text:
Many small snakes wrap around the target, preventing any action and slowly suffocating the victim for Physical damage every 1 sec.

Destroying or incapacitating the knot of snakes frees the victim, causing the clump to unravel and attack players.

264172.name: Burrow
264172.text:
Merektha burrows through the ground, inflicting Nature damage to any players caught in her path. Victims are knocked up and stunned for 4 sec.

A occurs while Merektha burrows.

264763.name: Spark Step
264763.text: The creature zaps to the location of a player, inflicting Nature damage to players near the chosen player.

265773.name: Spit Gold
265773.text: Spits molten gold at random players, inflicting Fire damage to players near impact and additional Fire damage every 2 sec for 6 sec, and creating a pool of Molten Gold at the player's location afterwards.

265910.name: Tail Thrash
265910.text: A heavy hitting melee strike that inflicts Physical damage.

265923.name: Lucre's Call
265923.text: Turns all pools of Molten Gold in the area into Animated Gold.

265966.name: Ground Pound
265966.text: The caster smashes the ground with such force that all enemies nearby are knocked away and take Physical damage.

265991.name: Luster
265991.text: Shields the Golden Serpent for 10% of its health in damage, and increases its damage done by 25% until removed. This effect stacks.

266191.name: Whirling Axe
266191.text: Kula unleashes a whirling attack that inflicts Physical damage to players nearby, knocking them back. She then throws two whirling axes which inflict Physical damage every 2 sec for 6 sec to players who come into contact with them, and knock the player back.

266206.name: Whirling Axes
266206.text: Kula unleashes a whirling attack that inflicts Physical damage to players nearby, knocking them back. She then throws two whirling axes which inflict Physical damage every 2 sec for 6 sec to players who come into contact with them, and knock the player back.

266231.name: Severing Axe
266231.text: Kula throws an axe at a random player, inflicting Physical damage and additional Physical damage every 2 sec for 8 sec.

266237.name: Debilitating Backhand
266237.text: Wallops her current target with a Debilitating Backhand, inflicting Physical damage, knocking them back, and applying Shattered Defenses to them.

266951.name: Barrel Through
266951.text: Aka'ali charges a targeted player, inflicting Physical damage, split among players near impact. This attack ignores armor.

267027.name: Poison Spit
267027.text: The Toxic Viper spits poison at a player, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

267060.name: Call of the Elements
267060.text: Zanazal the Wise calls forth his reinforced elemental totems.

267077.name: Explode
267077.text: Explodes, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

267105.name: Torrent
267105.text: Gouts of water spew forth from the totem, inflicting Frost damage to players nearby and knocking them back.

267257.name: Disruption
267257.text: A burst of thunder interrupts all players for 4 sec.

267273.name: Poison Nova
267273.text: Creates a burst of poisonous gas, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec for 12 sec.

267483.name: Loose Sparks
267483.text: Loose sparks crackle with energy, inflicting Nature damage to players hit and stunning them for 6 sec.

267618.name: Drain Fluids
267618.text: Prepares the targets for mummification by draining their fluids, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec and triggers for 6 sec. Applies Desiccation to the target when finished.

267639.name: Burn Corruption
267639.text: Mchimba targets a random player with purifying flames, inflicting Fire damage to players near impact and creates a patch of Burning Ground.

267702.name: Entomb
267702.text:
Entombs the target within one of the crypts inside the chamber. After casting Entomb, Mchimba will move between the crypts, opening them one at a time, beginning with the crypts that do not contain the entombed player.

Releasing the Entombed player will interrupt the ritual, preventing Mchimba from releasing additional Finished Mummies.

267763.name: Wretched Discharge
267763.text: Afflicts all players with a disease, causing Nature damage every 2 sec for 12 sec.

267874.name: Burning Ground
267874.text: Inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to any players inside a patch of Burning Ground.

268013.name: Flame Shock
268013.text: The creature sears a player with fire, inflicting Fire damage and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

268586.name: Blade Combo
268586.text: A series of deadly melee strikes that deal increasing damage to their target.

269116.name: Draw Power
269116.text: The caster draws power from a nearby power source, increasing all damage dealt.

269232.name: Hunting Leap
269232.text: Reban jumps towards a targeted player, inflicting Physical damage and additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. Reban then follows up with a series of gutripping attacks, inflicting Physical to players in a cone with each attack.

269369.name: Deathly Roar
269369.text: Rezan lets out a terrifying roar, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and makes them run in fear for 4 sec.

269896.name: Embryonic Vigor
269896.text:
The caster is invigorated with the stolen life of the egg's embryo.
The caster is healed for 10% of their maximum health and has all damage dealt increased by 30%.

269928.name: Vigilant Defense
269928.text: Raises a shield, deflecting all ranged attacks and spells and blocking all melee attacks from the front.

269935.name: Bound by Shadow
269935.text: Absorbs damage and increases damage done by 20%. Kills the target when removed.

269972.name: Hex Volley
269972.text: Inflicts Shadow damage and curses for an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 12 sec.

270003.name: Suppression Slam
270003.text: Slams the ground in a frontal cone, inflicting Physical damage to all affected players and stunning them for 2.5 sec.

270292.name: Purifying Flame
270292.text: Inflicts Fire damage to all enemies and creates a zone of purifying flame, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec. To players who enter.

270293.name: Purification Strike
270293.text: Inflicts Fire damage to all enemies and creates a zone of purifying flame, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec. To players who enter.

270482.name: Violent Lunge
270482.text: Jumps to a player's location and slashes players, inflicting Physical damage and knocking them back.

270492.name: Hex
270492.text: "Curses" the target, transforming them into an adorable, tiny dinosaur for 5 sec, rendering them unable to take actions.

270497.name: Healing Tide Totem
270497.text: Summons a totem that heals all nearby allies for 10% every 2.5 sec. The totem lasts for 30 sec or until killed.

270499.name: Frost Shock
270499.text: Freezes the target, inflicting Frost damage and reducing their movement speed by 25% for 15 sec.

270502.name: Hunting Leap
270502.text: Reban jumps towards a targeted player, inflicting Physical damage and additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. Reban then follows up with a series of gutripping attacks, inflicting Physical to players in a cone with each attack.

270514.name: Seismic Upheaval
270514.text: Inflicts Physical damage to nearby players and knocks them high into the air.

270889.name: Overload
270889.text: Channels beams of lightning around the caster every 0.3 sec. For 4 sec.

270901.name: Unholy Mending
270901.text: Harnesses profane regeneration, causing them to heal 7% health every 2 sec. For 10 sec.

270920.name: Bind Soul
270920.text: Binds the target's soul, charming them for 10 sec or until they would be killed.

270927.name: Bladestorm
270927.text: Moves towards a targeted player in a whirl of blades, inflicting Physical damage every 0.5 sec. To nearby players.

271290.name: Open Coffin
271290.text: Opens one of the crypts, releasing the occupant. Each open coffin reduces the time required to open subsequent coffins.

271555.name: Entomb
271555.text: Entombs the target within one of the crypts inside the chamber, and begins channeling Wail of Mourning until the target is released.

271561.name: Wail of Mourning
271561.text:
Channels a wail of mourning, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec., this damage increasing with time.

Releasing the interred player will stop this ability.

271563.name: Embalming Fluid
271563.text: Inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec. And slows the target's movement by 30% for 4 sec. These effects stack.

272654.name: Head Butt
272654.text: The creature inflicts Physical damage to their current target.

272655.name: Scouring Sand
272655.text: The caster exhales a cone of sand, inflicting Nature damage to players in a frontal cone and disorienting them for 4 sec.

273225.name: Volley
273225.text: The caster fires a volley of arrows at the target location, inflicting Physical damage to all units near the impact.

273241.name: Wall of Sparks
273241.text: The caster summons forth a Wall of Sparks that move across the battlefield. Any players caught in their path suffer Nature damage.

371471.name: Shape Earth
371471.text: Shaping the earthen body of an elemental.

371984.name: Frostbolt
371984.text: The creature inflicts Frost damage to a player.

372047.name: Steel Barrage
372047.text:
A flurry of strikes inflicts Physical damage to the current enemy target every 0.5 sec for 3 sec.

Each strike causes a flaming nova that inflicts Fire damage to players nearby and creates a fragment.

372087.name: Blazing Rush
372087.text:
Rushes to an enemy target in a whirl of steel, inflicting Fire damage to all enemies in the path of this ability.

Enemies damaged by this ability bleed for Physical damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

372107.name: Molten Boulder
372107.text:
Kokia slams a molten boulder into the ground in front of her, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby. Any player it touches takes Fire damage and gets knocked back.

The boulder rolls forward up to yards and then explodes, inflicting damage to players nearby and leaving behind Scorched Earth.

372730.name: Crushing Smash
372730.text: The caster inflicts Physical damage and Nature damage to its current target.

372743.name: Ice Shield
372743.text:
The caster fortifies an ally with an icy shield every 3 sec for 15 sec.

The shield absorbs 5% of the caster's maximum health per application and prevents crowd controlling effects.

372793.name: Excavate
372793.text: Excavates earth in order to widen the Flashfrost incursion tunnel.

372808.name: Frigid Shard
372808.text: Melidrussa launches a shard of ice that inflicts Physical damage to her current target.

372820.name: Scorched Earth
372820.text: The scorched ground inflicts Fire damage to players within the flames every 1 sec.

372851.name: Chillstorm
372851.text:
Melidrussa summons a storm of frost at a player's location that pulls players towards the.

Every 1.5 sec, the storm inflicts Frost damage to all players.

After 7 sec the storm explodes, inflicting Frost damage to all players and pushing them away.

372858.name: Searing Blows
372858.text: Kokia strikes her target times over 3 sec, inflicting 150% weapon damage and applying Searing Wounds with each strike.

372860.name: Searing Wounds
372860.text: Each strike from Searing Blows causes the victim's skin to blister and melt, inflicting Fire damage every 0.5 sec for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

372863.name: Ritual of Blazebinding
372863.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Kokia summons a Blazebound Firestorm at a player's location, searing players nearby for Fire damage.

372988.name: Ice Bulwark
372988.text: Ice Bulwark absorbs 10% of Melidrussa's maximum health.

373017.name: Blaze Volley
373017.text: The Blazebound Firestorm blasts all players with flames, inflicting Fire damage.

373046.name: Awaken Whelps
373046.text: Melidrussa calls upon her Infused Whelps to join the fight.

373087.name: Burnout
373087.text: When its health is depleted, the Blazebound Firestorm goes out with a bang, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby and leaving behind Scorched Earth.

373614.name: Burnout
373614.text: When its health is depleted, the caster goes out with a bang, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby.

373680.name: Frost Overload
373680.text:
Melidrussa pulses frost energy, encasing herself in an Ice Bulwark.

While Ice Bulwark holds, she inflicts Frost damage every 1.5 sec to all players and increases damage taken from this ability by 5% for 3 sec. This effect stacks.

373692.name: Inferno
373692.text: The caster inflicts Fire damage to players within yds and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

373693.name: Living Bomb
373693.text:
The caster inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

The affliction explodes upon expiration, inflicting Fire damage to players within yds and knocking them into the air.

373727.name: Frost Infusion
373727.text: Infuses whelps with primal Frost energy.

373972.name: Blaze of Glory
373972.text: The creature becomes a whirlwind of flame before dying, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby and launching a volley of embers every 3 sec for 15 sec that inflict Fire damage to any players hit.

381512.name: Stormslam
381512.text: Erkhart delivers a massive blow to a player, inflicting Physical damage and Nature damage, and additionally increasing Nature damage taken by 100% for. This effect stacks.

381516.name: Interrupting Cloudburst
381516.text: Erkhart conjures a massive torrent, inflicting Nature damage to all players and interrupting casts for.

381517.name: Winds of Change
381517.text: Erkhart conjures a localized hurricane, inflicting Nature damage every sec for, pushing players and Kyrakka's Flaming Embers.

381525.name: Roaring Firebreath
381525.text: Kyrakka forges flames in a frontal direction, tempering targets for Fire damage every 1 sec for.

381602.name: Inferno Spit
381602.text:
Kyrakka spits a gout of fire, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for.

Upon removal, these flames explode, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby, creating Flaming Embers.

384024.name: Hailbombs
384024.text:
The frosty mine explodes upon contact with a player, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and knocking them upward.

Additionally, these mines reduce the haste of victims by 50% for 20 sec.

384139.name: Summon Scorchlings
384139.text: Summon Scorchlings to attack an enemy.

384194.name: Cinderbolt
384194.text: The creature inflicts Fire damage to a player.

384773.name: Flaming Embers
384773.text: Burning embers char the ground, inflicting Fire damage every sec to players within them.

384823.name: Inferno
384823.text: The Blazebound Firestorm inflicts Fire damage to all players and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

384933.name: Ice Shield
384933.text:
The caster fortifies an ally with an icy shield every 3 sec for 15 sec.

The shield absorbs 5% of the caster's maximum health per application and prevents crowd controlling effects.

385311.name: Thunderstorm
385311.text: Inflicts Nature damage to players within yds and knocks them back.

385312.name: Gathering Storm
385312.text: Able to cast Thunderstorm at energy.

385313.name: Lightning Rod
385313.text:
The caster causes a player to be struck by lightning, inflicting Nature damage every 1.5 sec.

Upon expiration, a massive strike inflicts Nature damage.

385536.name: Flaming Barrage
385536.text: The creature throws flaming knives at its current target every 1 sec for 10 sec, inflicting Fire damage and Physical damage.

391031.name: Stormcloud Barrier
391031.text:
The creature shrouds itself in an elemental shield equal to 85% of their total health.

Upon removal, the creature explodes with a Stormcloud Detonation.

391723.name: Flame Breath
391723.text: Flamegullet breathes flames towards a player, inflicting Fire damage to players in a frontal cone every 0.5 sec for 3 sec.

391726.name: Storm Breath
391726.text: Thunderhead breathes lightning towards a player, inflicting Nature damage to players in a frontal cone every 0.5 sec for 3 sec.

392394.name: Fire Maw
392394.text: Flamegullet tears into his current target with fiery fangs, inflicting Physical damage and Fire damage, plus an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

392395.name: Thunder Jaw
392395.text: Thunderhead tears into the target with thundering fangs, inflicting Physical damage, plus Nature damage and knocking them back.

392399.name: Stormcloud Detonation
392399.text: The creature blitzes towards a player nearby, dying in a blast that inflicts Nature damage to players nearby.

392406.name: Thunderous Stomp
392406.text: The caster inflicts Nature damage to enemies nearby.

392569.name: Molten Blood
392569.text: While below 50% health, Flamegullet oozes burning blood that inflicts Fire damage to players within yds every 3 sec. This damage is increased by 15% with each cast. This effect has a maximum of applications.

392576.name: Thunder Blast
392576.text: The Tempest Channeler calls thunder down upon their target, inflicting Nature damage.

392640.name: Rolling Thunder
392640.text:
Thunderhead electrocutes players, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 45 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon removal of this affliction, Electrical Discharge surges into players.

396044.name: Hailburst
396044.text: Melidrussa unleashes a frost wave that inflicts Frost damage to all players and launches Hailbombs at them.

473898.name: Legion Strike
473898.text: Xathuux the Annihilator performs a powerful swing with his axe that inflicts Physical damage and reduces healing received by 80% for 8 sec.

474197.name: Demonic Rage
474197.text: Xathuux the Annihilator flies into a Demonic Rage, inflicting Chaos damage to all players. While this effect is active, Xathuux gains 75% attack speed, suffers 30% increased incoming damage, and gains Burning Steps for 15 sec.

474234.name: Burning Steps
474234.text: Xathuux the Annihilator spreads fel magic across the ground from his feet inflicting Fire damage every sec to any players standing in it.

474238.name: Illicit Infusion
474238.text: Kystia reinfuses Nibbles with fel magic, turning her hostile towards players.

474375.name: Chaos Bolt
474375.text: Lithiel Cinderfury unleashes a devastating blast inflicting Chaos damage.

474462.name: Fingers of Gul'dan
474462.text: Lithiel Cinderfury calls down demonic magic to each nearby enemy inflicting Shadowflame damage to all enemies within yds of each target. Wild Imps to burst from the impact sites and attack nearby targets.

474478.name: Killing Spree
474478.text: Zaen unleashes a rapid barrage of gunfire, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 0.5 sec over 3 sec. This attack ignores armor.

474515.name: Heartstop Poison
474515.text: A lethal poison that reduces the target's maximum health by 30% and inflicts Nature damage over 15 sec.

474766.name: Same-Day Delivery
474766.text: Zaen calls upon the warehouse workers above to throw Forbidden Freight at players, causing Fire damage on impact and knocking them away.

474768.name: Delivery!
474768.text: Zaen calls upon the warehouse workers above to throw Forbidden Freight at players, causing Fire damage on impact and knocking them away.

1201554.name: Seduction
1201554.text: The sayaad seduces the target, disorienting them for 6 sec.

1213658.name: Unsatisfied Customer
1213658.text: Clearly unhappy with the service around here.

1214260.name: Elated!
1214260.text: This patron is satisfied with their service.

1214357.name: Fire Bomb
1214357.text: Zaen hurls a ticking bomb at a player. After 6 sec the bomb explodes, dealing Fire damage to players nearby and destroying any Forbidden Freight caught in the blast.

1214487.name: Awaiting Service
1214487.text: This patron is waiting for their order.

1214641.name: Axe Toss
1214641.text: Xathuux hurls a massive flaming axe at a target and inflicts Fire damage and interrupts targets near the impact.

1214650.name: Fel Lightning
1214650.text: Xathuux the Annihilator's axe channels beams of fel lightning at all players inflicting Chaos damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

1214675.name: Demonic Gateway
1214675.text: Lithiel Cinderfury creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway and prevents initial damage and Fire vulnerability from Malefic Wave.

1214922.name: Fel Rage
1214922.text: Reduces the caster's damage taken by 60% and make them immune to crowd control effects for 1 min.

1214959.name: Chaotic Burst
1214959.text:
The light infusion stuns Kystia for 20 sec, bringing her attacks to a halt, increasing all damage she takes by 115%, and expelling bursts of fel magic that inflict Chaos damage to all players every 1 sec.

Additionally, this reduces the effectiveness of Kystia's Felshield.

1214966.name: Fel Infused
1214966.text: Releases fel energy upon death inflicting Fire damage to all enemies within yds.

1214980.name: Health Funnel
1214980.text:
Heals target for 10% of their max health every 2 sec for 30 sec.

Caster loses 5% of their max health every 2 sec.

1215961.name: Fel Beam
1215961.text: Beams of Fel magic inflict Fire damage every sec to enemies they come into contact with.

1216074.name: Spill Zone
1216074.text: A mess of spilled drinks and food, reducing movement speed by 70%. Gross!

1216076.name: Nauseous
1216076.text: This patron's stomach is in upheaval.

1216284.name: Stealth
1216284.text: Puts the caster in stealth mode.

1216300.name: Cutpurse
1216300.text: The caster leaps to a nearby enemy to pickpocket them, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Bleed damage over 8 sec.

1216529.name: Shield Bash
1216529.text: The guard slams their shield against the target, inflicting Physical damage, and increasing Physical damage taken by 20% for 20 sec.

1216538.name: Fel Detonation
1216538.text: The caster explodes upon death, inflicting Fire damage to all enemies within yds.

1216571.name: Fel Missiles
1216571.text: Launches disorderly missiles at an enemy, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

1216589.name: Heartstop Poison
1216589.text: The caster coats their weapons with a lethal venom for 8 sec that causes each strike to poison the enemy for Nature damage over 8 sec and reduce their maximum health by 5%. This effect stacks.

1216954.name: Eye Beam
1216954.text: Inflicts Chaos damage to enemies in front of the caster.

1216970.name: Back to Work!
1216970.text: Increases attack speed of Warehouse Workers in combat nearby by 200% for 20 sec.

1217099.name: Fel-Infused Freight
1217099.text: A shipment that is barely containing the volatile magic within, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 3 sec.

1217345.name: Malefic Wave
1217345.text:
Lithiel Cinderfury conjures a Felshield and then projects a wave of fel fire. Impacted players suffer Fire damage every 1 sec and take 50% additional fire damage for 1 min. This effect stacks.

Demons struck by Malefic Wave are granted Malefic Empowerment.

1217415.name: Felshield
1217415.text: Lithiel enshrouds herself in a fel barrier, reducing the damage she takes by 50% for 10 sec.

1217464.name: Illicit Infusion
1217464.text: Kystia infuses Nibbles with fel magic.

1217633.name: Corroding Spittle
1217633.text: The wyrm spits at their current target, inflicting Fire damage immediately and Fire damage every 3 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

1217881.name: Shadow Bite
1217881.text: Melee attacks inflict additional Shadow damage to target enemy.

1217930.name: Imprison
1217930.text: The caster imprisons the demon, incapacitating them.

1217973.name: Curse of Doom
1217973.text: Inflicts impending doom upon the target, inflicting Shadow damage after 10.1 sec, spread among all enemies near target.

1217989.name: Felshield
1217989.text: Kystia enshrouds herself in a fel barrier, reducing the damage she takes by ${(*)}%.

1217992.name: Workplace Accident
1217992.text: The caster throws the shipment at a nearby target, dealing Physical damage nearby and stunning for 3 sec.

1218347.name: Murder in a Row
1218347.text: Zaen takes a few precious moments to take aim at all players. When he is ready to fire, he shoots all players in his line of sight, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Bleed damage over 15 sec.

1218465.name: Server
1218465.text: Patrons request a random food or drink refreshment upon taking a seat, and will await your service for a short duration before becoming frustrated. Some patrons are impatient and will require your service quickly.

1218466.name: Cleaner
1218466.text: Gather the enchanted broom and then move towards messes and spills to keep the Illicit Rain clean!

1218467.name: Entertainer
1218467.text: Elevate the atmosphere of the Illicit Rain with a performance they'll never forget. Put on your dancing shoes, and gather notes of rhythm to stay on beat. Gathering multiple notes in rapid succession will improve the performance of your coworkers too!

1218468.name: Bouncer
1218468.text: Rowdy patrons occasionally show up and throw a temper tantrum, ruining the atmosphere of the Illicit Rain. Punt rowdy patrons towards the exit to force them to leave.

1218508.name: Disguised
1218508.text: Disguises the target as an Illicit Rain employee.

1222100.name: Nether Dash
1222100.text: The Ethereal Shade dashes through its target, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 15 sec to players hit.

1222484.name: Poison Pool
1222484.text: Atroxus's acidic venom inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec to players standing within it and applies Mind-Numbing Poison for 5 sec.

1222519.name: Provoke Creeper
1222519.text: Atroxus agitates the surrounding pools, causing a Toxic Creeper to emerge and attack players.

1222598.name: Murder in a Row
1222598.text: Zaen takes a few precious moments to take aim at all players. When he is ready to fire, he shoots all players in his line of sight, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Bleed damage over 15 sec.

1222642.name: Hulking Claw
1222642.text: Atroxus delivers a powerful blow to a player that inflicts Nature damage with an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

1222692.name: Toxic Aura
1222692.text: The Toxic Creeper radiates a toxic cloud that inflicts Nature damage every sec to players within yards.

1222721.name: Noxious Breath
1222721.text: Atroxus breathes out Noxious Fumes in front of itself, inflicting Nature damage to players struck.

1222795.name: Envenom
1222795.text: Zaen drives a poisoned blade in deep at his current target, inflicting Physical damage and applying Heartstop Poison.

1223204.name: Felfire Burst
1223204.text: Inflicts Fire damage to an enemy.

1223906.name: Fel Nova
1223906.text: Kystia teleports to a random player's location and sends out an explosive wave of destructive energy, inflicting Fire damage to nearby players and knocking them back.

1226120.name: Poison Splash
1226120.text:
Atroxus splashes poison around itself, inflicting Nature damage to all enemies every 1 sec. 

The poison glob inflicts Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 5 sec to players struck. Each impact creates a poison pool for 1 min.

1226469.name: Malefic Empowerment
1226469.text: Empowered by Malefic Wave, increasing haste by 100%.

1227020.name: Dimensional Shred
1227020.text: Teleports behind its target and viciously strikes them inflicting Shadow damage.

1227197.name: Cosmic Crash
1227197.text: Charonus crashes void comets at players' locations, inflicting Shadow damage to players near impact and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 20 sec and knocking them back.

1227247.name: Void Cascade
1227247.text: Charonus projects condensed cosmic power toward nearby players. Players coming into contact with this energy suffer Shadow damage and are knocked away.

1228198.name: Corroding Spittle
1228198.text: Nibbles spits at players, inflicting Fire damage immediately and Fire damage every 3 sec for 30 sec.

1230298.name: Chaos Barrage
1230298.text: Kystia unleashes a devastating blast of chaos at her current target, dealing Chaos damage and then jumping to nearby players at reduced effectiveness.

1230304.name: Light Infusion
1230304.text: When Nibbles is drained of fel magic she reverts to her light form. While in her light form, Nibbles attempts to purge the fel from Kystia with an infusion of light.

1231256.name: Infernal Rage
1231256.text: Stuns all enemies nearby, rendering them unable to move or attack and grants Immolation Aura.

1231262.name: Felfire Core
1231262.text: Inflicts Fire damage to nearby enemies every sec.

1232012.name: Serrated Fists
1232012.text: The Hoardmonger gathers from his bone pile, granting him access to Bonespike Slam.

1233264.name: Blisterburst
1233264.text: Charges to the target's location and explodes inflicting Fire damage to enemies nearby.

1233398.name: Mad Shriek
1233398.text: Fears enemies near the caster for 6 sec.

1233472.name: Rip and Slice
1233472.text: Charges to the location of a target before repeatedly cleaving with melee strikes for 6 sec inflicting Shadow damage to enemies nearby.

1233535.name: Shred Defense
1233535.text: Inflicts Physical damage to an enemy and increasess all damage they take by 20% for 10 sec.

1234021.name: Earthshatter Slam
1234021.text: The Hoardmonger slams the ground, inflicting Nature damage to players in a frontal cone.

1234233.name: Spoiled Supplies
1234233.text: The Hoardmonger reaches into his sack and tosses rotten food over 7 sec, impacting targeted players for Nature damage or littering s around the arena.

1234314.name: Snowdrift
1234314.text: Upon defeat, the Fractured Shivercore forms a pile of deep snow at its location. Players standing within have their movement speed reduced by 40% and are immune to forced movement effects.

1234681.name: Ravenous Bellow
1234681.text: The Hoardmonger lets out a mighty roar, inflicting Physical damage to all players and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 10 sec. Ignores armor.

1234753.name: Bedrock Slam
1234753.text: Meittik strikes their primary target with immense force, inflicting Nature damage and Physical damage. The force of the impact ruptures nearby topsoil, creating patches of Fertile Loam.

1234802.name: Fertile Loam
1234802.text: Unearthed subsoil slows players standing within the effect by 50% and inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec.

1234833.name: Ravenous Swarm
1234833.text: Projects a swarm of biting insects to the location of the target inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to any enemies in the nearby area.

1234846.name: Toxic Spores
1234846.text: Rotten Mushrooms apply a noxious cloud, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 12 sec. This effect stacks.

1234850.name: Lightsower Dash
1234850.text: Lekshi dashes between patches of Fertile Loam, inflicting Holy damage to players in their path and sowing a Lightblossom at each destination.

1234855.name: Insidious Aura
1234855.text: Inflicts Nature damage to all enemies near the caster every 2 sec for 8 sec.

1234890.name: Smashing Charge
1234890.text: Charges forward inflicting Physical damage and knocking back players.

1235072.name: Resourceful Measures
1235072.text: The Hoardmonger gathers from the nearest pile of resources, replacing one of his abilities with a new one.

1235079.name: Satiated
1235079.text: The Hoardmonger gathers from his pile of meat, granting him access to Hearty Bellow.

1235105.name: Overflowing Supplies
1235105.text:
Gathering from his pile of mushrooms, the Hoardmonger gains Overflowing Supplies.

This effect increases the amount of s thrown during Spoiled Supplies.

1235125.name: Hearty Bellow
1235125.text:
Gathering from his pile of meat, the Hoardmonger unlocks Hearty Bellow.

The Hoardmonger lets out a mighty roar, inflicting Physical damage to all players and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 10 sec and knocking them back. Ignores armor.

1235129.name: Bonespike Slam
1235129.text:
Gathering from his pile of bones, the Hoardmonger unlocks Bonespike Slam.

The Hoardmonger slams the ground, inflicting Nature damage to players in a frontal cone. This additionally creates bone spikes for 45 sec which apply Bonespiked upon contact.

1235405.name: Bonespiked
1235405.text: Broken bones litter the ground, inflicting Physical damage every 0.5 sec and reducing movement speed by 50%.

1235548.name: Glacial Torment
1235548.text: The Sentinel of Winter assaults players with freezing temperatures, inflicting Frost damage every 2 sec for 16 sec.

1235564.name: Lightblossom Beam
1235564.text:
Kezkitt channels a beam of light on each Lightblossom Seed, inflicting Holy damage every 2 sec to players standing in the effect. The powerful beam rapidly germinates the seed, applying stacks of. After 8 sec, the blossom casts Lightbloom Overgrowth.

Standing within the beam stifles the seed's growth and prevents applications of.

1235616.name: Light Bolt
1235616.text: Kezkitt inflicts Holy damage to a player.

1235623.name: Raging Squall
1235623.text: The Sentinel of Winter creates Raging Squalls, inflicting Frost damage to players near the impact location. These squalls wander the arena for 90 sec, inflicting Frost damage to players it hits and knocking them back.

1235640.name: Thornblade
1235640.text: Lekshi ambushes a player and backstabs them, inflicting Nature damage and causing them to bleed for Physical damage every 2 sec for 12 sec.

1235641.name: Raging Squall
1235641.text: The Sentinel of Winter creates Raging Squalls, inflicting Frost damage to players near the impact location. These squalls wander the arena for 90 sec, inflicting Frost damage to players it hits and knocking them back.

1235656.name: Frozen Tempest
1235656.text:
The Sentinel of Winter manifests a massive storm, inflicting Frost damage to all players every 1 sec, pushing them away.

Players outside of the eye of the storm suffer an additional Frost damage every 1 sec.

1235752.name: Lightbloom Overgrowth
1235752.text: The fully cultivated Lightblossom surges with energy, inflicting Holy damage to all players every 1 sec for 8 sec. Devoid of nutrients, patches of Fertile Loam wither into Light-Scorched Earth.

1235783.name: Shattering Frostspike
1235783.text: The Sentinel of Winter slams the ice, forming 2 icicles which splinter, inflicting Frost damage to players near targeted locations, revealing a Fractured Shivercore.

1235828.name: Light-Scorched Earth
1235828.text: The charred earth inflicts Holyfire damage every 1 sec to players standing within the effect.

1235829.name: Winter's Shroud
1235829.text: The Fractured Shivercore blankets players with the chill of Winter, inflicting Frost damage to all players, increasing their Frost damage taken by 10% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

1236289.name: Blizzard's Wrath
1236289.text: The Sentinel of Winter surrounds the arena in a massive blizzard, inflicting Frost damage to players standing within.

1236709.name: Thorncaller Roar
1236709.text: Ikuzz roars, inflicting Nature damage to all players while erupt around it every 2 sec for 6 sec.

1236746.name: Verdant Stomp
1236746.text: Ikuzz stomps, inflicting Physical damage to all players and knocking them back. After 4 sec, emerge at players' locations.

1237073.name: Lightcrazed Frenzy
1237073.text: Ikuzz fully absorbs the power of the Lightbloom, increasing its movement speed by 20% and causing it to pulse Holy damage every 2 sec.

1237093.name: Crushing Footfalls
1237093.text: While fixating on a target, Ikuzz's massive footfalls inflict Nature damage to players and crush any nearby every 1 sec.

1237166.name: Incise
1237166.text: Upon reaching its prey, Ikuzz chomps down on the player, causing them to bleed Physical damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

1237330.name: Bloodthorn Roots
1237330.text: Roots emerge from the ground, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players and rooting them in place until destroyed.

1237855.name: Earthrupture Strike
1237855.text: The Rutaani slashes their target with immense force, inflicting Physical damage and creating Ruptured Earth that inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec and slows players by 40%.

1237858.name: Ruptured Earth
1237858.text: The Rutaani slashes their target with immense force, inflicting Physical damage and creating Ruptured Earth that inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec and slows players by 40%.

1238053.name: Mother's Wrath
1238053.text: The cub lets out a cry angering nearby bears nearby, increasing their damage dealt by 50% and their movement speed by 50% for 1 min. This effect stacks.

1238063.name: Light Bolt
1238063.text: The caster launches light energy at a target, inflicting Holy damage.

1238066.name: Thornblade
1238066.text: The caster appears behind a target and backstabs them, inflicting Nature damage and causing them to bleed an additional Physical damage every 2 sec for 8 sec.

1238084.name: Spore Spines
1238084.text:
Pollen from the lasher's melee attacks linger on the target, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec and slowing them by 2% for 16 sec.

This effect stacks.

1238158.name: Lightbloom Pollination
1238158.text: The caster envelops itself in a cloud of pollen, absorbing damage taken and becoming immune to crowd controlling effects. Nearby allies gain Pollen Surge, increasing their attack speed by 50% and heals them for 5% of their max heatlh every 3 sec. This effect persists for 1 min or until the shield is removed.

1238173.name: Pollen Surge
1238173.text: Attack speed is increased by 50% and heals for 5% of max health every 3 sec by a nearby ally's Lightbloom Pollination.

1238200.name: Frantic Blooming
1238200.text: The caster frantically looks for aid, channeling on dormant nearby lashers for 8 sec. When the channel finishes, the lashers awaken and attack players.

1238232.name: Seed Shot
1238232.text: The caster spits a seed at a target, inflicting Nature damage on impact.

1238294.name: Disorienting Screech
1238294.text: The caster emits a piercing cry, disorienting enemies for 3 sec.

1238368.name: Lightmaw Beams
1238368.text: Each of the caster's heads beams down light energy at a target, inflicting Holy damage to players near their location every 1 sec for 6 sec.

1238439.name: Razor Dive
1238439.text: The caster jumps to a player and rips them with their beak, causing them to bleed Physical damage every 1 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

1238581.name: Spiny Shield
1238581.text: The caster's prickly exoskeleton absorbs damage and inflicts Nature damage back on attackers.

1238642.name: Bullet Seeds
1238642.text: The caster pelts explosive seeds that inflict Nature damage to players within the effect.

1238687.name: Feast of Misery
1238687.text: The caster siphons the essence of all players to satiate its hunger, inflicting Shadow damage and healing itself for ${*100}% of that amount every 1 sec for 5 sec.

1238760.name: Starvation Effigy
1238760.text: The totem drives players into an insatiable hunger, reducing their maximum health by 15% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

1238801.name: Insatiable Hunger
1238801.text: The totem drives players into an insatiable hunger, reducing their maximum health by 15% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

1239394.name: Scavenge
1239394.text: The eagle flies down and attempts to steal the nearby berry bush!

1239821.name: Warden's Wrath
1239821.text: Ruia blasts his current target with a bolt of energy, inflicting Nature damage.

1239824.name: Lightfire
1239824.text:
Ruia shoots a beam of energy at a player, burning them for Radiant damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

Upon expiration, emerge at the afflicted player's location.

1239856.name: Sky Strike
1239856.text: Charges to a nearby target and inflicts Nature damage to all enemies nearby, shared among all enemies impacted. The charge also knock all enemies impacted in the air.

1239860.name: Cryo Surge
1239860.text: The revenant sends a chilling surge through a player, inflicting damage to players nearby.

1239882.name: Shapeshift: Moonkin
1239882.text: Ruia shapeshifts into his moonkin form.

1239883.name: Shapeshift: Haranir
1239883.text: Ruia shapeshifts into his Haranir form.

1239885.name: Shapeshift: Bear
1239885.text: Ruia shapeshifts into his bear form.

1239919.name: Lightfire Beams
1239919.text: Standing within the beams inflicts Radiant damage every 1 sec and silences players for 6 sec.

1240100.name: Lightfall
1240100.text: Ruia calls down waves of falling Light energy, inflicting Holy damage to players near the impact.

1240210.name: Pulverizing Strikes
1240210.text: Ruia marks several targets and launches a wave of force toward each of them in a frontal cone every 2 sec for 6 sec. Each impact inflicts Physical damage to players within the effect and applies Pulverized.

1241058.name: Grievous Thrash
1241058.text: Ruia thrashes about, inflicting Physical damage to players and causing them to bleed an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 40 sec or until fully healed. This effect stacks.

1241067.name: Spirits of the Vale
1241067.text: Ruia calls upon the spirits, casting Lightfire, Lightfall, Pulverizing Strikes, and Grievous Thrash every 8 sec until he is defeated.

1241214.name: Earth Bolt
1241214.text: The caster launches a bolt of earth at the target, inflicting Nature damage.

1241217.name: Shredding Claws
1241217.text: Melee attacks have a chance to shred the target's armor, reducing their armor for 2 sec. This effect stacks.

1241226.name: Bloodrush
1241226.text: The wolf senses nearby blood and enters a craze, increasing movement speed and attack speed by 60% for 10 sec.

1241463.name: Glacial Tomb
1241463.text: The avatar encases all players in a frozen tomb, inflicting Frost damage every 2 sec until it's destroyed.

1242135.name: Grievous Gash
1242135.text: The thornmaw rends its target, inflicting Physical damage and causing them to bleed an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 16 sec or until fully healed. This effect stacks.

1242138.name: Solar Breath
1242138.text: The thornmaw expels light energy in a frontal cone, inflicting Holy damage to players within the effect.

1242200.name: Lightwarden's Blight
1242200.text: Upon death the light-infused creature explodes, inflicting Holy damage to nearby players and creating a pool of.

1242244.name: Blight Propagation
1242244.text: Ruia channels light energy into nearby allies, applying Lightwarden's Blight.

1242860.name: Echoing Maul
1242860.text: Nalorakk marks players for 4 sec, then sends an Echo of Nalorakk to their position. All Echoes of Nalorakk immediately inflict Nature damage to players nearby.

1243002.name: Fury of the War God
1243002.text:
Nalorakk headbutts Zul'jarra into a Concussive Shock, then commands the Echoes of Nalorakk to charge her position. These collide with the first target encountered casting Echoing Fury.

Any Echo of Nalorakk that reaches Zul'jarra triggers Demoralizing Scream. Each Echo remains for one additional Fury of the War God, then vanishes.

1243018.name: Concussive Shock
1243018.text: Nalorakk disables Zul'jarra with a hefty blow. Unable to defend herself, she stands vulnerable to Nalorakk's echoes.

1243078.name: Burden of War
1243078.text: Dawning the Mantle serves as an extreme hindrance, increasing damage taken.

1243408.name: Echoing Fury
1243408.text: The charging Echo of Nalorakk ravages the first target in their path, inflicting Nature damage.

1245186.name: Head Bash
1245186.text: Bashes a player, coating them with fel spittle that inflicts Fire damage periodically and knocks them back.

1245593.name: Putrid Burst
1245593.text: After sec the mushroom bursts, inflicting Nature damage, applying Toxic Spores to all players.

1246372.name: Awaken the Lightbloom
1246372.text:
Ziekket sows Light energy into the soil, sprouting Lightspawn Lashers and reawakening any that are.

Lashers reawaken with Vicious Regrowth.

1246527.name: Awaken the Lightbloom
1246527.text:
Ziekket sows Light energy into the soil, sprouting Lightspawn Lashers and reawakening any that are.

Lashers reawaken with Vicious Regrowth.

1246607.name: Concentrated Lightbeam
1246607.text:
Ziekket releases a powerful beam of Light energy, inflicting Holy damage every 0.5 sec to players within the effect.

Any Lightspawn Lashers hit by the beam are instantly liquified into puddles of Lightsap.

1246753.name: Lightsap
1246753.text: Viscous resin covers the ground, inflicting Holy damage every 2 sec to players standing within the effect and reducing their movement speed by 40%.

1246820.name: Magma Totem
1246820.text: The Magma Totem pulses searing magma, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 0.3 sec.

1246825.name: Searing Magma
1246825.text: The Magma Totem pulses searing magma, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 0.3 sec.

1246847.name: Shoot
1246847.text: Shoots at an enemy, inflicting Physical damage.

1246858.name: Lightbloom's Essence
1246858.text:
Ziekket draws out globules of Lightbloom energy from the earth that move toward him, triggering a Fluorescent Outburst upon reaching him.

The orbs instead burst when touched by players, granting that player.

1246865.name: Bestial Wrath
1246865.text: Sends the caster and its pet into a rage, increasing their damage done by 25% for 10 sec.

1246957.name: Primal Echo
1246957.text: The caster inflicts Physical damage to players nearby and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 3 sec. This effect stacks and ignores armor.

1246986.name: Poison Spear Volley
1246986.text: A volley of poison-tipped spears rains down, inflicting Nature damage to players standing yards of each impact area.

1247030.name: Poison Spear Volley
1247030.text: A volley of poison-tipped spears rains down, inflicting Nature damage to players standing yards of each impact area.

1247039.name: Fluorescent Outburst
1247039.text: Ziekket absorbs the Lightbloom's Essence, triggering a powerful reaction that inflicts Holy damage to all players. This effect grants Ziekket a Fluorescent Shield.

1247050.name: Fluorescent Shield
1247050.text: Ziekket becomes enveloped in Light energy, absorbing the next damage taken and increasing his damage done by 10%. This effect stacks.

1247377.name: Oozing Xylem
1247377.text: Ziekket gorges on Light energy, inflicting Holy damage to all players every 3 sec.

1247669.name: Lightspore Shot
1247669.text: The lasher spews at a player, inflicting Holy damage.

1247685.name: Thornspike
1247685.text: Ziekket impales the player with his spiked branch, inflicting Holy damage and knocking them back. The puncture wound causes the player to bleed an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

1248112.name: Unstable Singularity
1248112.text:
Charonus creates multiple singularities near himself. Each singularity inflicts Shadow damage periodically to all players and are slowly pulled toward the center.

Players pulled into the singularity are.

1249238.name: Fire Spit
1249238.text: Spits multiple fireballs that Inflict Fire damage and Fire every 1 sec for 10 sec to enemies near where they impact.

1249621.name: Violent Sand
1249621.text: The caster exhales a blast of sand, inflicting Nature damage to all enemies within and reduces their movement speed by 40% for 12 sec.

1249661.name: Feral Rage
1249661.text: Increases the melee haste of nearby allies by 20%.

1250021.name: Shell Guard
1250021.text: Reduces damage to nearby allies by 75%.

1250043.name: Melt Armor
1250043.text:
Inflicts Fire damage to all enemies near the caster periodically for 10 sec.

Causes an enemy to take increased Fire damage for 10 sec.

1250100.name: Tongue Toss
1250100.text: The Potatoad Matriarch lashes their target with its massive tongue, inflicting Physical damage and knocking them up and over.

1250199.name: Toadspawn
1250199.text: The Potatoad Matriarch spawns Potadpole Eggs that immediately begin to Hatch into Newborn Potadpoles.

1250203.name: Hatch
1250203.text: The Potatoad Egg hatches into a Newborn Potadpole.

1250640.name: Venomous Spit
1250640.text: The caster spits venom at the target's location, creating a pool of poison that inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

1250813.name: Hatch
1250813.text: The Potatoad Egg hatches into a Newborn Potadpole.

1250829.name: Potad-Toss
1250829.text: The Newborn Potadpole enthusiastically leaps at a player, inflicting Physical damage and knocking them back.

1250937.name: Toxic Spew
1250937.text: The Potatoad Matriarch belches corrosive toxins, inflicting Nature damage to all players. The poisonous fluid inflicts an additional Nature damage every 1.5 sec for 9 sec.

1251027.name: Gravely Wounded
1251027.text: Nanea is severely wounded after the battle.

1252406.name: Dreadbellow
1252406.text: The sentinel unleashes a dark roar, knocking back all players and inflicting Shadow damage to them every 1 sec for 12 sec.

1253028.name: Thicket's Trinity
1253028.text: Meittik, Lekshi, and Kezkitt are bonded, causing them to share all damage taken.

1253320.name: Vicious Regrowth
1253320.text: Lightspawn Lashers reawaken with renewed power, increasing their haste and damage done by 20%. This effect also makes them immune to interrupts and crowd controlling effects.

1253410.name: Bloodthirsty Gaze
1253410.text:
The Devilsaptor fixates on a player, pursuing them for 10 sec. Upon reaching their target, the Devilsaptor will Incise them.

While fixated, the Devilsaptor gains Crushing Footfalls.

1253811.name: Fel Spray
1253811.text: Nibbles unleashes a spray of fel magic in a cone in front of her, dealing Fire damage to players caught in the spray every 1 sec for 5 sec.

1254622.name: Watchful Gaze
1254622.text: Nalorak watches and waits in anticipation for the final trial.

1255205.name: Uproot
1255205.text: The caster summons massive roots at players' locations, inflicting Nature damage and knocking them back.

1255577.name: Spectral Slash
1255577.text: The echo slashes at nearby players, knocking them back. The slash lingers on player, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 12 sec. This effect stacks.

1256276.name: Deep Corruption
1256276.text: Increases nearby allies' damage dealt by 25% and reduces area of effect damage taken by 25%.

1256299.name: Over-infused
1256299.text: Triggers Burning Fel every 3 sec. Releases a massive burst of fel energy upon death.

1256300.name: Massive Fel Detonation
1256300.text: The caster explodes upon death, inflicting Fire damage to all enemies within yds.

1257094.name: Pulverized
1257094.text: Upon being struck by Pulverizing Strikes, players take 100% increased damage from Pulverizing Strikes for 6 sec.

1257877.name: Scathing Review
1257877.text: The caster attempts to write a scathing review about the Illicit Rain. If the caster is interrupted, the spell backfires and forces them to leave.

1258537.name: Summon Wyrms
1258537.text: The caster summons a Tiny Felwyrm every 0.3 sec for 1 sec.

1259365.name: Bloodthorn Roots
1259365.text: Roots emerge from the ground, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players and rooting them in place until destroyed.

1261011.name: Fan Of Thorns
1261011.text: Lekshi unleashes a flurry of thorns, inflicting Nature damage to players near their location every 1 sec for 3 sec.

1261776.name: Defensive Stance
1261776.text: When Nalorakk casts, Zul'jarra creates a protective barrier reducing damage taken from by 80% to players behind her.

1262253.name: Demoralizing Scream
1262253.text:
Zul'jarra cries out in pain from the undefended attack, inflicting Physical damage to all players. Ignores armor.

Players feel the weight of her burden, increasing damage taken by 10% for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

1262497.name: Monstrous Roar
1262497.text:
Atroxus lets out a powerful roar, inflicting Physical damage to all players, this attack ignores armor.

The roar agitates a nearby poison pool, causing a Toxic Creeper to emerge.

1263590.name: Rimeshatter
1263590.text:
The Fractured Shivercore bursts releasing ice shards that impact 6 sec later inflicting Frost damage to players nearby.

If no players are struck the shard fragments cause a Rime Detonation.

1263597.name: Rime Detonation
1263597.text: Inflicts Frost damage to all players and roots them in place for 4 sec.

1263636.name: Belch Spores
1263636.text: The caster spews spores every 1.5 sec for 3 sec that inflict Nature damage to players standing in the impact.

1263971.name: Mind-Numbing Poison
1263971.text: Poison numbs the mind of the afflicted player, reducing their Haste by 30% for 5 sec.

1263983.name: Condensed Mass
