1263983.text: Gravitic Orbs fixate a player, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing their movement speed by 2%. This effect stacks.

1263984.name: Unstable Singularity
1263984.text:
Charonus creates multiple singularities near himself. Each singularity inflicts Shadow damage periodically to all players and are slowly pulled toward the center.

Players pulled into the singularity are.

1264095.name: Mirror Images
1264095.text: Kystia creates copies of herself nearby, each of which cast Felstorm.

1264106.name: Felstorm
1264106.text: Kystia's mirror image engulfs the arena in fel fire, inflicting Fire damage to all nearby players every 1 sec.

1265400.name: Frostbite
1265400.text: The caster bites the target, inflicting Frost damage.

1266178.name: Snowdrift
1266178.text: Upon defeat the Glacial Revenant forms a pile of deep snow at its location. Players standing within have their movement speed reduced by 40% and are immune to forced movement effects.

1266207.name: Reposition
1266207.text: The Beasttamer repositions closer to an enemy.

1266241.name: Freight Explosion
1266241.text: Upon being hit by a Fire Bomb or Murder in a Row, Forbidden Freight explode after 5 sec, inflicting Fire damage to nearby players, knocking them away.

1267029.name: Call The Grove
1267029.text: The caster frantically runs toward any nearby dormant lashers.

1267894.name: Savage Leap
1267894.text: Leaps at a nearby enemy, stabbing them with both weapons inflicting Physical damage and causes them to bleed for additional Physical damage every 1 sec for5 sec.

1269866.name: Void Tentacles
1269866.text: Attacks inflict Shadow damage to the enemy.

1271385.name: Spouting Floret
1271385.text: The caster ejects Light energy from its blossoms, inflicting Holy damage to players nearby every 2 sec for 6 sec.

1272265.name: Mangling Claws
1272265.text: While in Bear form, Lightwarden Ruia's melee attacks inflict %1 increased damage.

1272290.name: Crunched
1272290.text: The player is stunned for 5 sec after being chewed up and spit out.

1276586.name: Bedrock Surge
1276586.text: The impact of Bedrock Slam causes an aftershock that inflicts Nature damage to all players every 1 sec for 8 sec.

1282892.name: Sickening Bite
1282892.text: The Toxic Creeper bites a player, causing them to suffer 50% increased Nature damage for 5 min. This effect stacks.

1282959.name: Gatekeeper
1282959.text: The presence of this creature is blocking the way to Charonus.

1287627.name: Searing Fel Flame
1287627.text: Lithiel Cinderfury engulfs herself in fel fire, radiating Fire damage to enemies every 1 sec.

1287798.name: Vine Grip
1287798.text: Orweyna attaches players to the Writhing Coil with powerful vines. All attached players moving 10yd farther from the Writhing Coil causes it to Uncoil.

1287811.name: Uncoil
1287811.text: The Writhing Coil is ripped apart into its constituent snakes, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

1288087.name: Thunder and Lightning
1288087.text:
Adderis dashes forward with his arcing blade, inflicting Nature damage divided evenly between all players nearby.

He then winds up a massive peal of thunder, inflicting Nature damage to all enemies nearby.

1288428.name: Overload
1288428.text: Adderis overloads with power for 8 sec, increasing his attack speed by 100% and causing each of his melee strikes to inflict 25% of their damage as additional Nature damage.

1288457.name: Gust
1288457.text: Aspix blasts a player for Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

1288864.name: Tempest Winds
1288864.text:
Aspix targets players with furious winds, inflicting Nature damage to players within yards of the impacts.

These winds build over time, coalescing into tempest zones for 1 min that silence and pacify any players who contact them for 4 sec.

1289062.name: Gale Force
1289062.text: Aspix launches gale force winds at players, inflicting Nature damage and pushing them away.

1289063.name: Rune of Echoes
1289063.text:
Your Core Rune (Void-Touched Orbs) leaves an echoing curse on the target for 10 sec that accumulates 50% of all damage or healing done to the target by your Core Rune and your Rune of Lingering.

When the curse expires, all accumulated damage or healing is dealt to the target.

1289205.name: Hatch
1289205.text: Snakes emerge from eggs within Merektha's chamber that attack players.

1289265.name: Corrosive Essence
1289265.text: Inflicts Nature damage every 2 sec for 12 sec.

1289416.name: Envenom
1289416.text: Inflicts Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

1289589.name: Lingering Storm
1289589.text: The pool of electricity inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec.

1289602.name: Thunder Spit
1289602.text:
Merektha spits volatile energy at players, inflicting Nature damage and causing lightning to strike their location every 1 sec for 4 sec.

Each strike inflicts Nature damage to all players within the impact zone and leaves behind Lingering Storm.

1290031.name: A Knot of Snakes
1290031.text:
Many small snakes wrap around the target, preventing any action and slowly suffocating the victim for Physical damage every 1 sec.

Destroying or incapacitating the knot of snakes frees the victim, causing the clump to unravel and attack players.

1290531.name: Induction
1290531.text: Galvazzt releases a pulse of electric energy, inflicting Nature damage to all enemies and creating an Induction Field.

1290797.name: Lightning Bite
1290797.text: Merektha sinks her crackling fangs into her current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 7 sec.

1291399.name: Serrated Charge
1291399.text: The creature charges to an enemy, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

1291468.name: Sunder Slam
1291468.text: Inflicts Physical damage and increases Physical damage taken by 50% for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

1291622.name: Storm Catalyst
1291622.text: The Storm Serpent calls down a lightning strike at its location, inflicting Nature damage to all players near the impact zone and leaving behind Lingering Storm.

1291815.name: Induction Field
1291815.text: A static field inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec to players standing within it.

1292035.name: Frenzy
1292035.text: The loss of one partner sends the other into a wild frenzy, casting abilities with reckless abandon.

1292585.name: Sandburst Arrow
1292585.text: Fires an enchanted arrow that trembles in the ground before exploding, inflicting Nature damage to enemies nearby.

1292904.name: Incubate
1292904.text: The infuser channels on unhatched eggs, accelerating their incubation.

1292990.name: Swarming Krolusks
1292990.text: The caster summons Krolusk kin to aid them in battle.

1293022.name: Fel Dash
1293022.text: Dash towards target enemy and inflicts Fire damage.

1293048.name: Serpentstorm
1293048.text:
Merektha exhales, knocking back all players and inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Storm Strikes occur across the chamber.

1293059.name: Hatch
1293059.text: The eggs break open, unleashing nascent Hatchlings.

1293101.name: Shadow Bite
1293101.text: Melee attacks inflict additional Shadow damage to target enemy.

1293307.name: Addle Mind
1293307.text: Channels mind-altering energy, disorienting the enemy for 5 sec.

1293420.name: Evolution Ritual
1293420.text: Shielded by the ritual. Unattackable and immune.

1293464.name: Accumulate Charge
1293464.text:
The caster gathers energy, increasing their damage done by 8%.

This effect stacks. Maximum of applications.

1293475.name: Release Charge
1293475.text: Releases all pent up energy built from Accumulate Charge, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

1293650.name: Call Lightning
1293650.text: The caster calls down lightning, inflicting Nature damage to all enemies near the impact.

1294432.name: Septic Spatter
1294432.text: The leech pops, splashing poisoned blood that inflicts Nature damage on impact and Nature damage every 1.5 sec to players within the pools.

1294557.name: Piercing Hiss
1294557.text: Inflicts Physical damage and reduces haste by 30% for 6 sec. This effect ignores armor.

1294567.name: Paralyzing Shots
1294567.text:
The Twinfang spits numbing venom at players, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 14 sec.

Affected players become paralyzed over time, reducing their movement speed by 10% with each tick.

1294770.name: Demonic Frenzy
1294770.text: Caster enters a demonic rage, increasing its Haste by 20% and pulses Fire damage every 1 sec.

1294815.name: Shadowfrost Bolt
1294815.text: Inflicts Shadowfrost damage to an enemy.

1294824.name: Defiled Slam
1294824.text: Slams the ground with Fel energy, inflicting Fire damage to all enemies and causes Defiled Detonation at nearby locations.

1294845.name: Corrosive Fangs
1294845.text: The writhe injects the target with powerful venom, inflicting Nature damage and increasing damage taken by 20% for 20 sec.

1294849.name: Rattle
1294849.text: The writhe rattles its tail, inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec for 5 sec. This effect ignores armor.

1294870.name: Fel-Scarred Earth
1294870.text: Inflicts Fire damage to an enemy every 1 sec.

1294883.name: Shoot
1294883.text: The caster shoots an arrow at a player, inflicting Physical damage.

1294934.name: Noxious Spray
1294934.text: The serpent blasts a rapid stream of venom at its target, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

1294972.name: Soul Bolt
1294972.text: Inflicts Shadow damage to an enemy.

1295035.name: Glaive Toss
1295035.text: Caster tosses a glaive at target enemy, inflicting Physical damage and causes them to bleed for Physical damage for 4 sec. The glaive then bounces towards nearby enemies.

1295055.name: Virulent Whirl
1295055.text:
The serpent spins violently, unleashing toxins that inflict Nature damage near each impact.

The toxins then swirl up into a Virulent Twister at each location.

1295125.name: Spectral Bolt
1295125.text: Inflicts Shadow damage to an enemy.

1295427.name: Flay
1295427.text: Caster charges toward an enemy and slashes them, inflicting Physical damage and causes them to bleed for an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

1295453.name: Infernal Crush
1295453.text: Xathuux the Annihilator slams the ground with his fel-infused axe, causing energy to erupt under target players, inflicting Fire damage and additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

1295635.name: Slither Strike
1295635.text: The caster teleports to a player and strikes, inflicting Nature damage.

1296052.name: Imbued Conduction
1296052.text:
The caster sends electricity into players, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

If Imbued Conduction expires, strikes the victim.

1296058.name: Regurgitate
1296058.text: Rav'i hurls 3 waves of stomach acid in lines toward an enemy, inflicting Nature damage to enemies within yards and enemies caught in the waves, and decreasing their movement speed by 50% and their damage done by 50%.

1296219.name: Fetid Roar
1296219.text: Rav'i roars with rage at her meal being interrupted, consuming all stacks of to inflict Nature damage per stack to all players.

1296220.name: Triple Shot
1296220.text: Rav'i shoots globs of venom at 3 enemies that each inflict Nature damage and an additional Nature damage to enemies within yd every 1 sec for 10 sec.

1296518.name: Rumbling Ward
1296518.text: Caster creates a shield around itself that absorbs incoming damage, and pulses Nature damage to all enemies every 2 sec for 1 min.

1296671.name: Captain's Bulwark
1296671.text: The Guard Captain protects its allies, causing them to receive 30% less damage.

1296719.name: Forked Lightning
1296719.text: Inflicts Nature damage to the target and bouncing towards up to 2 additional targets.

1296722.name: Earthquake
1296722.text: Nanea causes the earth to tremble and break at target players' locations, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and an additional Nature damage to players standing within every 1 sec for 30 sec.

1296738.name: Hatch
1296738.text: The embryo within the egg is beginning to hatch. When complete, a snake will emerge and attack the players.

1296889.name: Ethereal Shades
1296889.text: Taz'Rah summons ethereal shades in nearby locations to assist him in battle.

1296912.name: Storm Strikes
1296912.text: Lightning strikes across the chamber, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impacts.

1296963.name: Umbral Rupture
1296963.text: Taz'Rah $?diff1|diff2[tears]$?diff8[and his Ethereal Shades tear] open a rift to the void, inflicting Shadow damage to all players near impact.

1296967.name: Void Fissure
1296967.text: Void energy eats away at the player, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec.

1297017.name: Void Blast
1297017.text: Taz'rah blasts target player with void energy, inflicting Shadow damage and knocking them back.

1297034.name: Electrified Ground
1297034.text: Merektha blocks her chamber's exits with electric patches that inflict Nature damage every 1 sec.

1297326.name: Eternal Bond
1297326.text: This royal duo have an eternal bond, sharing health with one another.

1297676.name: Punishing Might
1297676.text: Caster becomes empowered everytime her melee attack is missed or dodged, increasing her Physical damage done by 30% until she lands a melee attack. This effect stacks.

1297682.name: Drain Life
1297682.text: Drains life from the target every 1 sec, transfering them to the caster.

1297684.name: Dark Pact
1297684.text: Caster sacrifices 10% of its max health and shields itself for 30% of its max health.

1297696.name: Healing Breeze
1297696.text: The caster conjures a healing breezing, healing nearby allies for of their maximum health every 2 sec.

1297699.name: Rotten Supplies
1297699.text: Inflicts Nature damage and leaves behind Rotten Ground for 20 sec.

1297763.name: Bestial Berserk
1297763.text: Increases movement, attacking, and casting speed of Queen Patlaa and her allies by 25% for 15 sec.

1297778.name: Arc Lightning
1297778.text: Caster strikes an enemy with a lightning bolt that arcs to another nearby enemy, inflicting Nature damage. The spell affects up to targets.

1297781.name: Sudden Rupture
1297781.text: Ruptures the target, reducing their movement speed by 10% and bleeding for Physical damage every 1 sec for 18 sec.

1297792.name: Overwhelming Onslaught
1297792.text:
Nalorakk unleashes a devastating set of attacks on all players, inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec for 3 sec. These attacks ignore armor. 

The final hit stuns Zul'Jarra and knocks all players back. Nalorakk then targets Zul'Jarra with Forceful Slam.

1297797.name: Forceful Slam
1297797.text: Nalorakk unleashes a power slam on Zul'jarra. Inflicting Physical damage to all players near impact. If there is no player hit, Zul'jarra bears the full force of the slam, causing her to let out a Demoralizing Scream.

1297918.name: Mortal Bleed
1297918.text:
Bleeds the enemy for Physical damage every 1 sec for 18 sec.

Reduces the healing received of an enemy by 20% for 18 sec.

1297970.name: Blood Drain
1297970.text: Drains blood from any bleeding enemies, inflicting Physical damage and healing King A'akul for ${*100}% of that amount.

1298223.name: Ssscavenging
1298223.text:
Rav'i runs to feast on the nearest Carrion Pile, gaining a shield that absorbs all damage. Until her shield is removed, Rav'i applies Carrion Burst to all enemies every 3 sec.
$? DIFF23 | DIFF8 [
Rav'i is a Messy Eater, and throws chunks of rotting meat across the pit while Ssscavenging.
][]
If the Carrion Pile contains Fresh Meat, Rav'i goes into a instead.

1298304.name: Dark Revelation
1298304.text: Unleashes a Dark Revelation after 5 sec, inflicting Shadow damage to enemies nearby.

1298683.name: Hydrastrike
1298683.text: Each of Rav'i's three heads strike her current target, inflicting Physical damage.

1298900.name: Brutal Slams
1298900.text: Caster shields himself and begins savagely slamming the ground every 1.5 sec, inflicting Physical damage to all enemies for 30 sec. Each slam increases the damage by an additional 8%. This effect stacks.

1298902.name: Proof of Mastery
1298902.text: Absorbing the might of the arena champion, increasing the target's Mastery by ${*}%.

1298903.name: Proof of Endurance
1298903.text: Absorbing the might of the arena champion, increasing the target's Versatility.

1298908.name: Champion's Spear
1298908.text: Caster summons a spear that chains all players, inflicting Physical every 1 sec and pulling them in until the spear is destroyed.

1298949.name: Tail Scythe
1298949.text: The Writhing Coil slices its current target with a bladed tail, inflicting Physical damage.

1299053.name: Death Rattle
1299053.text: The Writhing Coil unleashes a relentless rattle, inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks, and increases its applications every 1 sec until the Writhing Coil is pulled apart.

1299130.name: Burrowing Charge
1299130.text: The Writhing Coil burrows across the ground, inflicting Nature damage to enemies in its path.

1299154.name: Synchronized Venom
1299154.text: The Writhing Coil shoots venom at all enemies, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 35 sec.

1299240.name: Raging Typhoon
1299240.text: Caster creates a swirling typhoon at target location, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to enemies within and periodically creates Crashing Wave.

1299257.name: Crashing Wave
1299257.text: Inflicts Nature damage to enemies within.

1299913.name: Null Eruption
1299913.text:
Inflicts Shadow damage to enemies near the impact.

Inflicts Shadow damage to all enemies near the impact every 1 sec for 5 sec.

1299940.name: Vindictive Onslaught
1299940.text: The Writhing Coil directs a sequence of vicious attacks at an enemy.

1300044.name: Venom Jet
1300044.text: The Writhing Coil unleashes a spray of venom at an enemy, inflicting Nature damage to enemies in a cone in front of it.

1300138.name: Void Beam
1300138.text: Caster inflicts Shadow damage to enemies near impact every 0.5 sec for 4 sec.

1300243.name: Brutalize
1300243.text: Inflicts Physical damage on target enemy every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.

1300249.name: Devour
1300249.text: Devours the target, healing the caster for 50% of their health.

1300259.name: Dark Bloom
1300259.text: Taz'rah unleashes a wave of void energy, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and causes Void Fissure to erupt, inflicting Shadow damage to players hit.

1300503.name: Spiteful Hunt
1300503.text: Each Uncoiled Writhe fixates on an enemy.

1300612.name: Uncoiled
1300612.text:
The Writhing Coil splits into Uncoiled Writhes, each with a portion of the Writhing Coil's health. After 20 sec, the Uncoiled Writhes cast Assimilation, and the Writhing Coil reforms with the combined health of the Uncoiled Writhes.

Uncoiled Writhes are susceptible to crowd control effects.

1300684.name: Hex Muck
1300684.text: A mire of hex magic transforms players within it into a frog, rendering them unable to attack or cast spells and inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec.

1300686.name: Assimilation
1300686.text: All Uncoiled Writhes converge to reform into The Writhing Coil.

1300698.name: Assimilation
1300698.text: All Uncoiled Writhes converge to reform into The Writhing Coil.

1300704.name: Fixate
1300704.text: The creature attempts to fixate upon the closest enemy healer and reduces their healing done upon striking by 5%. This effect stacks.

1300714.name: Shadowlash
1300714.text: The creature attempts to fixate upon the closest enemy healer and reduces their healing done upon striking by 5%. This effect stacks.

1300803.name: Tainted Strike
1300803.text: The Corrupted Guardian attacks their current target with a brutal slash, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

1300871.name: Corrupted Lifeforce
1300871.text:
Touching cleanses it, transferring Corruption to the player.

The Avatar can Consume Lifeforce once cleansed. Otherwise, a Corruption Burst occurs upon expiration of.

1300876.name: Ritual of the Fang
1300876.text:
Zul'jan wields the Fang of Ula'tek as snake heads focus ancient beams into him for 8 sec, granting Fang Empowered.

Upon interception by players, the beams instead inflict Nature damage every 1 sec and apply Ritual Venom.

1300885.name: Ritual of the Fang
1300885.text:
Zul'jan wields the Fang of Ula'tek as snake heads focus ancient beams into him for 8 sec, granting Fang Empowered.

Upon interception by players, the beams instead inflict Nature damage every 1 sec and apply Ritual Venom.

1300888.name: Fang Empowered
1300888.text: The Fang of Ula'tek pulses with strength, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

1300894.name: Ritual Venom
1300894.text: Dormant toxins fill the player for 50 sec. Upon expiration, the venom bursts inflicting Nature damage.

1301111.name: Axegrinder
1301111.text:
Zul'jan unleashes spinning axes that eviscerate players on contact, inflicting up to ${*} Physical damage. This effect ignores armor.

The axes ricochet through the arena, inflicting reduced damage as they lose speed.

1301199.name: Defiling Taint
1301199.text: The Essence Defiler channels dark energy into the Avatar of Sethraliss, preventing all external healing.

1301217.name: Bloodletting
1301217.text: Zul'jan's Physical abilities cause players to hemorrhage, removing applications of Ritual Venom and creating pools of blood inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players within them.

1301350.name: Chop Down
1301350.text: Zul'jan hacks twice at his current target, inflicting Physical damage with each strike.

1301413.name: Boneslicer
1301413.text: Zul'jan hurls an axe at a player, inflicting Physical damage to all players caught in its path and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 7 sec. This effect ignores armor.

1301851.name: Bloodthirsty Axe
1301851.text: Throws a serrated axe that seeks up to two targets, bleeding for Physical damage every 1 sec. For 12 sec.

1302007.name: Blade Dance
1302007.text: Caster strikes all enemies every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec, inflicting Fire damage.

1302153.name: Latent Hex
1302153.text:
The creature afflicts a player for 4 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec.

Upon removal, shadowy energy inflicts Shadow damage to players within yards of the victim and releases Hex Muck.

1302158.name: Flame Shock
1302158.text: The creature sears a player with fire, inflicting Fire damage and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

1302616.name: Vile Charge
1302616.text: The Corrupted Guardian charges to a player and strikes them, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

1302761.name: Unstable Corruption
1302761.text: Polluted energy erupts from the Corrupted Guardian, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and forming Corrupted Lifeforce.

1302826.name: Corruption Burst
1302826.text: Dark energy explodes from the, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and increasing damage taken from this ability by 100% for 3 sec.

1302897.name: Consume Lifeforce
1302897.text: The Avatar of Sethraliss consumes, healing herself for 2% of her maximum health and regenerating $<healAmount>% of her maximum health every 3 sec. This effect stacks.

1302945.name: Impaling Spear
1302945.text: Spears periodically launches from the ceiling, inflicting Physical damage to all players near impact and causes them to bleed for Physical damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

1303105.name: Aerial Smash
1303105.text: King Dazar leaps at target players, unleashing a powerful smash that inflicts Physical damage to players near impact.

1303267.name: Gilded Destruction
1303267.text: King Dazar empowers himself with molten gold around his eternal throne, then unleashes a gilded smash that inflicts Fire damage to all players and additional Fire damage for 15 sec$?|diff2[.]$?diff8[. Dazar becomes enveloped in Searing Gold.]

1303324.name: Quaking Leap
1303324.text: T'zala leaps at target players, inflicting Physical damage to players near impact.

1303366.name: Venom Burst
1303366.text: Bursts upon death, inflicting Nature damage.

1303372.name: Searing Gold
1303372.text: Empowered by the molten gold, King Dazar's melee attacks creates a wave of searing gold in front of him, inflicting Fire damage to players hit.

1303396.name: Liquid Gold
1303396.text: Liquid gold drips from T'zala's body periodically for 12 sec, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec to players within.

1303443.name: Venomous Slash
1303443.text:
The creature strikes its current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

Venom Shrapnel rains outward from the strike.

1303452.name: Venom Shrapnel
1303452.text: Venomous missiles rain down, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby.

1303486.name: Caustic Stomp
1303486.text: The creature stomps to eject a venomous nova, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

1303488.name: Savage Maul
1303488.text: T'zala charges towards the target player and mauls them, inflicting Physical damage. The attack leaves behind a bleeding wound on the target, causing them to bleed for Physical damage every 1 sec and increasing their Physical damage taken by 10% for 10 sec.

1303596.name: Siphon Energy
1303596.text: The Eye of Sethraliss siphons energy from the closest player within yards, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec.

1305201.name: Excavating Blast
1305201.text:
The caster inflicts Nature damage to enemies nearby and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

The impacts causes Blast Chunks to rain down.

1305225.name: Tectonic Strike
1305225.text: The caster knocks its current target off balance, inflicting Physical damage and increasing their damage taken by 25% for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

1305234.name: Cold Claws
1305234.text: Infused Whelps attack with frost-infused claws, applying an affliction that causes at applications.

1305368.name: Spiteful Venom
1305368.text: A fast-acting poison pervades the target's bloodstream, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec and reducing damage done by 5% for 3 sec. This effect stacks.

1305393.name: Undermining
1305393.text: Upon defeat, an Uncoiled Writhe begins destabilizing the earth, inflicting Nature damage and knocking back enemies above them.

1305810.name: Arc Lightning
1305810.text: Zanazal strikes target player with a lightning bolt that arcs to other players, inflicting Nature damage to each player struck.

1305955.name: Fiery Blast
1305955.text: The caster inflicts Fire damage to their current target.

1305982.name: Shadow Volley
1305982.text: Unleashes a volley of shadow arrows every 1 sec for 2 sec. Each volley lasts for 10 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to enemies within.

1306308.name: Ravenous
1306308.text: Melee swings increase attack speed by 10% for 2 sec. This effect stacks.

1306333.name: Ravenous Claws
1306333.text: Melee swings increase attack speed by 10% for 2 sec. This effect stacks.

1306345.name: Messy Eater
1306345.text:
Rav'i's chomping throws chunks of rotting meat across the pit. Each chunk inflicts Nature damage to enemies near its impact location.

Each chunk that isn't caught by an enemy explodes in a Carrion Burst.

1306366.name: Lightning Torrent
1306366.text: The caster barrages a player with electricity for 7 sec, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec.

1306385.name: Evolve
1306385.text:
The caster attempts to evolve, healing 5% of it's max health every 1 sec for 6 sec.

Upon completion, the caster gains a shield that absorbs the next damage and grants immunity to crowd control effects.

1306517.name: Blood Sacrifice
1306517.text: The Ritual Chieftain invokes spirits of the altar to gut players, inflicting Physical damage and causing the next healing to be absorbed.

1306657.name: Blood Sacrifice
1306657.text: The Ritual Chieftain invokes spirits of the altar to gut players, inflicting Physical damage and causing the next healing to be absorbed.

1306668.name: Toxic Breath
1306668.text: The Twinfang unleashes noxious gas from its jaws, inflicting Nature damage every 0.5 sec to players caught within its breath.

1306763.name: Serpent Strike
1306763.text: Inflicts Nature damage and additional Nature damage every 1 sec and reduce the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

1306852.name: Toxic Surge
1306852.text: The venomancer unleashes a storm of poison, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 9 sec and triggering Toxic Beam.

1306856.name: Toxic Beam
1306856.text: Inflicts Nature damage to any players hit.

1306893.name: Unstable Totem
1306893.text: The totem becomes unstable, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec while the chieftain remains in combat.

1306911.name: Dismember
1306911.text: The chieftain hacks his current target, inflicting Physical damage.

1307205.name: Earthbound's Imprint
1307205.text: The caster inflicts Nature damage to a player and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

1307372.name: Fiery Demise
1307372.text: Upon death, the creature becomes a pool of fire, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec to players within it.

1307502.name: Summon Primal Thunderclouds
1307502.text: Summons Primal Thunderclouds to aid the caster in combat.

1307511.name: Summon Primal Thunderclouds
1307511.text: Summons Primal Thunderclouds to aid the caster in combat.

1307526.name: Bloodletting
1307526.text: Melee attacks draw pools of blood.

1307567.name: Mass Envenom
1307567.text: Inflicts Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

1307602.name: Evolved
1307602.text:
The caster attempts to evolve, healing 5% of it's max health every 1 sec for 6 sec. 

Upon completion, the caster gains a shield that absorbs the next damage and grants immunity to crowd control effects.

1307700.name: Carrion Burst
1307700.text: The stench of rotting meat and viscera clings to all enemies, inflicting Nature damage every 3 sec for 9 sec. This effect stacks.

1307703.name: Fresh Meat
1307703.text: The taste of Fresh Meat throws Rav'i into a, causing her to eat twice as fast.

1307894.name: Ravenous Stomp
1307894.text:
Rav'i stomps impatiently, sending a quake through the temple that inflicts Nature damage to all enemies and breaks several stalactites from the ceiling. Each stalactite inflicts Nature damage to enemies near the impact and stuns players caught in the impact for 2 sec.

Flying Twinfangs are skewered by the falling rocks, dropping Fresh Meat into Rav'i's pit.

1308100.name: Poisoned Cheap Shot
1308100.text: The caster poisons their target with a cheap shot, stunning them and inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 5 sec. Requires stealth.

1308113.name: Arrow Barrage
1308113.text: The caster fires a barrage of arrows at a player for 9 sec, inflicting Physical damage every 0.8 sec.

1308148.name: Cytotoxin
1308148.text: The caster injects cytotoxins into a player, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

1308518.name: Laced Edge
1308518.text: Teleports behind a player and slashes them, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

1308864.name: Infest
1308864.text:
The serpent infests players with eggs, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

The infestations burst upon expiration, inflicting Nature damage nearby and creating Hatchlings.

1309385.name: Pool of Darkness
1309385.text: Standing within a Pool of Darkness inflicts Shadow damage every 2 sec.

1309919.name: Frigid Roar
1309919.text: The bear lets loose a frigid roar, reducing Haste and Movement Speed by 50%.

1309925.name: Volatile Totem
1309925.text: Nanea creates multiple totems to assist her in combat that release Volatile Flames.

1309931.name: Volatile Flames
1309931.text: Flames radiate from the totem, inflicting Fire damage every 2.5 sec.

1309947.name: Harsh Winter
1309947.text: The Winter Squall conjures a dense cloud in a yard radius around itself. Players cannot target into or out of the cloud. Players within the cloud suffer Frost damage periodically.

1310025.name: Gravitic Orbs
1310025.text:
Charonus summons a seeking Gravitic Orb near each player. The orb afflicts target player with Condensed Mass every 1 sec.

If the orb comes within 6 yards of an Unstable Singularity, its essence is torn apart and the orb is destroyed.

1310309.name: Macestorm
1310309.text: Charges to a random enemy and inflicts Physical damage to enemies nearby every 1 sec. For 6 sec.

1310311.name: Storm Blessed
1310311.text:
Adderis and Aspix call upon the power of the storm, granting them immunity to damage.

The duo will transfer this blessing between themselves as they get injured.

1310324.name: Mending Void
1310324.text: Heals the target for 3% of maximum health every 2 sec for 20 sec.

1310355.name: Tempest Stormshield
1310355.text:
The caster protects itself with a barrier of storm magic, absorbing 15% of its maximum health. While protected, the caster radiates Nature damage to all players every 1 sec.

Upon expiration, the barrier detonates, stunning players nearby for 4 sec.

1310357.name: Toxic Barrage
1310357.text: The Writhing Coil prepares to afflict its enemies with Toxic Atrophy 3 times in succession.

1310378.name: Scent of Blood
1310378.text: If the nearest Carrion Pile contains Fresh Meat, Rav'i gains Scent of Blood, increasing attack speed by 30%.

1310396.name: Serpent's Stormcall
1310396.text:
The creature calls on the power of the storm, causing its melee attacks to inflict additional Nature damage for 8 sec.

Upon expiration, a pool of Lingering Storm forms underneath the creature.

1310489.name: Blast Chunks
1310489.text: Debris rains from the ceiling, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impacts.

1310599.name: Electrical Discharge
1310599.text: Electrical current surges into players nearby, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

1310666.name: Toxic Atrophy
1310666.text: Releases a toxin that causes all enemies' muscles to wither away, reducing their damage done by 20% and their movement speed by 20%. This effect stacks.

1310683.name: Venom Bolt
1310683.text: The caster inflicts Nature damage to a player.

1310693.name: Static Shocks
1310693.text: The creature's melee attacks inflict additional Nature damage.

1310739.name: Accumulate Charge
1310739.text:
The caster gathers energy, increasing their damage done by 8%.

This effect stacks. Maximum of applications.

1310755.name: Heavy Slams
1310755.text: Melee attacks triggers causes the earth to rumble, inflicting Physical damage to all enemies.

1310974.name: Toxic Atrophy
1310974.text: Releases a toxin that causes all enemies' muscles to wither away, reducing their damage done by 20% and their movement speed by 20%. This effect stacks.

1311572.name: Melee
1311572.text: The caster inflicts Physical damage to its current target

1311747.name: Orb of Disruption
1311747.text: Summons Orbs of Disruptions in nearby locations.

1311754.name: Forked Lightning
1311754.text: Inflicts Nature damage to the target and bouncing towards up to 2 additional targets.

1311923.name: Dark Waves
1311923.text: Charonus sends out a wave of dark energy, inflicting Shadow damage to players hit.

1311980.name: Latent Hex
1311980.text:
The creature afflicts a player for 5 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec.

Upon removal, shadowy energy inflicts Shadow damage to players within yards of the victim and releases Hex Muck.

1311987.name: Serpentine Gust
1311987.text: The Golden Serpent creates a powerful gust of wind for 5 sec, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 1 sec and pushing them back.

1312146.name: Awakening Slam
1312146.text: Mchimba slams the ground with necrotic energy, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. The slam causes random crypts to open, summoning Half-Finished Mummy.

1312214.name: Corruption
1312214.text: The dark energy inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec, reduces healing done by 33%, and increases Physical damage taken by 250% for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

1312848.name: Command Constructs
1312848.text: Mchimba lets out a powerful roar, inflicting Physical damage tol players and commands nearby Interment Constructs to embalm players.

1314883.name: Hunting Leap
1314883.text: Jumps towards a targeted player and unleashes a series of gutripping attacks, inflicting Physical to players in a cone with each attack.
